communicationsjob detailsabout salesforcesalesforce is the #1 ai crm, where humans with agents drive customer success together. here, ambition meets action. tech meets trust. and innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. the world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through ai, driving innovation, and keeping salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? you’re in the right place! agentforce is the future of ai, and you are the future of salesforce.the experiencethe global brand & creative (gbc) team within marketing is responsible for our brand and marketing creative. from building brand awareness campaigns to designing experiences like dreamforce, our multi-faceted team does it all. we are a collection of thinkers, makers and doers, whose sole purpose is to bring the brand to life across our incredible portfolio of work.within gbc, the brand insights, strategy & management team is in charge of the brand insights, brand strategy, creative strategy, and brand management that powers the global brand & creative team and salesforce as a whole. we advocate the power of brand across the organization, guide brand marketing activities, and ensure brand excellence.we are looking for a creative strategist who bridges the gap between data-driven market understanding and world-class creative execution. in this role, you will lead the end-to-end creative strategy lifecycle across advertising, sports partnerships, internal campaigns, and events.you will serve as the ultimate connector of dots: identifying what customers and prospects are facing and what they think of us, translating those insights into potent creative strategies that guide our creative teams, and overseeing the validation testing of the resulting creative to ensure it hits the mark. this role will report into the director, creative strategy and work to drive brand awareness and relevance, support wider business objectives, and create strategic alignment across the broader marketing org through influence and relationship-building.what you'll actually be doingown the end-to-end creative lifecycle: manage the continuous loop of generating insights that inform creative strategy, formulating the creative strategy itself, working with creatives to ensure we stay on-brief, and leading the validation testing of the resulting creative.stay on the pulse: spearhead insight and data gathering to understand audience perception and needs. know what the market thinks of us and what audiences need at any given time.differentiate the brand: monitor the competitive landscape to ensure our creative work cuts through the noise, establishing a distinct and powerful brand voice.develop creative strategy: translate data into inspiring, actionable audience insights that inform your creative strategies and briefs across advertising, high-profile sports partnerships, internal employee campaigns, and major events.lead creative testing: guide pre-market and in-market creative testing with our vendors and internal teams to validate concepts, optimize the work, and prove roi.partner across teams: work seamlessly with brand strategy, brand management, and the campaign creative (designers, copywriters, producers) to ensure our high-profile campaigns and marketing activities are strategically sound and creatively compelling.brand advocacy: be a brand advocate within marketing and across salesforce’s global organization.you're our person if...8+ years of experience in creative strategy, brand planning, or creative insights/research roles, with at least 3 years in b2b tech or large-scale global brands.expertise spanning multiple creative disciplines: advertising, sports partnerships, experiential/events, and internal communications.a strong portfolio of creative briefs and strategies that led to measurable business impact and award-winning creative.strong creative instincts rooted in audience understanding and competitive differentiation.excellent written, verbal, and presentation skills, capable of influencing creative teams and executive stakeholders. you can “speak creative” and deliver guidance that inspires.strong qualitative and quantitative research skills, with a proven track record of gathering data, uncovering market perceptions, and synthesizing findings into clear strategic narratives.experience designing and leading creative validation and message testing.experience advancing cross-functional initiatives with stakeholders across functions, geographies, and operating units in fast-paced, high-performance environments.ba/bs required; mba a plus.why you are excited about this roleyou always put the customer first.you love living at the intersection of data and creativity, using insights as a springboard for bold ideas.you thrive on variety — from a massive sports partnership campaign one day to an intimate event for c-levels the next.you enjoy the rigor of testing and learning, always seeking to validate and optimize the creative product.you excel at simplifying complexity and providing clear strategic direction.why we are excited about youabove all, you are a sense-maker and a storyteller.you know how to discern between the quality of stories.you have a passion for people and a skill for building relationships with creatives. this role requires a skilled relationship-builder who can create influence across the marketing organization and occasionally with stakeholders outside of marketing to ensure strategic alignment.you are a rare hybrid: deeply analytical but highly creative.you have a keen eye for what makes great creative and the data chops to prove it.you naturally bring out the best in creative teams by providing clear, inspiring, and evidence-backed direction.you are hungry and pro-active; always hunting for the next great unlock.you see brand and creative as a core business driver and can back it up with data.you bring emotional intelligence, balance strategic thinking with hands-on execution, and thrive in ambiguity.you’re an excellent verbal and written communicator; your briefs get to the real heart of it with succinct and powerful words; you never get lost in strategisms or complexity; you can see the center of a concept quickly, clearly, and help others do the same — you make people believe the brand challenge you’re trying to solve.you’re an ai self-starter; experimenting on ways to optimize your own workflows, get to insights faster, and build more expansive and effective processes and ways of working for our team.you can balance big visionary thinking with the simplicity and practicality it takes to ship and ship fast.unleash your potentialwhen you join salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. our benefits and resources support you to find balance and be your best, and our ai agents accelerate your impact so you can do your best. together, we’ll bring the power of agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for ai, and the world.accommodationsif you need a reasonable accommodation during the application or the recruiting process, please submit a request via this accommodations request form.please note that salesforce uses artificial intelligence (ai) tools to help our recruiters assess and evaluate candidates’ resumes and qualifications throughout the recruiting process. humans will always make any candidate selection and hiring decisions. please see our candidate privacy statement for more information about how we use your personal data and your rights, including with regard to use of ai tools and opt out options.posting statementsalesforce is an equal opportunity employer and maintains a policy of non-discrimination with all employees and applicants for employment. what does that mean exactly? it means that at salesforce, we believe in equality for all. and we believe we can lead the path to equality in part by creating a workplace that’s inclusive, and free from discrimination. know your rights: workplace discrimination is illegal. any employee or potential employee will be assessed on the basis of merit, competence and qualifications – without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender expression or identity, transgender status, age, disability, veteran or marital status, political viewpoint, or other classifications protected by law. this policy applies to current and prospective employees, no matter where they are in their salesforce employment journey. it also applies to recruiting, hiring, job assignment, compensation, promotion, benefits, training, assessment of job performance, discipline, termination, and everything in between. recruiting, hiring, and promotion decisions at salesforce are fair and based on merit. the same goes for compensation, benefits, promotions, transfers, reduction in workforce, recall, training, and education.in the united states, compensation offered will be determined by factors such as location, job level, job-related knowledge, skills, dental, vision, mental health support, paid parental leave, life and disability insurance, 401(k), and an employee stock purchasing program. more details about company benefits can be found at the following link: https://www.salesforcebenefits.com.at salesforce, we believe in equitable compensation practices that reflect the dynamic nature of labor markets across various regions. the typical evolves. behind that velocity is the launch operations team, which owns the process that governs the lifecycle of bringing every aws capability to customers, from intake through customer availability. we turn aws’s innovation velocity into a durable marketing advantage: driving operational scale so service teams and stakeholders can focus on innovation, and improving signal-to-noise so the most important news reaches customers and enables field sales and partner teams to engage around the launches that matter most.we are looking for a program manager to help run the programs that make this possible. working closely with senior program managers and stakeholders, you will help keep launches moving on time and at a high quality bar — coordinating across product managers, marketing, engineering, security, legal, and field teams, tracking deliverables, and surfacing risks early. this is a role for someone who is organized, resourceful, and eager to grow in a high-visibility, cross-functional environment where the details matter and the scale is significant. you will learn the launch process end to end, and as you do, you will spot where manual coordination slows launches down and help implement the improvements that make the next cycle smoother.key job responsibilities support the end-to-end launch operations program including tracking milestones and deliverables, maintaining schedules, and surfacing risks across multiple concurrent launches. coordinate with product managers, marketing, engineering, security, legal, and field teams to keep launches moving from intake to customer availability and help remove blockers. help identify process gaps in how launches move through the pipeline and contribute to improvements that raise quality and reduce cycle time. maintain program dashboards and status reporting, ensuring stakeholders have accurate, timely visibility into launch progress. track program metrics and help improve signal-to-noise so the most important launches are elevated to customers. apply generative ai tools including amazon quick to streamline documentation, status reporting, and program analysis.a day in the lifeyou start your morning reviewing the launch pipeline and flagging any launches at risk of slipping, then follow up with the relevant task owners to keep them on track. mid-morning, you join a working session with product and marketing partners to walk through upcoming launches and capture next steps. after lunch, you update the program dashboard and pull together a status summary for the team, highlighting progress and any open items that need attention. between meetings, you look for small ways to remove friction in the intake process often using generative ai tooling to speed up the documentation and reporting that used to take up much of your day.about the teamthe aws lifecycle marketing team shapes how the world’s leading cloud and ai portfolio reaches customers. we orchestrate how aws launches are integrated with marketing planning, how lifecycle changes are managed responsibly, and how the portfolio is represented across shared surfaces and priority moments — removing complexity, increasing visibility, and ensuring marketing can act with the coordination, speed, and strategic focus the portfolio requires. launch operations is the connective tissue between aws service engineering and aws marketing, and this role is a great entry point into a multi-year transformation from manual, relationship-driven coordination to scalable, data-driven platforms. if you want to work on programs that shape how millions of customers experience aws innovation, we would love to hear from you.basic qualifications 2+ years of program or project management experience 3+ years of advanced microsoft word and excel experiencepreferred qualifications experience in requirement gathering and ability to write clear and detailed requirement document experience working in an analytical environment with cross-functional teamsamazon is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of protected veteran status, disability, or other legally protected status.our inclusive culture empowers amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. if you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. if the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your recruiting partner.the base salary range for this position is listed below. your amazon package will include sign-on payments and restricted stock units (rsus). final compensation will be determined based on factors including experience, qualifications, and location. amazon also offers comprehensive benefits including health insurance (medical, dental, vision, prescription, basic life & ad&d insurance and option for supplemental life plans, eap, mental health support, medical advice line, flexible spending accounts, adoption and surrogacy reimbursement coverage), 401(k) matching, paid time off, and parental leave. learn more about our benefits at https://amazon.jobs/en/benefits.usa, wa, seattle - 80,200.00 - 97,400.00 usd covista is america's largest healthcare educator, serving more than 97,000 students and supported by a community of 385,000 alumni across five accredited institutions. through personalized, tech-enabled education powered by 10,000 faculty and colleagues, covista expands access to healthcare careers and addresses the u.s. healthcare workforce shortage at scale. covista is the parent company of american university of the caribbean school of medicine, chamberlain university, ross university school of medicine, ross university school of veterinary medicine and walden university.our colleagues come from a wide range of backgrounds, business, academia, healthcare, government and nonprofits, and are part of a culture where doing exceptional work and making a meaningful difference for students and society aren't separate goals—they're one and the same. this means creating an environment where colleagues can develop new skills, build careers that match their ambitions and see the tangible impact of their work on healthcare education and workforce development. colleagues who deliver results and embrace new tools to work smarter are valued for their contributions. but what makes working at covista distinctive is our impact. our faculty and colleagues don't just support healthcare education—they shape it. this isn't abstract purpose work. it's solving real problems for real people in real communities while advancing careers.we operate on a hybrid schedule with four in-office days per week (monday–thursday). this approach enhances creativity, innovation, communication, and relationship-building, fostering a dynamic and collaborative work environment. job descriptionyou'll be the steady hand behind how covista's first team (our executive leadership) communications, you'll own the day-to-day mechanics of executive positioning: keeping every workstream on track, every voice consistent and every piece of content polished and on time.this role is built for someone who thrives on precision and process as much as prose. you'll manage multiple executives' content calendars and priorities simultaneously, translate a leader's point of view into a linkedin post that actually performs, and make sure everything moves forward on schedule.the exposure is broad and the work is high visibility. you'll support the first team on the moments that define their public presence—thought leadership, linkedin engagement, speaking engagements and the steady drumbeat of content that builds their authority over time.key responsibilities:executive communicationsdraft speeches, talking points, bylined articles and presentations tailored to each first team member's voice and priorities. own day-to-day execution of executive social media, with a particular focus on linkedin—writing, scheduling, monitoring engagement and identifying trends and moments to capitalize on. build and maintain messaging frameworks and content calendars across multiple executives and audiences. support media and speaking engagement prep, including briefing materials and q&as. track and manage multiple concurrent executive workstreams, ensuring deadlines, approvals and details don't fall through the cracks. use ai and technology to sharpen your work and move faster. performs other duties as assigned. complies with all policies and standards. who thrives hereyou're exceptionally organized—the person who keeps five executives' priorities straight without breaking a sweat, and who never lets a detail slip. you've supported senior leaders directly before and understand the pace, discretion and precision that comes with it. you write well across voices and formats, and you have a strong feel for what makes content land on linkedin—not just what to post, but when, how, and why it'll resonate. you're proactive, low-ego, and comfortable being the person behind the scenes making an executive look good.qualificationsbachelor's degree in communications, marketing, journalism or a related field required. 7+ years of experience directly supporting c-suite or senior executive leaders in a communications capacity—in-house, agency or both. proven organizational rigor: experience managing multiple executives' content pipelines, calendars and priorities at once. exceptional writing: able to write convincingly in multiple executive voices and adapt across formats. social media fluency: hands-on experience managing executive linkedin presence and driving measurable engagement. discretion and judgment: comfortable handling sensitive information and high-stakes situations with maturity. comfort with ai tools: actively uses ai to produce better work, faster. preferred backgroundexperience in higher education, healthcare, publicly traded companies or regulated industries is a plus. you're as comfortable in a strategic conversation as you are executing the details flawlessly. you build trust easily—with internal teams, external partners, and media contacts alike. #cvsaadditional informationin support of the pay transparency laws enacted across the country, the expected salary range for this position is between $80,336.75 and detail.desc: looking for something new?for three decades, dkc has been at the forefront of communications agencies, attracting the best and the brightest talent from around the country. currently, we are searching for a trailblazing account supervisor in our media/technology division who is ready to take their career to the next level.we’re looking for a creative thinker and business strategist who has the media connections to move mountains; curiosity to work with the best brands in exciting sectors and the right amount of energy and enthusiasm to help world-class teams take brands to new heights.we need strategists who have a passion for storytelling and creative ideation and are invested in delivering the “big feature” for their clients. we want media relations mavens who can bring journalist connections but are also open to making more – regardless of the sector.if you have the combination of curiosity, energy and enthusiasm to help world-class teams take brands to new heights we’d like to meet. at dkc, we strongly believe in the mantra, work hard, play harder, win together!with a vibrant and fast-paced atmosphere, dkc prides itself on offering a culture of fun, inclusivity and growth. from our national committees focused on health & wellness, diversity and fun, to a hands-on-approach to training and career growth, dkc offers a wide range of options for career minded staff. plus, we offer 401k match, cell phone reimbursement, an unlimited vacation and sick day policy, the latest technology for all digital natives and a welcoming environment that is all about perfecting the craft of communications.now, a little about you:smart, energetic, savvy account leader with sophisticated media relations expertise and digital chops looking to join one of the most dynamic media and technology practices in the country5-8 years’ experience working at a pr agency and/or an in-house communications teama background in corporate, b2b and consumer technology with experience in such areas as ai, platform innovation, fintech, ad tech, and ecommerce.outstanding tech and innovation business media relationships and a finger on the pulse of the companies, events and people driving the conversation in tech.demonstrated ability to lead teams and launch startups and productsability to develop and successfully execute thought leadership campaignsunderstands and can study data and translate that data into stories that help set the stage for communications programsdelivers excellent client service and account management, a reliable point of contact for both the client and mediaready to grow your career in new ways including business development, brand marketing and agency marketingthe salary range for this role is commensurate with experience: $75k - $95k.our office has a hybrid work model: in office 3 days a week (tues-thurs), remote 2 days a week.dkc provides equal employment opportunities to applicants and employees without regard for factors such as race, religion, national origin, color, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, protected veteran status, disability, or other protected status.

about usat we., we've spent decades at the intersection of technology and humanity, bridging the gap between what businesses create and how people experience those creations. we've learned that beneath even the most unruly situations — whether it's a global crisis, an emerging technology, or a sweeping organizational change—lies a simple human need. that need could be for trust, connection, safety, or a sense of purpose. but it’s always there. and it is only by uncovering these truths that we can make real, meaningful progress.about the rolethe account manager will support communications strategy and media engagement for microsoft's business, helping protect and strengthen brand reputation by translating complex issues into clear, credible narratives for key audiences.this role involves managing day-to-day client needs, driving pr campaigns, and fostering strong media and influencer relationships. ideal candidates are proactive communicators with strong analytical writing, relationship-management skills, and a passion for helping organizations communicate clearly in moments that matter. this role may manage direct reports.responsibilitiesmanage company news announcements and media cycles across corporate issues, helping to coordinate responses and drive execution in fast-paced environments. build and maintain relationships with reporters, industry influencers, and content creators, identifying opportunities to place stories and interviews to strengthen client visibility. serve as day-to-day counsel for clients and internal stakeholders, providing informed recommendations, managing expectations, flagging risks early and keeping workstreams aligned and on schedule. lead planning sessions and brainstorms, helping identify creative storytelling opportunities and new approaches to audience engagement. draft and develop a wide range of communications materials, including pitches, media materials like faqs, executive briefing documents, reactive statements, and coverage reports. monitor and analyze media, social, industry and competitive conversations to identify emerging reputational risks and opportunities; translate findings into actionable recommendations that protect and strengthen brand trust. support integrated earned, owned, social, and influencer campaigns that advance business objectives by coordinating deliverables and tracking performance coordinate cross-functional efforts across multiple client, agency, and partner teams to gather information, align messaging, and support program execution. may manage career development and performance of direct reports, managing up to senior staff on important issues, and client/team satisfaction while holding the team accountable to demonstrating agency values other duties as assigned requirements4+ years of experience in integrated communications or pr, preferably in an agency setting and/or within an applicable industry; 1+ years of management experience preferred minimum of 3 years of experience in strategic communications, corporate image, and/or issues management. proficiency with microsoft office suite (particularly outlook, word, sharepoint, powerpoint and excel) and experience using ai tools like copilot. preferred qualificationsexperience working with clients in the technology or science industry. demonstrated customer service orientation and ability to establish a consulting relationship with clients. high level of initiative; take accountability for role on projects. experience engaging with reporters and pitching stories; having established media and/or creator influencer relationships is a plus. demonstrated creative and strategic mindset, and ability to synthesize complex information and translate it into clear, compelling content for a variety of audiences. ability to analyze the news and social media environment, and provide strategic recommendations based on business and industry knowledge. exceptional attention to detail and strong editorial judgment, including proficiency in ap style and ability to edit for accuracy, clarity and consistency. desire to work in a fast-paced team environment (frequent tight deadlines, shifting priorities, multitasking, etc.); job pressure may exist from requirement of handling multiple tasks. ability to read, write, and speak english and experience working with colleagues or clients across multiple locations. may need to work more than 40 hours per week on occasion. compensationthe base annual salary range for this role, applicable across all u.s. locations, is outlined below. the actual salary may vary based on several factors such as business requirements, job responsibilities, skills, experience, and geographical location.salary range: $88,000 usd - $100,000 usdbenefitsas part of our commitment to the success and well-being of our team, regular employees working 20 hours or more per week are eligible for the following benefits:comprehensive benefits program including medical, dental, and vision coveragepretax accounts including hsa (company match), medical & dependent care fsagenerous time off including pto, holidays, annual wellness break, summer fridays and personal daysshort & long-term disability, paid by companyparental leave, up to 12 weeks for birthing and non-birthing parentcaregiver leave, up to 2 weeks to help eligible family member with serious health conditioncommunity engagement, up to 24 hoursbi-annual wellness credits, up to $300 per yearsupport with home office equipmentmonthly technology credit (to offset internet / phone costs)401(k) traditional and roth options with company matchlearning and development programs for our employeesequal opportunity: we. provides equal employment opportunity and does not discriminate against an employee or applicant because of age, race, color, religion, gender, national origin, veteran status, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, marital status, or other legally protected class status.diversity and inclusion: we. values a diverse and inclusive workforce and is committed to creating a workplace where everyone thrives. we promote an atmosphere in which diversity of people and ideas are welcomed and valued. diversity includes differences in race, religion, gender identity or expression, age, lifestyle, ethnic background and sexual orientation as well as differences in experiences and ideas.north america non-remote employees are required to come into the office 3 days a week.

communications agency, has an immediate opening for an entrepreneurial, self-starting managing supervisor to join our growing healthcare team. this is an exciting career opportunity for a pr professional with a passion for healthcare-related communications to work closely with fh senior management and assist global healthcare clients with their external public relations and communications activities.this role will lead global therapeutic area work for one of fh’s leading pharmaceutical clients in the neurology field and collaborate with other healthcare clients and brands as part of fh’s growing health and life sciences practice.this individual will face a broad array of challenges including reputation management, disease state education, advocacy relations, media relations, social media and digital integration, and marketing communications.the ideal candidate for this role will be a strategic thinker, ideator, and ultimately the “maker” that brings stories to life for our clients. you will help guide the day-to-day in key therapeutic areas and drive thought leadership to highlight this client’s expanding portfolio. you’re willing to dive into the content creation process as well as lead a team to successfully execute multi-stakeholder integrated campaigns.fleishmanhillard values the importance of impact and inclusion to strengthen the bonds between us, grow contact and manage workstreams and teams globally on program implementation aimed at reaching diverse stakeholders such as patients, medical professionals, advocacy organizations, policy makers, media, and client employeesplay a pivotal role in leading many of the day-to-day activities for the healthcare practice’s account teams, including working with senior members of the team to help communications. agency experience is a must and experience working in or with pharmaceutical companies is highly desired.demonstrated experience working directly with clients on day-to-day activities, communications, specifically product data milestones, regulatory approvals (u.s. and global) and ad comms, as well as branded and non-branded category awareness and disease awareness related to to detail with the ability to manage multiple ongoing activities.good interpersonal skills with the ability to negotiate approvals diplomatically and maintain composure and quality under deadlines in about spiralyzespiralyze is the largest a/b testing company in the united states. we run experiments on our clients’ websites to figure out what actually gets customers to buy. we use proprietary data, scraped from hundreds of thousands of tests across the web, to predict what will win for each client before a test even launches.our clients include well-known brands like crowdstrike, netflix, the nfl, podium, unbounce, okta, harvard, workday, and hundreds more. (see what they have to say on spiralyze.com/testimonials/)we’re a fast-growing company in a fast-growing industry. spiralyze has grown ~30% per year for the past 13 years. we’ve been on the inc. 5000 list of fastest-growing u.s. companies for 6 of the last 7 years. we promote almost entirely from within:75% of our leadership team started in entry-level roles85% of senior employees outside atlanta are remote if you’re smart, ambitious, and coachable, this is the one you’ve been looking for.the roledetailslocation: hybrid: midtown atlanta (in-office) + remoteexperience: 0-5 yearsworking schedule: 8 hours per dayvacation: 20 days + public holidayssalary: 50,000 - 80,000 usdhealthcare: yeswe’re building a founder-led media brand to establish spiralyze as the definitive authority in a/b testing and experimentation. this role is the engine that makes it happen.you’ll be the person who turns our proprietary data and the founder’s expertise into a steady stream of high-impact content across linkedin and youtube. you’ll own the editorial strategy, develop recurring content formats, write or ghostwrite posts, create video storyboards, and manage the creative team that produces everything.you’re a producer: part strategist, part writer, part editor-in-chief. you’ll work directly with the founder to extract insights and shape them into content that makes people stop scrolling.we have the most interesting dataset in our industry, a founder who can deliver on camera, and a production team ready to execute. we need the person who connects it all with a clear narrative and a relentless publishing cadence.core responsibilitieseditorial strategy & content planning. you’ll build and own the editorial calendar across linkedin and youtube. you’ll develop recurring series and formats (e.g., myth-busting posts, website teardowns, data-driven trend pieces) that compound over time. you’ll decide what gets published, when, and in what format, and you’ll make sure every piece reinforces our positioning as the data-backed authority in a/b testing.founder content extraction. you’ll run biweekly 60–90 minute sessions with the founder to capture insights, opinions, and stories from client work. your job is to turn that raw material into a week’s worth of linkedin posts, video scripts, and content briefs. the founder’s total time commitment should be under 10 hours per week. you’re the multiplier that makes that possible.writing & ghostwriting. you’ll write or direct the writing of 4–5 linkedin posts per week in the founder’s voice, plus scripts for 1–2 youtube videos. you know how to write hooks that stop the scroll, structure posts for engagement, and turn complex data into clear, compelling narratives. you’ll also develop a distinct written voice that feels authentic to the founder and consistent across every platform.creative team management. you’ll direct an in-house videographer, graphic designer, and overseas editors. you set the creative brief, review output, and ensure everything meets a premium quality bar. you’re not doing the production yourself; you’re the person who makes sure the production team has clear direction and the final product is sharp.performance & iteration. you’ll track what’s working and what’s not across every format and platform. you’ll use engagement data, follower growth, and pipeline attribution to double down on winning formats and kill underperformers. you’ll share performance reports and recommendations with leadership regularly.skills, knowledge and traitsexceptional writer. you think in hooks that stop people mid-scroll. you can take a complex a/b testing insight and make it accessible, surprising, and shareable.strategic thinker. you think not just of individual video ideas, but in terms of reusable content formats that we can apply multiple times to our content.data-comfortable. you don’t need to be a data scientist, but you should be comfortable working with math (rates, averages, etc.). our content is built on proprietary data, so you need to understand it well enough to tell stories with it.smart and high agency. you learn fast, take ownership, and don’t wait to be told what to do. when something isn’t working, you diagnose it and fix it. you’re the kind of person who brings solutions, not questions.what you'll getgrowth path. we invest heavily in developing our people and promote almost exclusively from within. success in this role leads to building and leading an entire content and brand team.in-demand skills. you’ll work alongside one of the most experienced experimentation teams in the world and learn how data, psychology, and creative intersect.time to recharge. 20 days of paid vacation plus holidays.if you’re excited about building a media brand around data, working directly with a founder, and turning proprietary insights into content that an entire industry pays attention to, we’d love to hear from you.

the director of media relations leads the atlantic council’s media outreach and communications strategy, and serves on the leadership of the broader engagement team. the director is responsible for bolstering the council’s media profile—advancing its mission by amplifying its expertise, events, and publications through earned us and international coverage. the director also coordinates external communications efforts and campaigns across the institution.the director reports to the atlantic council’s senior editorial director. the director works closely with the council’s digital, editorial, and event-production teams; executive office; and the atlantic council’s various programs and centers.this position is based at the council’s washington, dc headquarters. the director is expected in the office at least four days a week, and whenever the role requires.the atlantic council offers a competitive compensation package commensurate with experience and education, with offers from $140,000 to $180,000, and the position is bonus-eligible. applications submitted by november 1, 2026 will be prioritized for consideration.job responsibilitiesmedia relationsmanage the atlantic council’s media-relations operation, including full-time team members, partners, and vendors.build and manage relationships with reporters, producers, bookers, and editors at top-level us and international print, digital, and broadcast outlets.identify opportunities for and secure high-profile media coverage of atlantic council events and publications.lead rapid response to the media on breaking news developments worldwide, inserting the council’s expert views into the news cycle when they are most relevant.serve as the primary point of contact for crisis communications and rapid response.generate media partnerships that raise the visibility of council events and initiatives.coordinate efforts to secure media moderators and panelists.edit and place opinion columns in leading outlets.train staff on best practices for engaging with print, digital, and broadcast media.travel as needed to support the council’s global and flagship convenings.establish council experts as pre-eminent and visible sources of commentary and insight on international affairs.strategic communicationslead the atlantic council’s overall approach to external media as spokesperson, strategist, and advocate.help to build greater public awareness of the council, its influence, and the impact of its work, particularly in the press.develop a strategy to increase the atlantic council’s presence on non-traditional media platforms, including engagement with podcasts and digital media influencers.serve as a lead communications representative at the outset of major new atlantic council initiatives, defining a holistic communications framework including tactics and strategy.oversee long-term communications planning for the council’s programs and centers, working with each to define programmatic goals and a matching strategy.manage the council-wide communications calendar, including council and external global events, to raise the organization’s profile around key moments.develop the council’s paid media strategy in partnership with colleagues.lead and expand the council’s evolving portfolio of media partnerships.qualificationsrequiredbachelor’s degree in international affairs, communications, journalism, or a related field.7-10+ years of media relations, journalism, or strategic-communications experience, including at least three years managing staff.a robust network of active relationships with journalists at top-tier national and international outlets covering foreign policy, security, technology, and economics.experience designing and leading organization-wide communications plans and campaigns across multiple teams or programs.a track record of securing high-impact coverage, including broadcast bookings and op-ed placements.excellent writing and editing skills, with the ability to produce pitches, releases, and talking points on tight deadlines.working knowledge of international affairs and the washington policy landscape.proficiency with social media, digital marketing, and ai tools.proven judgment in crisis communications and in handling sensitive issues.ability to work outside standard hours when breaking news or other time-sensitive matters require it.preferredexperience at a major newsroom, government agency or congressional office, international organization, or policy institution.experience with media in europe, the middle east, asia, africa, or latin america.experience developing paid media strategies or managing media partnerships.proficiency in a second language.familiarity with media monitoring and database platforms such as cision, meltwater, or muck rack.how to applyto apply through the atlantic council careers page, submit a resume and cover letter. applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis, with those submitted by november 1, 2026, prioritized for consideration.to produce quality work and to successfully achieve our mission, we recognize the need for our staff to maintain a healthy lifestyle and a work/life balance. our comprehensive benefits package helps to keep costs low for our staff and their families. benefits include, but are not limited to comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance, paid time off, 403(b) plan, fsa options, pet insurance, public service loan forgiveness eligibility, and wellness benefits.

who we areinternational justice mission (ijm) is the global leader in protecting vulnerable people from violence around the world. our team of over 1,200 professionals are at work worldwide in over 30 offices. together we are on a mission to rescue millions, protect half a billion, and make justice unstoppable.we are a global community that cares for one another. we believe that the way we work is as important as the results we achieve. we provide professional excellence with joy and celebration to all those we serve. the needfor over 25 years, ijm has pioneered the work to protect vulnerable people from violence. 9 out of 9 times in the last decade, ijm’s justice system strengthening projects have reduced slavery and violence between 50 and 85% for very large populations of people in poverty. as we grow to expand our impact to protect 500 million people from violence, we are seeking a director, programmatic marketing enablement to establish and lead the capability through which ijm’s global marketing function advances programmatic outcomes. working at the intersection of marketing, program delivery, advocacy, and justice-system influence, this leader will help program teams use strategic communication to influence the audiences, decisions, behaviors, and social norms that matter to their objectives.this position is hybrid (onsite tuesdays & thursdays) if located in the washington, dc area or remote for non-local candidates and reports to the vice president, global insights and growth. this role requires current authorization to work in the united states. visa sponsorship is not available for this position, now or in the future.responsibilities:build the programmatic marketing capabilitydefine the strategy, scope, service model, and standards for how global marketing supports program-owned behavior-change and influence objectives; assess existing work across ijm and build on field and program expertise rather than duplicating or displacing it; establish a disciplined process for intake, sensitivity assessment, prioritization, staffing, roles/responsibilities framework, and delivery of programmatic marketing work; this should be in conjunction with global marketing’s existing operations model; translate program objectives into marketing & communications strategypartner with global program, advocacy, and field leaders early to determine where strategic marketing can advance program-defined outcomes; translate those outcomes into focused communication strategies that define the priority audience, the desired change, the communication approach, and how effectiveness will be measured; use research and local insight to understand what may motivate or prevent the intended audience from changing its knowledge, attitudes, decisions, or behavior; develop audience-centered strategies that support behavior change, community influence, or decision-maker engagement, depending on the program objective; lead integrated campaign deliverylead initial pilot campaigns from strategy through execution in partnership with global marketing capability experts; develop integrated channel plans that reach priority audiences through the most effective mix of mass, digital, community, interpersonal, and partner-led communication; engage trusted messengers such as journalists, faith leaders, and community leaders to strengthen the reach and credibility of priority efforts; manage visibility and narrative risk by monitoring public response, addressing harmful or unintended narratives, and ensuring all public-facing communication follows program direction and approved sensitivity levels; protect program integrity and safeguardingensure all work reflects local context, protects survivors and staff, and complies with ijm safeguarding, legal, security, consent, and brand requirements; apply program-defined sensitivity and visibility classifications so confidential or protected work is never unintentionally amplified; maintain clear review and approval pathways for factual accuracy, legal considerations, program strategy, calls to action, and safeguarding; build trusted, service-oriented partnerships across global marketing, global program, regional teams, and field offices; measure effectiveness and build learningdefine a measurement framework for programmatic marketing, including reach, comprehension, message uptake, sentiment, engagement, and appropriate behavioral or influence proxies; partner with program teams to connect communication indicators to program-owned outcome measures; establish baselines and learning plans for priority efforts and use evidence to improve audience strategy, messaging, creative, channels, and partner selection; build and scale the functionestablish the roadmap, priorities, investment, and team structure needed to prove and scale the capability; recruit/develop a high-performing team as the function grows, fostering a culture of rigor, humility, and service; bring current best practices in behavior change, advocacy communication, audience research, and measurement; contribute as a strategic and collaborative member of the global marketing leadership team; and participation in ijm’s community of spiritual formation. qualifications: bachelor’s degree in research/behavioral sciences/market research, communications, international development, public affairs, marketing, or a related field; master’s degree preferred; at least nine years of relevant experience in social and behavior change communication, advocacy or public-affairs communication, development communication, or a related discipline, including at least four years in a leadership role; demonstrated success designing and delivering behavior-change or influence communication that contributed to measurable, documented results; experience working in or alongside international, multicultural, and field-based program contexts, with strong judgment regarding safeguarding all relevant stakeholders; demonstrated ability to build a new capability, operating model, or cross-functional practice in a complex organization; deep expertise in social and behavior change communication and strong working knowledge of advocacy or public-affairs communication; expertise in formative research, audience segmentation, behavioral and social-norms approaches, message development, integrated campaign design, and communication measurement; ability to translate complex program objectives into focused audience and communication strategies and to guide high-quality creative execution; experience with media and social-listening approaches, narrative risk assessment, and rapid communication response; and excellent written, verbal, and presentation skills, with the ability to work effectively from field-level briefs through executive-level decisions. critical qualities:eager commitment to ijm's core values: christian, professional and bridge-building; self-starter with strong initiative;  disciplined with priorities; strong interpersonal skills and self-awareness; exceptional verbal and written communication; flexible, collaborative and eager to support others; effective team player who fosters collaborative environment; and adept at creative problem solving. mature christian faith as defined by the apostles’ creed; builder’s mindset, strategic judgment, and the ability to turn ambiguity into a clear and practical path forward; high emotional intelligence and cultural humility, with a demonstrated ability to earn trust across functions, geographies, and levels of seniority; strong ethic of service and deep commitment to ijm’s mission, safeguarding principles, and organizational values; results-oriented, self-directed, organized, and able to operate with significant independence while collaborating closely with others; and servant leadership that consistently places mission, survivors, program partners, and team outcomes above personal agenda. application process: upload resume, cover letter & statement of faith* in one pdf document.what is a statement of faith? a statement of faith should describe your christian faith and how you see it as relevant to your involvement with ijm. the statement can either be incorporated into the cover letter or submitted as a separate document and should include, at a minimum, a description of your spiritual disciplines (prayer, study, etc.) and your current fellowship or place of worship. what does ijm have to offer?comprehensive medical/dental/vision benefits monthly commuter and parking benefits in the dc metro area retirement benefit options paid leave starting at 23 days 12 holidays (plus early release the day prior) daily, quarterly, and annual community spiritual formation robust staff care resources ijm holds strict safeguarding principles and a zero tolerance to violations of the safeguarding policy, protection against sexual exploitation, abuse and harassment policy, and code of ethics. candidate selection is based on technical competence, recruitment, selection and hiring criteria subject to assessing the candidate’s value congruence and thorough background, police clearance, and reference check processes.at ijm, we’re committed to building a diverse workforce through fair and equitable employment practices. ijm encourages people of any race, color, age, sex, marital status or political ideology to apply for employment. while we welcome everyone into this work, we truly believe that the work we are doing is god’s work, not our own, and practice spiritual disciplines together daily. that’s why we legally require under sec. 2000e-1 [section702] of title vii of the civil rights act of 1964 that all employees practice a mature orthodox christian faith, as defined by the apostles’ creed.ijm requires a background check, police clearance and thorough review of references with an employment offer and/or employment contract.

grow healthyif you are as passionate about helping those in need as you are about growing your career, consider altamed. at altamed, your passion for helping others isn’t just welcomed – it’s nurtured, celebrated, and promoted, allowing you to grow while making a meaningful difference. we don’t just serve our communities; we are an integral part of them. by raising the expectations of what a community clinic can deliver, we demonstrate our belief that quality care is for everyone. our commitment to providing exceptional care, despite any challenges, goes beyond just a job; it’s a calling that drives us forward every day.job overviewunder the direction of the avp of civic engagement, the associate director of civic engagement will be responsible for implementing altamed’s civic engagement mission, guiding principles, and priorities to increase the footprint, visibility, amplification, and scalability of its integrated civic engagement model (icem). the associate director will work collaboratively with avp and department leadership to set the direction of altamed’s civic engagement strategy and goals. this position will be responsible for leading the civic engagement team to ensure that the strategy is implemented effectively and promptly, by providing guidance and leadership to the team. this position will also be responsible for developing, fostering, and sustaining strategic partnerships with internal departments, organizational leaders, key community stakeholders and cbos, funders, state and national partners, and thought leaders.the associate director will be responsible for the implementation of icem across all clinic sites, ensuring constant and consistent communication with medical and clinic leadership, developing a civic engagement curriculum for internal employee engagement, including providers, family medicine residents, nurses, and new hire orientations. this position will be responsible for ensuring that all grant-funded work is executed in time, effectively, and within budget. this also includes timely submission of monthly, quarterly, and annual reports to funders and for publication and dissemination amongst detail.desc: location: global - remote - we encourage applications from candidates from any location that are comfortable working occasionally during european hours.conditions - full time role - 5 days a week.the opportunitythis is a rare opportunity to build the public-influence infrastructure for one of the most important gaps in the climate and environmental movement: how to make care for the environment credible, visible and mainstream among conservative and traditional audiences globally.our common home (och) works through independent local organisations in around 19 countries. these partners engage people with a strong attachment to the land, traditions and communities – audiences who have often felt alienated by the tone and politics of mainstream climate advocacy. the role of the global director of strategic communications is to help credible local voices be heard, trusted and repeated in the places where public and political opinion is formed.the postholder will build och's central public-influence capability - known internally as media engagement - from the ground up. they will establish the standards, systems, methods and shared infrastructure that allow national teams to strengthen their own media and public-influence work. in the early phase, the role will be hands-on with priority countries. over time, the work will shift deliberately from delivery to coaching, with the capability embedded in the network rather than held at the centre.about ochoch increases support for protecting the environment by empowering those who are currently left out of the conversation. it works through independent local organisations in around 19 countries, supporting local actors to take environmental action rooted in more mainstream values and interests.it works by:developing better, longer-lasting solutions that reflect the priorities of ordinary people;creating the space for decision-makers from across the political spectrum to lead on environmental issues on their own terms; andbuilding confidence, capability and credibility in places where environmental action has too often been framed as belonging to one side of politics.och’s model depends on local credibility. country teams know their audiences, politics, language and media environments best. the central team exists to strengthen that work, not to direct it. a small global team sets the mission and supports country teams on strategy, research, governance and fundraising.why this role matters nowthe media and information environment is changing fast. trust is fragmenting, audiences are harder to reach through traditional channels, and ai is reshaping how information is produced, discovered, summarised and repeated. generic content is losing value. the premium is moving towards trusted voices, credible data, distinctive insight and rapid relevance.that shift plays to och's strengths, but only if the network is built for where media is heading rather than where it has been. the successful candidate will help och partners build the infrastructure to build up credible voices, develop them, connect them to the right media and platforms, and ensure their stories and evidence travel across the network.purpose of the rolethe global director of strategic communications will build and lead och's central strategic communications and public-influence function. the role will define what good media engagement work looks like across the network, support countries to develop their own capacity, and create shared systems that allow learning, intelligence and media opportunities to travel quickly.the consistent priority is to amplify partners and credible local voices rather than to raise och's own profile. the postholder will have the authority, licence and resources to build the infrastructure needed to do that well.the role works across three levelspartner and spokesperson amplification. elevating credible conservative and centre-right voices already rooted in communities through the network's partners and ground game, led by local people and local stories.country entity communications. helping national entities develop their own public presence, earned-media capacity, spokesperson base and public-influence strategy, without taking ownership of their political positioning.och central communications. developing the strategy for och's own public profile where it is useful to the mission, while keeping the primary emphasis on the network and local voices.what success looks likeafter the first year, success would mean that och has a clear media engagement strategy, a small but effective central capability, shared standards and methods, a tested spokesperson-development process, priority-country plans, and a growing rapid-response model.after three years, success would mean that country teams have the tools, confidence, relationships and judgement to lead their own public-influence work; credible conservative and centre-right environmental voices are more visible in national debates across priority countries; and the centre has moved from doing the work to advising, coaching and strengthening it.key responsibilitiesbuild och's central strategic communications and public-influence capability, including shaping the team, external support and operating model required for the build phase.define what good media engagement work looks like across the network: the shared language, standards, frameworks and practical tools that country teams can adapt to their contexts.work directly with country teams in the early phase to develop their strategies, then move progressively into a coaching and advisory role as country capacity grows.develop a network-wide spokesperson methodology: how country teams identify, prepare, support and sustain credible voices over time.build a rapid-response capability so credible local voices can become part of relevant breaking stories in a timely way.create shared infrastructure for narrative testing, media monitoring, intelligence gathering and cross-network learning, so that good practice travels quickly.position och's voices, stories and data for an ai-shaped media environment, including how information is found, summarised, trusted and reused.help country teams map and build relationships with the outlets, validators, think tanks, creators and platforms that reach their audiences.lead on developing crisis response protocolsmanage a budget focused mainly on developing capacity and skills across the networkplan the handover from the start: define the milestones at which central support reduces, what country teams need to demonstrate before taking fuller ownership, and how the function moves to a lighter-touch model.the wider ambitionbeyond the foundational systems, this role carries a larger strategic opportunity. och is well placed to build much needed new public-influence infrastructure. that could include a global or regional network of conservative environmental spokespeople, country-level mapping of the outlets and validators that shape non-progressive audiences, new media partnerships, or even the creation of platforms and formats that engage these audiences seriously. not all of these ideas will prove viable. the postholder will have room to test these ideas, the judgement to decide which are worth pursuing, and the discipline to stop the ones that are not working.what sits with country teamsoch's ethos is rooted in the belief that those closest to the work are best placed to devise and deliver the strategy. the global director of strategic communications will not own national political positioning, decisions about who speaks publicly in each country, campaign priorities and timing, national media relationships, or the specific language of media engagement work in each context.the credibility of the work depends on it being and feeling genuinely local. the role requires authority without directiveness: the ability to set standards, challenge constructively and build capability while leaving ownership where it belongs.person specificationessentialsenior strategic communications judgement. the ability to see how media, politics, audiences, narratives and organisational strategy connect.media-operator credibility. recent, hands-on experience of placing stories, developing spokespeople, managing narratives and working with journalists, editors, creators or platforms at pace.builder instinct. the appetite and ability to create infrastructure from scratch, without an established playbook.coaching orientation. a genuine commitment to developing others' capability rather than defaulting to doing the work personally.political fluency. strong understanding of centre-right and conservative landscapes, and the credibility to engage the validators and spokespeople the network needs to reach.network orchestration. the ability to work across many country contexts, with the cultural judgement to adapt without losing coherence.ai and media change. current, practical interest in how ai is reshaping the way information is produced, found and trusted, and what that means for strategic communications.temperament. the ability to bring authority and judgement, but not ego. able to set clear standards, challenge when needed, and still let country teams own their work.professional proficiency in english (cefr c2 or equivalent).desirableexperience of building, spinning out or scaling a new entity, function or practice.experience of multi-country civil-society networks, international ngos or politically diverse coalitions.experience in climate, environment, energy, land, rural affairs or adjacent public-policy debates.experience working with philanthropic funders, boards or senior political stakeholders.what this role is notthis is not a conventional head of communications role. it is not a content-production function, not a press office, not a brand role for och, and not a command-and-control role directing what country teams say.candidates whose strength lies mainly in running an established communications operation may find the role frustrating. the about primordial labswe're building the next generation interface for commanding autonomous systems in the real world. our core product, anura, translates spoken or typed intent into structured actions across drones, sensors, and mission software—enabling faster, more intuitive control in high-stakes environments. we’re a distributed team of engineers, operators, and technologists focused on deploying reliable autonomy at the tactical edge.the opportunityas the communications manager at primordial labs, you will be the primary architect of our public narrative, ensuring the world understands our technology and the value it brings to our customers. you will work at the intersection of deep tech and national security, turning complex ai products like anura, into compelling messaging for the media, stakeholders, and the warfighter.the role shapes the product narrative, builds relationships with defense, national security, and tech journalists, prepares leadership for interviews and speaking engagements, and supports government affairs, including engaging with hill staff, think tanks, and our ga firms. you’ll work closely with the marketing director to keep messaging consistent across every channel. joining our fully remote team means you’ll have the autonomy to drive high-impact pr strategies while working alongside world-class engineers and former special operators to safeguard national security.what you'll dostrategic storytelling: owning the end to end narrative for our product, helping to craft everything from high-level op-eds to punchy product launch announcements.media relations: building and maintaining deep relationships with top-tier defense trade, national security, and tech journalists to secure high value media placements.executive visibility: preparing our leadership team for interviews, speaking engagements, and industry demos, ensuring our "voice" is consistent and authoritative.policy and government affairs support: shape positioning with hill staff, our lobbying firms, think tanks, and the policy communityintegrated campaigns: collaborating with our marketing, growth, and engineering teams to launch multi-channel campaigns that highlight our mission impact at major events like sof week or ausa.internal & brand comms: keep a growing team aligned on company messaging, news, and external comms policies.about youproven experience: 5+ years in strategic communications, pr, or journalism, specifically within the defense, aerospace, or deep tech sectors.technical translation: ability to take "engineer-speak" and turn it into clear, mission-focused content for non-technical audiences.exceptional writing: mastery of ap style and a track record of crafting tight, memorable narratives under tight deadlines.media savvy: demonstrated success in pitching stories and managing complex media inquiries in a highly regulated industry.preferred qualificationssecurity clearance: an active secret (or higher) security clearance is a major plus.military familiarity: experience working as (or with) a military public affairs officer (pao) or a deep understanding of dod structure.startup agility: experience in a fast-paced "build-fast" environment where you are comfortable being a team of one for all things comms.visual storytelling: basic proficiency in tools like figma, canva, or adobe creative suite to help visualize our tech for social media.important qualification note: due to the nature of our work and federal compliance requirements, this position strictly requires u.s. citizenship and current residency within the united states. please note that permanent residency (green card status) or visa sponsorship cannot satisfy these specific regulatory requirements.compensationcompensation for this position includes a target base salary of $130,000 - $160,000 annually, with the specific figure determined by the candidate's experience level.we’re committed to fair and equitable compensation and are happy to explain how we determine our salary ranges, just ask!our benefitsbeyond a competitive salary, we provide a significant equity stake, aligning your growth with ours.100% remote: this role is fully remote, open to residents across the us. we believe that talent knows no borders (well, except for the us in this case!).comprehensive health coverage: we provide comprehensive medical, dental, and vision plans so you and your family can stay healthy and worry free.retirement planning: plan for tomorrow with our 401(k) package, complete with a generous 6% company match.generous dto: our generous discretionary time off (dto) policy is all about helping you take the breaks you deserve and live your healthiest, most fulfilling life.elite technology package: enjoy an elite technology package to make your work effortless and efficient.our interview processour interview process is designed to be thorough and respectful of your time. it typically includes:conversation with the people team: lets get to know one another first!interview: a 45-minute discussion about relevant communications concepts and your past experience.portfolio overview: this session is designed for us to dive into your real-world work, your storytelling approach, and how you translate complex technology into compelling narratives. you’ll walk us through 2–3 case studies or pieces from your past experience that highlight your strategic thinking, messaging skills, and execution across media relations, executive communications, or product announcements.team interviews: collaboration is at the heart of what we do. during this stage, you’ll meet your prospective peers to discuss our team dynamics, project workflows, and how we work together to win.we are committed to a low-stress interview experience—no trick questions or brain teasers!primordial labs is an equal opportunity employer, committed to creating a welcoming and respectful environment for everyone. discrimination and harassment have no place here. we firmly believe that a diverse team enriches our problem-solving capabilities, sparks greater creativity, and ultimately leads to a better product and a more vibrant company.we understand that great talent comes from various paths and that passion and transferable skills are invaluable. at primordial labs, what truly matters is your ability to make an impact, your dedication to our mission, and your capacity to thrive in a fast-paced, collaborative atmosphere. we are dedicated to fostering an inclusive workplace where you can contribute your unique talents, expand your skills, and learn continuously. if you’re driven to make a real impact, we encourage you to apply, even if your experience doesn’t perfectly align with every qualification.

with merchants and delivery partners to make familiar flavors more accessible and support local businesses.熊猫外卖成立于2017年，总部位于伦敦，致力于通过外卖平台连接海外社区与地道的中餐及亚洲美食。我们与商家和配送伙伴合作，让熟悉的味道触手可及，并支持本地商家的发展。our value 我们的价值理念satisfy your chinese taste. we bring people closer to the food they love and the communities they call home.满足你的中国胃。以美食连接用户与社区，传递熟悉的味道与归属感。our mission 我们的使命connect merchants and consumers through technology and delivery services, creating opportunities across the overseas chinese food ecosystem.通过科技与配送服务连接商家和消费者，为海外中餐生态创造更多发展机会。our people 我们的团队we are food lovers who value initiative, looking for an experienced, hands-on public relations manager to strengthen u.s. government and stakeholder relationships and protect hungrypanda’s reputation across media, social platforms and online communities. you will independently lead sensitive issue responses, advise leadership and personally execute communications across english- and chinese-language channels. this role combines government relations, crisis communications, media relations and proactive reputation building, with clear ownership from early risk assessment through resolution.我们正在寻找一位经验成熟、执行力强的公关经理，负责维护美国政府及重要利益相关方关系，并在新闻媒体、社交平台及网络社区中维护熊猫外卖的企业声誉。你将独立主导敏感事件应对，为管理层提供判断建议，并亲自执行中英文对外沟通。岗位涵盖政府关系、危机公关、媒体关系和主动声誉建设，要求从风险发现到事件闭环全程负责。main duties and responsibilities organizations. track policy and public affairs issues affecting delivery platforms and prepare briefings, meetings and responses with leadership and legal.政府关系与公共事务：建立并维护与美国相关政府部门、监管机构、行业协会、商会及社区组织的可信关系；跟踪影响外卖平台的政策与公共事务议题，与管理层及法务协同准备沟通材料、组织会面并回应问询。crisis communications and issues management: independently lead responses to negative coverage, drive execution, escalation and follow-up.危机公关与敏感议题管理：独立主导负面报道、争议指控、投诉扩散、服务或安全事件及其他声誉风险的应对；核实事实、判断风险等级、确定回应时机与渠道、制定行动方案，并亲自推动执行、升级汇报和后续跟进。cross-platform social listening and online reputation: own monitoring and response coordination across major english- and chinese-language channels, including instagram, tiktok, facebook, x, youtube, linkedin, reddit, xiaohongshu / red, wechat, weibo and douyin, as relevant to u.s. audiences. include community forums, google and yelp reviews, app store ratings and digital news. map cross-platform spread, identify influential voices and prioritize risks by credibility, reach and business impact.全平台舆情监测与网络声誉：负责主要中英文渠道的监测与回应协调，包括instagram、tiktok、facebook、x、youtube、linkedin、reddit、小红书、微信、微博及抖音，并根据美国市场受众确定优先级；同时覆盖社区论坛、google与yelp评论、应用商店评价和网络新闻。分析跨平台传播路径、识别关键影响者，并依据内容可信度、传播范围及业务影响判断风险。hands-on response and bilingual writing: personally draft statements, press materials, media q&as, executive talking points, social responses and stakeholder updates in english and chinese. adapt messaging to outreach and official communications with customer service and legal.亲自执行与双语写作：独立撰写中英文声明、新闻材料、媒体问答、管理层发言要点、社媒回应及外部沟通更新。根据不同平台调整表达，确保事实与核心口径一致；回应合理诉求，以证据澄清不实信息，并协调对违规内容的申诉。与客服及法务统一公开评论、直接沟通和官方回应。media response effectiveness. brief leadership on emerging risks and document lessons and corrective actions after corporate communications, public affairs or crisis communications, including substantial hands-on ownership of sensitive issues. strong individual contributors and agency professionals with end-to-end client responsibility are welcome.5年以上公关、企业传播、公共事务或危机沟通相关经验，并具有独立处理敏感事件的实战经历；欢迎资深执行型人才，以及曾全流程负责客户项目的公关机构候选人。demonstrated ability to independently manage a significant reputational incident. be ready advanced cancer research and treatment organizations in the u.s., and one of the leading research centers for diabetes and other life-threatening illnesses. city of hope research has been the basis for numerous breakthrough cancer medicines, as well as human synthetic insulin and monoclonal antibodies. with an independent, national cancer institute-designated comprehensive cancer center that is ranked among the top in the nation for cancer care by u.s. news & world report at its core, city of hope’s uniquely integrated model spans cancer care, research and development, academics and training, and a broad philanthropy program that powers its work. city of hope’s growing national system includes its los angeles campus, a network of clinical care locations across southern california, a new cancer center in orange county, california, and cancer treatment centers and outpatient facilities in the atlanta, chicago and phoenix areas.the successful candidate:reporting to the engagement, and community presence.this leader owns the monthly pr plan end to end, bringing together all tactics into a clear, actionable plan and ensuring it is executed in market through internal follow through.this leader ensures that the city of hope voice and brand are consistently reflected across all communications while actively contributing to execution. they work closely with their team and agency partners to develop and deliver content, move work forward, and ensure quality and consistency across channels. this includes close partnership with system teams, business development, brand, and social.the director also leads internal communications tied to pr efforts, ensuring clinical and non-clinical teams are informed, aligned, and clear on priorities and their role in execution. the role includes regular reporting on progress and performance, and requires a visible, hands-on presence in market, supporting press conferences, activations, and community events that elevate the brand.the ideal candidate is highly organized, collaborative, and action oriented, able to connect strategy to execution in a fast-moving environment.position qualifications:minimum education: bachelor’s degree in journalism or related field or 3 additional years of experience plus the minimum experience requirement may substitute for minimum education.minimum experience: 10 years of relevant work experience in marketing and communications and 3 years of management experience, including at least 3 years in healthcare marketing communications and proven experience in
