我们的价值理念satisfy your chinese taste. we bring people closer to the food they love and the communities they call home.满足你的中国胃。以美食连接用户与社区，传递熟悉的味道与归属感。our mission 我们的使命connect merchants and consumers through technology and delivery services, creating opportunities across the overseas chinese food ecosystem.通过科技与配送服务连接商家和消费者，为海外中餐生态创造更多发展机会。our people 我们的团队we are food lovers who value initiative, collaboration and practical results. we welcome people who take ownership, communicate openly and turn ideas into action.我们热爱美食，重视主动担当、团队协作和实际成果，欢迎愿意开放沟通、承担责任并推动想法落地的伙伴。about the role 岗位介绍we are looking for an experienced, hands-on public relations manager to strengthen u.s. government and stakeholder relationships and protect hungrypanda’s reputation across media, social platforms and online communities. you will independently lead sensitive issue responses, advise leadership and personally execute communications across english- and chinese-language channels. this role combines government relations, crisis communications, media relations and proactive reputation building, with clear ownership from early risk assessment through resolution.我们正在寻找一位经验成熟、执行力强的公关经理，负责维护美国政府及重要利益相关方关系，并在新闻媒体、社交平台及网络社区中维护熊猫外卖的企业声誉。你将独立主导敏感事件应对，为管理层提供判断建议，并亲自执行中英文对外沟通。岗位涵盖政府关系、危机公关、媒体关系和主动声誉建设，要求从风险发现到事件闭环全程负责。main duties and responsibilities 主要工作职责government relations and public affairs: build and maintain credible relationships with relevant u.s. government offices, regulators, industry associations, chambers of commerce and community organizations. track policy and public affairs issues affecting delivery platforms and prepare briefings, meetings and responses with leadership and legal.政府关系与公共事务：建立并维护与美国相关政府部门、监管机构、行业协会、商会及社区组织的可信关系；跟踪影响外卖平台的政策与公共事务议题，与管理层及法务协同准备沟通材料、组织会面并回应问询。crisis communications and issues management: independently lead responses to negative coverage, allegations, viral complaints, service or safety incidents and other reputational risks. verify facts, assess severity, recommend response timing and channels, prepare action plans and personally drive execution, escalation and follow-up.危机公关与敏感议题管理：独立主导负面报道、争议指控、投诉扩散、服务或安全事件及其他声誉风险的应对；核实事实、判断风险等级、确定回应时机与渠道、制定行动方案，并亲自推动执行、升级汇报和后续跟进。cross-platform social listening and online reputation: own monitoring and response coordination across major english- and chinese-language channels, including instagram, tiktok, facebook, x, youtube, linkedin, reddit, xiaohongshu / red, wechat, weibo and douyin, as relevant to u.s. audiences. include community forums, google and yelp reviews, app store ratings and digital news. map cross-platform spread, identify influential voices and prioritize risks by credibility, reach and business impact.全平台舆情监测与网络声誉：负责主要中英文渠道的监测与回应协调，包括instagram、tiktok、facebook、x、youtube、linkedin、reddit、小红书、微信、微博及抖音，并根据美国市场受众确定优先级；同时覆盖社区论坛、google与yelp评论、应用商店评价和网络新闻。分析跨平台传播路径、识别关键影响者，并依据内容可信度、传播范围及业务影响判断风险。hands-on response and bilingual writing: personally draft statements, press materials, media q&as, executive talking points, social responses and stakeholder updates in english and chinese. adapt messaging to each platform while maintaining factual consistency; address legitimate concerns, correct misinformation with evidence and coordinate reports of policy-violating content. align public comments, direct outreach and official communications with customer service and legal.亲自执行与双语写作：独立撰写中英文声明、新闻材料、媒体问答、管理层发言要点、社媒回应及外部沟通更新。根据不同平台调整表达，确保事实与核心口径一致；回应合理诉求，以证据澄清不实信息，并协调对违规内容的申诉。与客服及法务统一公开评论、直接沟通和官方回应。media and deadlines, and ensure follow-through until the issue is resolved.跨部门事件协调：牵头与法务、运营、客服、市场及管理层的公关协作，调查问题、统一口径并推动改进措施；按需协调外部机构与顾问，明确责任人和时间节点，持续跟进直至事件解决。preparedness, analysis and measurement: establish monitoring alerts, escalation procedures, crisis playbooks and platform-specific response guidelines. use social listening and media data to assess sentiment, spread, message accuracy and response effectiveness. brief leadership on emerging risks and document lessons and corrective actions after incidents.危机准备、分析与效果评估：建立监测预警、升级机制、危机预案及各平台回应指引；通过舆情与媒体数据评估情绪变化、传播情况、信息准确性及回应效果；向管理层汇报新出现的风险，并在事件后复盘经验与改进措施。qualifications and requirements 任职要求5+ years of relevant experience in public relations, corporate communications, public affairs or crisis communications, including substantial hands-on ownership of sensitive issues. strong individual contributors and agency professionals with end-to-end client responsibility are welcome.5年以上公关、企业传播、公共事务或危机沟通相关经验，并具有独立处理敏感事件的实战经历；欢迎资深执行型人才，以及曾全流程负责客户项目的公关机构候选人。demonstrated ability to independently manage a significant reputational incident. be ready to discuss your decisions, personal contribution and outcomes using non-confidential examples.能够证明自己独立主导过重要声誉事件；面试时可通过不涉及保密信息的案例，说明判断过程、本人承担的工作及处理结果。practical u.s. government relations experience and established, relevant stakeholder relationships. understand how to engage government offices and regulators professionally and work effectively with legal.具备美国政府关系实操经验及与业务相关的外部关系基础，熟悉政府部门和监管机构的沟通方式，能够与法务有效配合。professional fluency in both english and mandarin is required, including excellent english writing and the ability to draft and review simplified chinese crisis communications.英语及普通话必须达到专业工作水平；英文写作能力优秀，能够独立撰写和审核简体中文危机沟通内容。demonstrated experience managing reputational issues across multiple social platforms and digital communities. understand english- and chinese-language audience behavior, platform dynamics, creator influence and how a story spreads between social media, reviews and news coverage.具备跨社交平台及网络社区处理声誉事件的实战经验，了解中英文受众行为、不同平台的传播机制、内容创作者的影响，以及事件在社媒、评论网站和新闻媒体之间扩散的路径。strong news judgment, discretion and evidence-based decision-making. able to prioritize quickly, write clearly under pressure and personally drive execution across teams.具备敏锐的新闻判断力、保密意识和基于证据的决策能力，能够在压力下迅速确定优先级、清晰表达并亲自推动跨团队执行。available for time-sensitive incident response outside regular business hours when necessary, and occasional travel for stakeholder meetings.能够在必要时于非工作时间响应紧急事件，并接受因外部沟通需要安排的偶尔出差。preferred experience 优先考虑experience in delivery platforms, marketplaces, consumer technology, food and cross-border communications, crisis-focused pr agencies or social listening platforms such as meltwater, brandwatch, talkwalker or equivalent tools.拥有纽约或华盛顿特区相关政府及媒体资源；具备跨境传播、危机公关机构经验，或使用meltwater、brandwatch、talkwalker等舆情工具的经验。why join hungrypanda 为什么加入熊猫外卖take ownership of work that directly shapes public trust, stakeholder relationships execution.你的工作将直接影响公众信任、外部关系与业务稳定。你将面向美国及中文受众，在兼顾策略判断与亲自执行的岗位中发挥专业能力。

job descriptionkraft heinz is home to some of the world's most iconic brands — and this role puts you at the center of elevating creative across 70+ north american brands. as a direct creative partner to brand teams across the portfolio, you'll help shape the work that millions of consumers experience every day, at a company that has staked its reputation on pushing creative boundaries and raising the bar for what great looks like.champion creative effectiveness (15%)drive visibility, adoption, and cultural momentum for kraft heinz’s ace (accelerating creative effectiveness) program in north america.partner with the global capabilities team to shape, influence and adapt global creative frameworks to meet north america’s unique needs.advance creative effectiveness through tools, routines, inspiration, shared standards and governance, making it an expected outcome of how we work.upskilling brand teams through l&d, guidelines & frameworksembedded creative and comms support for bu brand teams (70%)establish, own and continuously refine a new embedded support model for bu brand teams, shaping how it's rolled out and embedded across the organization to scale creative effectiveness detail.desc: about cressetcresset is a firm built by clients, for clients. as an independent, award-winning multi-family office and private investment firm, we are reimagining the way wealth is experienced. our purpose is to help ensure that both wealth and life are fully optimized—integrated, intentional, and aligned with each client’s vision of success.we provide access to the caliber of talent, ideas, and investment opportunities typically available to the largest single-family offices and institutions. our approach is personalized, entrepreneurial, and client-first.proudly owned by our clients and employees, cresset was built to endure. we are creating a 100+ year firm—one focused on delivering an exceptional experience, not only for the families we serve but for the team that serves them. recognized by barron’s and forbes among the nation’s top ria firms, and as one of the industry’s best places to work,* cresset is guided by long-term relationships, shared success, and a belief that wealth should serve a life well lived.job descriptionreporting to the director of growth marketing, the associate director, organic content & growth (seo & geo/aeo) will help execute and scale cresset's organic growth initiatives across seo, geo/aeo, content marketing, and ai-powered discovery channels. this role is responsible for creating and optimizing content that drives qualified leads, increases brand visibility, and supports long-term organic growth.this is a hands-on role for a content marketer with strong seo and ai discoverability expertise. the ideal candidate will manage content production workflows, develop and optimize high-performing content, and contribute directly to writing and editing. working closely with the growth marketing team, external seo consultants, and internal subject matter experts, this individual will translate strategic priorities into compelling content and measurable business outcomes.the successful candidate will have a performance marketing mindset, using content and organic discoverability as levers to increase visibility, engagement, and lead generation across search engines, ai-driven discovery platforms, digital channels, and paid campaigns. they will help expand cresset's digital footprint and authority signals to support both seo and geo/aeo performance.key responsibilitiescontent, discoverability & brand authoritypersonally write, edit, optimize, and refresh high-quality content, including thought leadership, educational articles, website content, landing pages, and other digital assets.develop and manage seo-driven content plans, editorial calendars, and content workflows that support organic growth and lead generation objectives.conduct keyword, search intent, competitive, and content gap research and translate insights into content briefs and finished content.partner directly with internal subject matter experts to turn complex financial topics and ideas into clear, engaging, authoritative content.partner with external seo consultants to identify opportunities, develop content briefs, and execute content initiatives.identify and execute opportunities to increase off-site visibility and authority through third-party profile optimization, industry rankings, guest articles, interviews, publisher placements, citations, and brand mentions.organic growth & search optimizationcollaborate with the head of growth marketing and external partners on seo and geo/aeo strategy while taking direct ownership of execution.apply seo best practices across content, including keyword strategy, search intent, content structure, internal linking, metadata, and other on-page optimization opportunities.optimize content for discoverability across traditional search about the role:the john s. and james l. knight foundation is seeking an exceptional writer with strong editorial judgment and project management skills to join our communications team and help shape how the foundation is understood in the press and public discourse. as communications officer, you will partner with the director of communications to support the delivery of clear, timely and consequential communications across the foundation’s work, and amplify the voice of one of the nation’s leading champions of the first amendment, a free press and democracy.this is a hands-on role for a thoughtful, highly organized professional who can move between strategy and execution. you will work across knight’s grantmaking portfolio in journalism, research, the arts and community impact to identify stories and translate complex ideas, research findings, grantmaking and convenings into compelling materials for journalists, partners and the public.knight holds itself to high editorial standards and journalistic integrity. this role carries that into how we talk about our mission to ignite in every person the power to shape thriving communities.you will work closely with knight’s director of communications, within the communications function led by our vice president of communications and digital strategy. the role sits in our miami headquarters.you are an ideal candidate if:you understand the essential role of the first amendment in a democracy. you have strong command of ap style, experience in communications, media relations or journalism and a deep understanding of the media landscape and the narratives shaping public conversation and civic discourse today. you’re organized, respect deadlines, have or are willing to build relationships with reporters and influencers, and have experience managing vendors and editing writers. you own your areas of responsibility, work with growing independence, spot risks early and know when to escalate. you keep pace when priorities shift, and you do your best work on a small team.key responsibilities:media relations: support the director of communications in building and maintaining working relationships with journalists, editors, thought leaders, influencers and outlets. pitch stories, field inquiries, coordinate staff interviews and help secure accurate, timely coverage of knight’s work.writing and message development: draft press releases, statements, op-eds, talking points and briefing memos that hold to the foundation’s external narrative and voice. keep internal message houses, data repositories and grantmaking dollar amounts up to date.leadership and spokesperson support: prepare materials to equip leadership and program staff for media interviews, public appearances and high-stakes conversations, including background research, q&a and briefing materials.monitoring and insight: track media coverage and perceptions of the foundation to inform how to position knight’s work in public conversation, backed by performance data.vendors and project management: work with external communications vendors across public relations, speechwriting and event production. edit and manage freelance writers for knight’s owned editorial content.convenings: support program development, talking-points, event communications, including invitations and relationships with peer funders, grantees, high-profile guests and the press before, during and after events. partner with the convenings project manager, who leads logistics and execution, and with the marketing and creative team on brand and creative. expect hands-on support onsite, with occasional evenings, weekends and travel.cross-functional partnership: keep communications, marketing, convenings and program teams in step so media, campaign and field engagement line up.things we look for in a successful candidate:experience in media relations, communications or journalism, with a track record of owning defined areas of work with increasing independence.exceptional writing and editing on deadline, with command of ap style.strong news judgment and demonstrated media relations results or reported work: pitches placed, reporter relationships built and coverage earned.sound judgment and discretion with sensitive, embargoed or high-profile information and the instinct to escalate issues appropriately.comfort supporting live events, including preproduction and hands-on execution on site.commitment to knight’s mission and interest in free expression, thriving communities and our focus areas: information ecosystems, economic mobility and cultural vibrancy.preferred but not required:journalism experience, or non-profit communications experience.familiarity with media monitoring and coverage analysis tools.proficiency with a leading content management system (e.g., wordpress) and email marketing platforms such as mailchimp and rsvpify.experience with project management tools such as monday, asana and airtable.adobe creative suite skills.experience with or openness to using artificial intelligence to streamline processes and increase efficiency.interested candidates should submit a brief portfolio (pdf or website link) of their work and a resume to recruiter@kf.org.about knight foundationwe ignite in every person the power to shape thriving communities.john s. and james l. knight believed that a well-informed community could best “determine its own true interests” and was essential to a well-functioning, thriving democracy. for 75 years, knight foundation has continued their work by supporting people, organizations and insights that lead to healthier communities.the foundation invests in journalism, arts and culture, research and field-building efforts that promote a more resilient information ecosystem, deepen shared understanding and advance a culture of free expression and community development in the 26 cities where the knight brothers once published newspapers. since our founding in 1950, we have been committed to the communities we serve and to providing those communities with the tools they need for residents to thrive.we believe in freedom of expression and in the values expressed in the first amendment to the u.s. constitution. we believe an informed citizenry is essential for representative democracy to function effectively. we believe in engaged, equitable and inclusive communities. we believe in the power of diverse perspectives to foster positive change and build stronger, more equitable communities.our drive to create positive change is amplified by our ability to collaborate internally and with our partners. we look for authenticity, agility and accountability, knowing we are at our best when we leverage our collective strengths and experiences. we proactively approach our work with a sense of pride and responsibility, adapting as needed to the changing realities in our communities.knight foundation offers competitive pay and a generous benefits package and is an equal opportunity employer. the hiring salary range for this role starts at $80,000. actual compensation is based on a number of factors including qualifications, skills and relevant experience.this is an in-office position located in miami.this posting outlines the general nature of the role and is not an exhaustive list of responsibilities; duties may change based on organizational needs. the role requires the ability to perform standard office activities. reasonable accommodation will be provided as required by law.

this role can be office-based in freiburg (germany) / san francisco (usa) or remote-first, with a requirement to be in one of the offices one full week per month.about black forest labswe’re the team building the foundational layer for visual intelligence: multimodal models trained jointly on images, video, audio, and action to see, generate, and understand the world.our founding team pioneered latent diffusion and stable diffusion, the breakthroughs that made generative ai accessible to millions. with flux, we're pushing into generative media at scale, machines that act in the physical world, and emerging applications in computer use.our flux models top public benchmarks and run in production in some of the world's biggest platforms. we're a small, fast growing research lab competing with the largest companies in the world. from our labs in freiburg to san francisco, we're building what comes next.why this roleblack forest labs builds visual intelligence: models that create and understand images and video, and increasingly act in the physical world. for a company whose work is visual, the brand is part of the work. it's often the first thing people see of us, before they've tried a single model. it has to hold the same bar as our models and grow as they do.we're hiring our first brand & marketing design lead to define that brand and own it wherever people meet bfl. you'll bring the taste that sets the standard for how bfl looks, and build what keeps it consistent across launches, the website, events and everything in between.this is a hands-on lead role. you'll ship much of the work yourself while setting up the tools and processes that let others ship at your level. over time, you'll also shape how brand and marketing design grows at bfl, including who we hire next.what you'll work onlead how our visual identity grows, including logo, type, color, imagery and motion, and turn it into guidelines and design systems others can work from. create the concept and creative direction for each model launch, campaign and event, working with research to show what every new model can do. make the work people see every day, online and offline: social posts, editorial, decks, docs, sales material, event spaces, merchandise and print. own the direction of bfl.ai and our growth pages, and help make the website one of the clearest and strongest expressions of the brand. build templates, internal tools and an agent-readable design system so marketing, sales and engineering can create on-brand work themselves. we'd rather you build the generator than draw the hundredth asset. work with product design on shared foundations like type, color and components, so bfl.ai, the playground, the dashboard, and other product surfaces feel like one company. your teamdesign at bfl is young, and much of how it works is still open, including how we review work, what we call finished and how design informs decisions across teams. you'll help define these and represent design across the company.you'll work closely with devran, who leads design at bfl, and with teams across the company, including marketing, growth, developer relations, research and product design. among the people you'll work with most are owais and aitana in marketing and jay in growth engineering.what we're looking forat least six years designing brands, and one or two projects you'd still stand behind today, where you played a key role from concept through rollout and others now build on the work. we're looking for an original idea, clear taste and execution that holds up in every detail. deep craft in identity and visual design, from typography and color to layout, art direction and motion. you notice the crop, the spacing and the timing of a transition, and you fix them before anyone asks. a quality bar that raises the work around you. you've made a team better before, through the work you shipped and the feedback you gave. you're ready to ship from day one. you've started work no one asked for, seen it through, and sorted out disagreements directly with the people involved. a systems thinker. you've built guidelines, templates or design systems that others used well without you in the room, and you can tell when work should scale and when it should stay one of a kind. you move easily between the big picture and the details. you can make the case for a design decision to a founder, an engineer and a marketer, and you change how you make it for each of them. you're comfortable with ambiguity. one week might take you from a model launch to merch to a new page on bfl.ai. much here isn't figured out yet, and you see that as an opportunity. curiosity about new tools, new problems and getting better at your craft. you can point to something you taught yourself recently and how it changed your work. nice to have:shipping web pages or prototypes yourself with ai coding tools such as claude code. building your own tools for brand work, such as template generators or small internal apps. using generative image or video models in your creative process. motion, 3d or creative coding. experience at an ai lab. how we work togetherwe're a distributed team with real offices that people actually use. depending on your location, you'll either join us in freiburg or sf at least 2 days a week (or one full week every other week), or work remotely with a monthly in-person week to stay connected. we'll cover reasonable travel costs to make this possible. we think in-person time matters, and we've structured things to make it accessible to all. we'll discuss what this will look like for the role during our interview process.everything we do is grounded in four values:obsessed. we are a frontier research lab. the science has to be right, the understanding deep, the product beautiful. low ego. the work speaks. the best idea wins, no matter who said it. credit is shared. nobody is above any task. bold. we take the ambitious bet. we ship, we do not wait for conditions to be perfect. kind. people over politics. we treat each other with genuine warmth. agency without empathy creates chaos. please apply even if you don't match every line above. what matters most to us is curiosity and a love of making things. you don't need to know every tool we use. we'd rather hire a great, curious designer than someone who ticks every box.if this sounds like work you'd enjoy, we'd love to hear from you.compensationeu : €148k - €175k + equitysf : $219k - $265k + equity

about nightnight is a next-generation media holding company redefining talent representation for the digital age. night manages over 400 of the world's most influential digital creators, artists, and athletes. with a digital-first ethos, night has emerged as a cultural powerhouse at the intersection of entertainment, entrepreneurship, and the creator economy. the company's comprehensive suite of services includes talent management, a venture studio, a rapidly growing licensing division, and a top-tier podcast network. as the traditional media landscape continues to evolve, night is building the infrastructure that empowers individual creators to become global brands.about the rolewe're hiring a sports content strategist to lead content and athlete brand strategy across the night sports roster - this role will help our athletes build audiences, personal brands, and commercial value that lasts beyond any single season. this is a highly strategic and execution-oriented role. working alongside night sports managers, you will be responsible for taking the long-term vision for an athlete and turning it into an actionable strategy across their personal brand, social platforms, and broader business.what makes night different is the network we bring to every athlete. we sit at the intersection of sports and the internet in a way that traditional sports agencies can’t. our athletes don't have to guess what works online or have marginalized commercial opportunities - they have direct access to some of the most engaged audiences on the internet, and a team that knows how to activate them authentically. the sports content strategist will be the person who figures out how to turn that structural advantage into content and moments that move culture.our sports managers are exceptional at developing athlete relationships and structuring deals. what they need is a dedicated content and brand expert who can build each athlete's digital presence with intention - someone who closes the gap between a great athlete and a brand people follow.what you’ll do develop and execute content strategy across night's sports roster, tailored to each athlete's sport, season, personality, and commercial goals  originate creative concepts across long form and short form digital channels - content series, creator collaborations, behind-the-scenes formats, moment-driven hooks - and own their execution  build content calendars around the sports cycle: training camp, season, playoffs, draft, offseason, and key career moments  broker collaborations between athletes and night's creator roster to drive cross-pollinated audience growth  source and manage external creative resources including videographers, editors, photographers, producers and other specialists  partner with sports managers and the brand partnerships team to make athletes more valuable to sponsors  track performance across platforms and translate data into clear recommendations for athletes and managers  stay sharp on platform trends, emerging formats, and what's cutting through in sports what we’re looking for 3 - 5+ years of experience in sports content, athlete marketing, social strategy, or a closely related role (team, league, agency, media brand, or in-house)  experience working directly with athletes or talent, not just team or consumer brand accounts  equal parts strategist and executor - you can develop a content vision and deliver it  deep fluency in social platforms: short-form video, instagram, tiktok, youtube  ability to identify the story, personality, and positioning that make an athlete interesting beyond their competition performance  strong storytelling and communications instincts, with an understanding of what can become an earned-media moment and when to bring in pr expertise  strong project management instincts - the ability to manage strategies and timelines across multiple athletes simultaneously  comfort operating in a fast-moving, entrepreneurial environment

detail.desc: descriptionthe pv brand partnerships studio creates the deepest brand-content integrations in streaming — custom programs that connect advertisers to prime video's premium ip at the highest investment tier. the creative strategist is the qualification and creative gateway for all custom brand partnerships entering the studio pipeline.you will guide brands on how to leverage prime video's content slate, talent, and streaming technology to reach audiences in a meaningful way. you'll respond to client briefs with compelling proposals that serve the brand's needs while leveraging the best of prime video's ip, products, and premiere calendar. you'll also develop proactive packages against upcoming titles — identifying which brands belong against which content before the brief arrives.this role sits at the intersection of pre-sales and creative. you are not producing campaigns — you are deciding which campaigns get produced, and shaping the creative strategy that wins them.key job responsibilitiesyou will qualify inbound briefs against defined criteria (win probability, budget confirmation, title-brand alignment, timeline feasibility) and route demand to the correct tier.you will respond to qualified client rfps with compelling proposals that connect brand objectives to prime video ip, talent, and audience.you will attend client meetings, pitches, and collaborative work sessions to translate, and educate, pv brand partnerships to customers and media agencies.you will develop proactive title packages, identifying advertiser vertical needs and content opportunities before demand arrives.you will conceptualize campaigns in a fast-paced, collaborative environment while managing multiple projects with multiple stakeholders across sales, gtm, studios, and production.you will articulate high-concept ideas and proposals to sellers, media agencies, and clients to ensure they're effectively communicated and creatively differentiated.you will serve as the strategic bridge between the sales organization and the creative team — protecting studio capacity while maximizing pipeline quality and win rates. you will ensure that all concepts delivered meet amazon's bar-raising standard. you will work hard, have fun, and make history.a day in the lifecreative: you lead strategic creative development sessions for qualified briefs, guide cross-functional teams through innovative program design, and champion breakthrough ideas from concept through pitch.qualification & routing: you assess incoming demand against the qualification gate, make binding go/no-go decisions on which briefs enter the custom pipeline, and redirect non-qualifying demand to appropriate tiers with clear rationale.data-driven approach: you analyze title performance data, audience signals, and campaign history to inform creative recommendations and brand-title matching decisions.proactive development: you build title packages against the upcoming slate before briefs arrive — connecting ip, audience data, and brand category fit into pitchable creative platforms.stakeholder management: you navigate conversations with internal teams (sales, gtm, studios, production) and external clients, build consensus across diverse groups, and maintain strong relationships with key partners.ai fluency: you integrate ai tools into your creative workflow, explore emerging capabilities to enhance campaign development, and advocate for ai-driven innovation in the pre-sales process.strategic influence: you pitch creative concepts to senior leaders and clients, refine ideas based on feedback, and drive teams to execute against your strategic vision.about the teamthe bil pv bps team focuses on prime video ip and brands, developing co-branded full-funnel campaigns.basic qualifications 8+ years of driving compelling creative strategy and execution at an agency or in-house creative team experience bachelor's degree experience prioritizing senior executives 5+ years of driving compelling creative strategy and execution at an agency or in-house creative team experiencepreferred qualifications knowledge of indesign, photoshop, detail.desc: company profilethe carlyle group (nasdaq: cg) is a global investment firm with $485 billion of assets under management, across 678 investment vehicles as of june 30, 2026. founded in 1987 in washington, dc, carlyle has grown into one of the world's largest and most successful investment firms, with more than 2,500 professionals operating in 28 offices in north america, europe, the middle east, asia and australia. carlyle's purpose is to connect people, ideas, and capital to fuel growth for companies and performance for investors, which range from public and private pension funds to wealthy individuals and families to sovereign wealth funds, unions and corporations. carlyle invests across three segments - global private equity, global credit and carlyle alpinvest - and has deep expertise across industries, markets, and geographies. at carlyle, we believe that a wide spectrum of experiences and viewpoints drives performance and success. our ceo, harvey schwartz, has stated that, "to build better businesses and create value for all of our stakeholders, we are focused on assembling leadership teams with the strongest insights from a range of perspectives." reflecting this view, emphasis is placed on development, retention and inclusion through our internal processes and seven employee resource groups (ergs). we cultivate a culture where ideas are openly shared and challenged, connecting diverse expertise and perspectives to drive enduring value. position summary carlyle is seeking an experienced content strategist, writer, and editor to join our marketing team as avp, content strategy. this role blends hands-on writing and editing with broader ownership of how content marketing campaigns translate carlyle's investment strategy and business results across carlyle's three global business segments - global private equity, global credit, and carlyle alpinvest - into compelling, commercially astute, investor-facing content that feels native to the platforms where it appears.reporting to the head of content, this individual is a key member of the team responsible for helping to develop and execute carlyle's content and digital marketing strategy worldwide. this person will also partner closely with business subject matter experts across investment teams to ensure that our content reflects timely, accurate, and compelling market perspectives that enable investment decision-making.leveraging expertise in copywriting, editing, and storytelling, the role will work closely with media peers, event marketing, internal and executive communications, and colleagues across marketing, including social media, multimedia, digital experience and the creative studio. in-office requirement: 4 days per week office location: washington, d.c. or new york, ny primary responsibilitiesdevelop, write, and edit high-quality marketing content across formats, including long-form articles and research, video and podcast scripts, email, social media, and in-person events, translating carlyle's investment perspectives and business priorities into compelling narratives for institutional investors and wealth audiences (advisors, uhnw/hnw).help shape and execute carlyle's editorial point of view and content strategy, including ownership of the editorial calendar, ensuring individual initiatives ladder up to consistent themes, audience priorities, and business objectives across segments and channels.develop deep fluency in carlyle's investment strategies and market positioning across global private equity, global credit, and carlyle alpinvest, using that knowledge to create content that informs, engages, and builds relevance with target audiences.stay current on social and digital platform norms, emerging formats, audience behaviors, and evolving content discovery, adapting carlyle's voice and storytelling so content feels native to each channel while meeting brand and compliance standards.direct and develop freelance and contract writers who extend the in-house content team, including assigning work, providing developmental editing and brand voice direction, and ensuring consistently high editorial quality.lead the editorial strategy for complex and high-profile campaigns, defining the core narrative and ensuring it translates cohesively across content, creative, multimedia, social, and other audience touchpoints in support of clear business objectives.serve as an editorial lead across content, creative studio, multimedia, and social media, connecting disciplines and ensuring narratives, priorities, and execution remain aligned across channels.use audience insights and content performance data to identify opportunities, optimize content, and inform future editorial priorities and formats.partner closely with legal and compliance to navigate review requirements and ensure content meets applicable standards prior to publication.serve as a trusted advisor to partners and stakeholders across the firm on storytelling, messaging, structure, and brand voice, constructively challenging and improving content where appropriate.support the head of content in advancing broader editorial priorities, team processes, and ways of working as carlyle's content function continues to evolve and grow.requirements education & certificatesbachelors degree, requiredconcentration in marketing, communications, journalism, or a related field, preferredcertificate in content strategy, project management, or a related field is a plus. professional experience6+ years of overall relevant experience, requiredexperience in content marketing, journalism/editorial, or content operations within financial services, preferredproven experience writing and editing content marketing for institutional investors, financial advisors, and/or high-net-worth investors, with the financial and market fluency to translate complex investment concepts into compelling, differentiated narrative.track record of creating content that performs on social and digital platforms, with fluency in current platform norms, formats, and trends across channels such as linkedin, instagram, and podcast/video.proven experience coordinating multi-channel content projects across teams that use different tools and systems, without formal management authority over those teams.experience developing and maintaining an editorial calendar or content strategy roadmap, translating business priorities into a coherent content narrative over time.demonstrated track record of solving cross-team roadblocks and reprioritizing competing workloads independently, rather than escalating routine conflicts to leadership.experience directing or managing the output of freelance or contract writers, including assigning work and providing developmental feedback.experience partnering with legal and compliance on regulated marketing content.familiarity with microsoft 365 tools (lists, teams, sharepoint) or comparable project-tracking systems (e.g., monday.com, kanban/agile boards) is a plus. competencies & attributescomfortable holding others accountable to deadlines and process without formal management authority.strong storytelling, writing, and copyediting skills, paired with genuine curiosity about markets and investment strategy and the judgment to translate complex ideas into a sharp, differentiated brand voice.strategic thinker who can define and evolve an editorial point of view and content roadmap, not just execute against a brief.creative instinct for what engages on social and digital platforms, with fluency in current trends, formats, and best practices, and the judgment to adapt them to carlyle's brand and audience.highly organized and detail-oriented, with the judgment to know when to escalate versus resolve independently.diplomatic relationship-builder who can operate fluently across tools, teams, and seniority levels.ability to influence and operate effectively in a fast-paced, evolving, matrixed environment.strong project coordination skills and experience working cross-functionally with global teams to prioritize and execute parallel projects.comfort leveraging ai tools to support drafting, editing, research, and content operations, with sound judgment about where human review and brand voice must lead. benefits/compensation the compensation range for this role is specific to washington, dc and takes into account a wide range of factors including but not limited to the skill sets required/preferred; prior experience and training; licenses and/or certifications.the anticipated base salary range for this role is $140,000 to $150,000. in addition to the base salary, the hired professional will enjoy a comprehensive benefits package spanning retirement benefits, health insurance, life insurance and disability, paid time off, paid holidays, family planning benefits and various wellness programs. additionally, the hired professional may also be eligible to participate in an annual discretionary incentive program, the award of which will be dependent on various factors, including, without limitation, individual and organizational performance.due to the high volume of candidates, please be advised that only candidates selected to interview will be contacted by carlyle.

detail.desc: about quizletat quizlet, our mission is to help every learner achieve their outcomes in the most effective and delightful way. we’re a $1b+ learning platform used by two-thirds of u.s. high school students and half of college students, powering over 1 billion learning interactions each week.we blend cognitive science with machine learning to personalize and enhance the learning experience for students, professionals, and lifelong learners alike. we’re energized by the potential to power more learners through multiple approaches and various tools.let’s build the future of learningjoin us to design and deliver ai-powered learning tools that scale across the world and unlock human potential.why join quizlet?🌎 massive reach: 60m+ users, 1b+ interactions per week🧠 cutting-edge tech: generative ai, adaptive learning, cognitive science📈 strong momentum: top-tier investors, sustainable business, real traction🎯 mission-first: work that makes a difference in people’s lives🤝 inclusive culture: committed to equity, diversity, and belongingabout the rolethis is a hybrid social-and-pr role, roughly 70% brand social and 30% earned media. you are the directly responsible individual for all @quizlet social content — strategy, ideation, creation, posting, community, and measurement — and you also run the announcements, media relationships, and thought leadership that put quizlet in the conversation. the two halves compound: viral content becomes earned coverage, and announcements become social moments.in this role, you willown content end-to-end for all quizlet-branded channels — including instagram, tiktok, youtube shorts, linkedin, threads, etc. — from strategy through posting, leveraging the best of our creator channels and creating content yourself every day, hands-on at every step.insert quizlet into culture through content and coverage that feels more human than corporate, more irreverent than sterile — building the recurring themes, motifs, and storytelling that make us a real participant in pop culture rather than a brand commenting on it.run announcements end-to-end for product and company news — press releases, media pitching, and amplification across blog, social, and paid — with a goal of growing earned media coverage 20% year over year.own the tentpole moments where social and pr have to move together: spring rush, back-to-school, finals, march madness, april fools', and the quick-turn newsjacking opportunities in between. you keep an always-on calendar of these and know which ones are worth our time.build and cultivate media relationships, with a focus on raising visibility with top-tier press, and support our thought leaders with sharp povs on ai, the future of education, and digital learning — using data storytelling (including our how america learns research) as the hook and developing content for speaking engagements, executive social and media opportunities.manage our agency partners — you own the pr agency relationship and budget from day one, setting priorities, briefing them, holding the work to our standards, and building a collaborative partnership for outbound comms and reactive/crisis situations.manage our community — monitoring and engaging across channels daily, routing user issues to the right internal teams, and surfacing what you're hearing back to product and marketing.work cross-functionally to measure impact and keep the story consistent — partnering with paid, lifecycle, pmm, brand design, product, and ads, and with our social agency partner, to make sure the work ladders up to quizlet's brand and business goals.report on performance and act on it — tracking content and coverage against views, engagement, and user growth, and articulating why something worked so we can do it again.submit our products, brand, and leaders for industry awards and speaking opportunities that put quizlet in good company.handle rapid-response and crisis communications, including coordinating with leadership and external agencies during sensitive situations. you'll be the point person for reputation management and media inquiries during challenging moments.what you bring to the tabledeep understanding of what makes branded social content actually engaging, plus a one-step-ahead instinct for what differentiates a brand on social.proven track record of creating engaging short-form content — you may have tens or hundreds of millions of views in aggregate.excellent grasp of the media landscape and the ability to generate insight from trends in learning, consumer, technology, and business.ability to analyze and articulate why content goes viral and connect content performance to business impact.strong command of timing, message, and voice when managing internal leaders and external partners through a launch or a story.exceptional creative storytelling abilities, and up-to-the-moment knowledge of viral trends and cultural moments.recognized authority in your field — cross-functional partners seek out your opinion and approval — with the judgment to make independent calls on complex work and pivot when something isn't the right fit for the brand.experience directing outside agencies or vendors — briefing them well, raising the quality of what comes back, and knowing what to keep in-house.self-starter; proactive by nature, with a bias toward action over deliberation and the ability to unblock yourself.bonus points if you haveexperience leading socials for a top-tier, leading brand.experience partnering across social and pr for earned media stemming from viral social content.experience handling and coordinating on-set film shoots, including filming on a campus and coordinating logistics for physical items around locations.work locationwe’re happy to share that this is a hybrid position in our san francisco office. to support collaboration, we ask employees to be in the office at least two days a week: wednesday and thursday.compensation, benefits & perkscollaborate with your manager and team to create a healthy work-life balance20 vacation days that we expect you to take!competitive health, dental, and vision insurance (100% employee and 75% dependent ppo, dental, vsp choice)employer-sponsored 401k plan with company matchaccess to linkedin learning and other resources to support professional growthpaid family leave, fsa, hsa, commuter benefits, and wellness benefits40 hours of annual paid time off to participate in volunteer programs of choicewe strive to make everyone feel comfortable and welcome!we work to create a holistic interview process, where both quizlet and candidates have an opportunity to view what it would be like to work together, in exploring a mutually beneficial partnership. we provide a transparent setting that gives a comprehensive view of who we are!in closingat quizlet, we’re excited about passionate people joining our team—even if you don’t check every box on the requirements list. we value unique perspectives and believe everyone has something meaningful to contribute. our culture is all about taking initiative, learning through challenges, and striving for high-quality work while staying curious and open to new ideas. we believe in honest, respectful communication, thoughtful collaboration, and creating a supportive space where everyone can grow and succeed together.”quizlet’s success as an online learning community depends on a strong commitment to diversity, equity, and inclusion.as an equal opportunity employer and a tech company committed to societal change, we welcome applicants from all backgrounds. women, people of color, members of the lgbtq+ community, individuals with disabilities, and veterans are strongly encouraged to apply.to all recruiters and placement agenciesat this time quizlet does not accept unsolicited agency resumes and/or profiles.please do not forward unsolicited agency resumes to our website or to any quizlet employee. quizlet will not pay fees to any third-party agency or firm nor will it be responsible for any agency fees associated with unsolicited resumes. all unsolicited resumes received will be considered the property of quizlet.

lean team with our headquarters in los altos, california and roughly half our engineering team in sydney, australia.we're building the ai agents that enterprises actually deploy — not demos. our positioning & brandrefine our narrative, ideal customer profile (icp), buyer personas, and category positioningown the company's core messaging architecture and keep it consistent across the website, decks, demos, ads, and sales conversationstranslate deeply technical product capabilities into clear, compelling stories for enterprise buyers (cios, ctos, heads of ai, security and procurement teams)build and maintain brand guidelines — voice, tone, visual identity, and editorial standardsmanage brand reputation and any crisis or issues communicationsproduct marketing & launcheslead use-case pages on the websitedemand generation & performance marketingown paid acquisition end to end: google ads (search, display, performance max) and other paid channelsmanage budgets, bids, and creative; optimize for qualified pipeline, not vanity clicksbuild and optimize landing pages and conversion pathsown seo strategy and execution — technical seo, on-page, and content-led organic growthrun email and lifecycle marketing: nurture sequences, newsletters, and lead scoringcontent & thought leadershipbuild and run our content engine: blog posts, whitepapers, case studies, ebooks, one-pagers, and technical explainersproduce content for every stage of the funnel, from top-of-funnel awareness to bottom-of-funnel sales enablementturn our founders' and engineers' expertise into published thought leadershipown the editorial calendar and keep a steady cadence across channelspublic relations & communicationsown pr strategy and media relations — build relationships with journalists covering enterprise ai and agentic aiwrite and pitch press releases, media pitches, and bylined articlesmanage awards, analyst briefings (gartner, forrester, constellation), and industry recognitionhandle inbound press inquiries and coordinate executive interviews and speaking engagementssocial media & communityown all social channels (linkedin, x/twitter, youtube, and others) — strategy, calendar, and daily executionbuild an executive social presence for our founders and leadershipgrow and engage our community of enterprise ai practitioners and developersmonitor social conversation, engage authentically, and manage our online reputationwebsite & digital presenceown website conversion optimization — continuously test and improve landing pages, messaging, ctas, user journeys, and other conversion points to increase qualified leads and pipelinework with design and engineering (internal or contract) to keep the site fast, current, and on-brandmanage our marketing tech stack: cms, analytics, marketing automation, crm integration, and attributionsales enablement & revenue supportbuild the collateral our sales team needs: pitch decks, one-pagers, case studies, roi models, and competitive battlecardspartner with sales on repeatable sales plays and messaging that closes enterprise dealssupport abm (account-based marketing) efforts against target enterprise accountsarm the team for security reviews, rfps, and procurement conversations with the right materialsevents & field marketingown our presence at conferences, trade shows, and industry events — from booth strategy to speaking slotsplan and run our own webinars, roundtables, and executive dinnersmanage event logistics, budgets, and follow-up pipelineidentify and pursue strategic speaking opportunities for the ceo at relevant industry conferences, panels, summits, and other high-value events to build thought leadership and visibilitypartnerships & co-marketingidentify and execute co-marketing opportunities with technology partners, integrators, and channel partnersmanage joint campaigns, webinars, and content with partnerssupport partner enablement with co-branded materialsanalytics, reporting & operationsdefine the marketing kpis that matter and report on them regularly to leadershipown marketing analytics and attribution — know what's driving pipeline and revenuemanage the marketing budget and allocate spend for maximum returnbuild repeatable processes so the function can scale as we add peoplewhat we're looking for5+ years in marketing, with meaningful experience as a generalist or early/founding marketer at a startup — you've done the work yourself, not just managed people who didb2b and enterprise experience, ideally in saas, developer tools, infrastructure, or ai. you understand long sales cycles, technical buyers, and enterprise procurementa writer first. you can take a complex technical concept and make it land in a sentence. writing is the core of this jobfull-stack and hands-on. you've run paid campaigns, written content, pitched press, managed social, and optimized a website. you're comfortable being the only marketer in the buildingcomfortable with ambiguity. no playbook, no team, no hand-holding. you figure out what matters and go do itdata-driven. you measure everything, you know your numbers, and you make marketing to enterprise it, security, or ai buyersprior experience as a first or founding marketing hirefamiliarity with the agentic ai / llm landscape and the players in itexperience with abm detail.industry: Insurance and Employee Benefit Funds and Software Development
detail.desc: about avanteask any employee to explain their benefits, and you'll likely get a confused shrug. ask any hr leader if their benefits investment is working, and you'll get an honest "i don't know." for employees, benefits are confusing and overwhelming. for hr and finance leaders, benefits are the second-largest expense, but they lack the visibility to know what's working and what's wasted.at avante, we're changing that. we're an ai-native benefits intelligence platform built to help companies and hr leaders run benefits more effectively with ai. for employees, our agent carly provides personalized, always-on benefits guidance. for benefits leaders, our agent ava serves as the extension of the benefits team, handling operational workload and giving them better insights, sooner.we're based in seattle and expanding our presence to new york city, and work 4 days a week in the office (one day remote). we sell to fortune 2000 employers, with customers like samsung, zscaler, and news corp, and our marketing team is still small enough that one person's writing sets the tone for how the entire market understands what we do. we're looking for a senior content marketing manager to be that person.the roleai for benefits barely existed two years ago, and someone has to write the story of why it matters. that's this role: you'll be the voice behind the ideas, events, and content that make hr and benefits leaders sit up and pay attention.day to day, you'll plan and write across a range of formats: blog posts, sales enablement materials, event and webinar content, social, and more, moving fluidly between short-term production and longer-term editorial planning. you'll partner closely with product marketing, demand generation, and creative to make sure content ladders up to the right goals and reaches the right audience, and you'll use data to figure out what's working and adjust accordingly.this is a senior individual contributor role built for a writer at heart: you'll launch thought leadership communications, shape the narrative behind our webinars and panels, and turn avante's customer relationships into stories nobody else can tell. you'll own and curate avante’s brand voice, and identify areas of improvement as this industry continues to develop. what's yours is the writing itself: the original thinking, sharp framing, and proprietary point of view that no ai tool or outside agency can produce.what you'll dobuild avante's content engine. stand up the fundamentals: a working content calendar, website content, and a steady cadence of gtm enablement materials that give sales something concrete to use in every deal.curate avante's point of view. build narratives, materials, and thought leadership that define our category, educate and entertain our buyers, and enlighten and engage our partners and customers.write and shape our event content. build the speaker guides, narrative arcs, and talking points behind our webinars, panels, and podcasts. you provide the narrative and direction; creative partners handle production.lead our social presence. you'll shape what we say on our social platforms and make sure it sounds like a company with something to say, not another ai vendor posting for the algorithm.support demand generation with nurture content. write the drip sequences that keep leads warm once they enter the funnel, and write to improve aeo and seo through topical content, optimized for ranking.protect a consistent brand voice. make sure everything avante puts out, whatever the format or channel, sounds like it's coming from the same company. you're the one who catches it when copy drifts off-brand, and the one who keeps that voice sharp as more people touch content over time.use ai to extend your reach, not replace your thinking. let it handle the mechanical work, slicing long-form pieces into emails, subject lines, and social copy, so you can spend your time on what it can't produce: original ideas, real customer stories, and a voice that's recognizably avante's.adapt as we grow. scope will shift as the marketing function scales, and you should welcome that.what we're looking for7+ years in content marketing or a writing-heavy communications role, with a portfolio led by thought leadership and executive or event content, not general content opsbachelors degree in marketing, communications, or equivalent experienceexcellent, independently strong writing and editing skills; you can take a rough transcript or technical brief and turn it into something a senior hr or benefits leader wants to readdirect experience writing for events: speaker guides, panel and webinar narratives, or podcast contenta track record of producing enablement materials that sales teams actually use, built on real relationships, not generic testimonialscomfort using ai tools to repurpose and extend long-form writing, paired with clear judgment about what only a human writer should produceexperience partnering with product marketing or brand partners and executing on their vision.early-stage startup experience, including comfort being the only content person for a whileexperience marketing to enterprise-level/fortune 2000 companiesnice to havea published writing background (bylines, books, or a personal platform with real readership)experience marketing to hr, benefits, or healthcare buyershow we workour four values aren't aspirational. they translate into concrete operating tenets that shape how we make decisions every day.beat yesterday. we re-evaluate our own toolkit every quarter, because the workflows that made you effective three months ago may already be outdated. we act on 70% of the information rather than waiting for certainty. we timebox, execute, and iterate, getting work in front of real people quickly instead of polishing in isolation. and we own our output regardless of how we produced it. ai can get you 80% of the way there. everything that goes out with your name on it is your responsibility to review, refine, and stand behind.embrace type 2 fun. we take on hard problems and find meaning in the work, even when it's uncomfortable. we assume good intent and follow up directly rather than venting in side channels. we celebrate wins loudly and specifically, naming the actual behavior so the whole team learns what great looks like. we are on by default, because we owe it to each other and to our customers to be available beyond what a regular corporate job would demand. and we do unscalable things today that build scalable advantages tomorrow: every hand-built case study and late-night byline turnaround earns us the right to scale later.stay hungry, stay curious. we expect everyone to be the expert on ai in their function before anyone asks them to be. the landscape changes weekly. when you learn something, teach it. learn enough about adjacent functions to ask good questions. ask the question you think is too basic, because in complex domains like benefits, the cost of a wrong assumption can be a lost account. and remember: curiosity without urgency is a hobby. learning has to translate into action on a timeline that matches the opportunity.act like an owner. we say the uncomfortable thing early, raising missed commitments or quality gaps directly with the person within 48 hours. we surface problems when they're small, not the week they become a crisis. customer-facing work gets priority, always. and we close the loop every time, because over-communication is a feature at our stage, not a bug.comp: $120k-$155k base, + equity

detail.desc: descriptionartificial intelligence (ai) is changing both what customers build as well as what they must defend and how they defend it. autonomous agents now take actions, access data, and call other systems on their own, creating a new security and identity challenge that every enterprise is racing to understand. at the same time, ai is becoming one of the most important tools defenders have. together, these shifts represent the biggest change in cybersecurity in a generation.amazon web services (aws) is investing to lead through that shift. we have long set the standard for security of the cloud, and we are building on that foundation in two directions: helping customers secure their ai workloads, agentic applications, and the identities that ai introduces; and delivering a portfolio of ai-powered enterprise security services that use ai and autonomous agents to help defenders work at machine speed.this role sits at the center of that work. as a senior product marketing manager (pmm) for aws security and identity, you will help define how aws talks about both a key domain in securing ai and/or using ai to secure, and own the category narrative for a communicationsjob detailsabout salesforcesalesforce is the #1 ai crm, where humans with agents drive customer success together. here, ambition meets action. tech meets trust. and innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. the world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through ai, driving innovation, and keeping salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? you’re in the right place! agentforce is the future of ai, and you are the future of salesforce.about the rolejoin salesforce’s social & influence marketing team to lead our influencer and industry voice ecosystem, grow our employee advocacy program, and help bring major product launches to life across social.this is a dual-track role for someone who is equally comfortable building influencer relationships and shaping social content around a launch moment. you’ll own key programs end-to-end, co-lead product launch execution with our content strategy & creative lead, and bring the cross-functional teams required to deliver the work together.you’re also deeply plugged into culture — someone who understands the conversations, creators, formats, and behaviors shaping social in real time, and can turn that fluency into relevant content and influencer opportunities for salesforce.what you'll owninfluencers (ai creators & builders): lead the program end to end, including relationships, engagement cadence, and a tiered approach and moments.employee advocacy: own the program end-to-end, establishing a consistent editorial rhythm and activating employee ambassadors around priority stories and moments.product launches: co-lead social execution for major launches, spanning influencer coordination and social content production, with increasing independent ownership of launches over time.channel strategy: own the strategy and presence for instagram and tiktok, shaping how salesforce shows up across both channels.trend-spotting: contribute to team-wide trend monitoring and identify emerging conversations, creators, formats, and behaviors that salesforce can credibly participate in.cross-functional leadershipconnect the influencer center of excellence and the slack social & influence team, creating alignment around priorities, opportunities, and execution.lead cross-functional problem-solving when influencer, creative, measurement, and operational priorities compete within a launch.keep stakeholders aligned on decisions, dependencies, and trade-offs, and drive issues to resolution when perspectives diverge.how you'll work with the teampartner closely with the content strategy & creative lead to shape and execute product launches, build towards independent launch leadership over time.bring insights from influencers, creators, and industry voices back into the team — helping inform how we think about audiences, narratives, content, and cultural opportunities.collaborate with the social strategy & operations lead, using measurement, performance insights, and competitive intelligence to inform the work and understand its impact.what success looks likeslack has a well-run influencer and industry voice ecosystem with clear relationship tiers, engagement strategies, and a predictable activation cadence.employee advocacy operates with a consistent editorial rhythm and an engaged network of employee ambassadors.instagram and tiktok have clear strategies and increasingly distinctive roles within salesforce’s broader social presence.product launches are delivered on time and on budget, with strong alignment across influencer, content, measurement, and operations.you take full accountability for the work you own and progressively lead larger, more complex launch moments independently.qualifications & experience5+ years of experience in social media, influencer marketing, content strategy, or related fields, with demonstrated ownership of campaigns or programs from strategy through execution.experience managing influencer or creator relationships end-to-end, including sourcing, negotiation, briefing, activation, and measurement.hands-on experience developing and shipping social content, including copywriting, editorial planning, content calendars, and campaign execution.experience supporting major product launches, campaigns, or culturally relevant moments across social.strong cross-functional leadership skills, with experience aligning creative, influencer, analytics, and operations partners around shared outcomes.a track record of developing clear product or solution narratives, ideally informed by customer, creator, or external audience insights.strong working knowledge of instagram and tiktok, including platform behaviors, formats, creator ecosystems, and emerging trends.experience managing project budgets and timelines and making sound decisions within moderate ambiguity.strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to facilitate discussions, navigate competing priorities, and clearly articulate decisions and trade-offs.experience with employee advocacy programs and tiered influencer engagement models is a plus.unleash your potentialwhen you join salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. our benefits and resources support you to find balance and be your best, and our ai agents accelerate your impact so you can do your best. together, we’ll bring the power of agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for ai, and the world.accommodationsif you need a reasonable accommodation during the application or the recruiting process, please submit a request via this accommodations request form.please note that salesforce selection and hiring decisions. please see our candidate privacy statement for more information about how we use your personal data and your rights, including with regard to use of ai tools and opt out options.posting statementsalesforce is an equal opportunity employer and maintains a policy of non-discrimination with all employees and applicants for employment. what does that mean exactly? it means that at salesforce, we believe in equality for all. and we believe we can lead the path to equality in part by creating a workplace that’s inclusive, and free from discrimination. know your national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender expression or identity, transgender status, age, disability, veteran or marital status, political viewpoint, or other classifications protected by law. promotion, benefits, training, assessment of job performance, discipline, termination, and everything in between. recruiting, hiring, and promotion decisions at salesforce are fair and based on merit. as location, job level, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. certain roles may be eligible for incentive compensation, equity, and benefits. salesforce offers a variety of benefits to help you live well including: time off programs, medical, dental, vision, mental health support, paid parental leave, life and disability insurance, 401(k), and an employee stock purchasing program. more details about company benefits can be found at the following link: https://www.salesforcebenefits.com.at salesforce, we believe in equitable compensation practices that reflect the dynamic nature of labor markets across various regions. the typical base salary range for this position is $117,400 - $177,600 annually. the range represents base salary only, and does not include company bonus, incentive for sales roles, equity or benefits, as applicable.

lead dot&pf’s statewide communications team and oversee internal and external communications, media relations, public information, websites, social media, publications, and employee engagement consistent communication strategies that support the department’s mission and keep employees, stakeholders, and the public informed.our organization, mission, and culturethe state of alaska department of transportation and public facilities’ mission is to keep alaska moving. we are working toward a modern, adaptable, flexible transportation system that will be resilient as we tackle our challenges. we believe collaboration, communication, and coordination increase our ability to succeed. creating teams that are focused on results, working together, and leveraging resources across our department, with community and private sector partnerships, increases our ability to accomplish our mission and serve alaskans.the working environment you can expectthis position is located in anchorage, alaska. working at the alaska department of transportation and public facilities (dot&pf) offers a uniquely challenging and rewarding environment. with alaska's diverse and expansive terrain, coupled with its extreme weather conditions, employees of the dot&pf can work in various locations, including remote locations and urban centers, addressing a wide range of transportation needs. their roles demand adaptability and resourcefulness as they maintain and improve roads, bridges, airports, ports, and public facilities in a state known for rugged terrain and extreme seasonal changes. this work not breathtaking natural beauty, reflecting a strong commitment to safety and environmental responsibility.the benefits of joining our teamjoining the alaska department of transportation & public employees with a dynamic and diverse work environment where they can continually enhance their skills and climb the career ladder. the department values professional development, offering training programs and mentorship opportunities to help individuals expand their expertise and advance in their chosen fields. with the vast and unique challenges of alaska's geography and climate, employees can work on groundbreaking projects that contribute to the state's growth, making the dot&pf an ideal choice for those seeking a fulfilling and evolving career in transportation and public facilities.the state of alaska has a generous benefits package and an excellent retirement plan. please see here for more information: https://doa.alaska.gov/dop/workplace/benefits/.the dot&pf core about the client service departmentthe goal of client service is to build and grow meaningful relationships with the world's largest, most sophisticated investors and help clients achieve their goals through high quality return streams and tailored insights. to this end, we deeply understand the global pools of capital, develop strategies to effectively develop relationships, and partner with clients on their most difficult investment and portfolio construction problems. we help our clients broaden their understanding of our investment process, strategies and performance as well as deepen their understanding of financial markets more generally.about your roleyou will help shape the next phase of bridgewater's visual identity and bring it to life across internal and external channels. this is a hands-on design role with significant creative ownership and room to experiment and build. you will move fluidly between building the visual design system and designing within it, and you will partner closely with the creative director and the head of external communications and affairs to create the tools, standards, systems and assets that support it.you will drive the following responsibilities:evolving bridgewater's visual identity: help develop and refine our visual language including typography, color, imagery, graphic systems, iconography, and other core brand elements. build the brand system: partner with the creative director and head of external communications and affairs to co-develop practical brand guidelines and a scalable design architecture that creates consistency without sacrificing creativity. turn the system into exceptional work: apply the brand system across a wide range of touchpoints from retail ads to recruiting materials to our website and social media and beyond. raise the creative bar: bring exceptional taste and a strong point of view while being open-minded and able to quickly loop on feedback. push beyond the obvious solution and
