about spiralyzespiralyze is the largest a/b testing company in the united states. we run experiments on our clients’ websites to figure out what actually gets customers to buy. we use proprietary data, scraped from hundreds of thousands of tests across the web, to predict what will win for each client before a test even launches.our clients include well-known brands like crowdstrike, netflix, the nfl, podium, unbounce, okta, harvard, workday, and hundreds more. (see what they have to say on spiralyze.com/testimonials/)we’re a fast-growing company in a fast-growing industry. spiralyze has grown ~30% per year for the past 13 years. we’ve been on the inc. 5000 list of fastest-growing u.s. companies for 6 of the last 7 years. we promote almost entirely from within:75% of our leadership team started in entry-level roles85% of senior employees outside atlanta are remote if you’re smart, ambitious, and coachable, this is the one you’ve been looking for.the roledetailslocation: hybrid: midtown atlanta (in-office) + remoteexperience: 0-5 yearsworking schedule: 8 hours per dayvacation: 20 days + public holidayssalary: 50,000 - 80,000 usdhealthcare: yeswe’re building a founder-led media brand to establish spiralyze as the definitive authority in a/b testing and experimentation. this role is the engine that makes it happen.you’ll be the person who turns our proprietary data and the founder’s expertise into a steady stream of high-impact content across linkedin and youtube. you’ll own the editorial strategy, develop recurring content formats, write or ghostwrite posts, create video storyboards, and manage the creative team that produces everything.you’re a producer: part strategist, part writer, part editor-in-chief. you’ll work directly with the founder to extract insights and shape them into content that makes people stop scrolling.we have the most interesting dataset in our industry, a founder who can deliver on camera, and a production team ready to execute. we need the person who connects it all with a clear narrative and a relentless publishing cadence.core responsibilitieseditorial strategy & content planning. you’ll build and own the editorial calendar across linkedin and youtube. you’ll develop recurring series and formats (e.g., myth-busting posts, website teardowns, data-driven trend pieces) that compound over time. you’ll decide what gets published, when, and in what format, and you’ll make sure every piece reinforces our positioning as the data-backed authority in a/b testing.founder content extraction. you’ll run biweekly 60–90 minute sessions with the founder to capture insights, opinions, and stories from client work. your job is to turn that raw material into a week’s worth of linkedin posts, video scripts, and content briefs. the founder’s total time commitment should be under 10 hours per week. you’re the multiplier that makes that possible.writing & ghostwriting. you’ll write or direct the writing of 4–5 linkedin posts per week in the founder’s voice, plus scripts for 1–2 youtube videos. you know how to write hooks that stop the scroll, structure posts for engagement, and turn complex data into clear, compelling narratives. you’ll also develop a distinct written voice that feels authentic to the founder and consistent across every platform.creative team management. you’ll direct an in-house videographer, graphic designer, and overseas editors. you set the creative brief, review output, and ensure everything meets a premium quality bar. you’re not doing the production yourself; you’re the person who makes sure the production team has clear direction and the final product is sharp.performance & iteration. you’ll track what’s working and what’s not across every format and platform. you’ll use engagement data, follower growth, and pipeline attribution to double down on winning formats and kill underperformers. you’ll share performance reports and recommendations with leadership regularly.skills, knowledge and traitsexceptional writer. you think in hooks that stop people mid-scroll. you can take a complex a/b testing insight and make it accessible, surprising, and shareable.strategic thinker. you think not just of individual video ideas, but in terms of reusable content formats that we can apply multiple times to our content.data-comfortable. you don’t need to be a data scientist, but you should be comfortable working with math (rates, averages, etc.). our content is built on proprietary data, so you need to understand it well enough to tell stories with it.smart and high agency. you learn fast, take ownership, and don’t wait to be told what to do. when something isn’t working, you diagnose it and fix it. you’re the kind of person who brings solutions, not questions.what you'll getgrowth path. we invest heavily in developing our people and promote almost exclusively from within. success in this role leads to building and leading an entire content and brand team.in-demand skills. you’ll work alongside one of the most experienced experimentation teams in the world and learn how data, psychology, and creative intersect.time to recharge. 20 days of paid vacation plus holidays.if you’re excited about building a media brand around data, working directly with a founder, and turning proprietary insights into content that an entire industry pays attention to, we’d love to hear from you.

about runx1the runx1 research program (rrp) supports families affected by runx1 familial platelet disorder (runx1-fpd), a rare inherited condition that raises the lifetime risk of blood cancer. runx1-fpd can only be confirmed through genetic testing, so many families go years without a diagnosis, or never receive one. helping those families find us is at the heart of this role.founded in 2016 by monica and tim babich, a patient family, rrp connects patients, clinicians, and researchers and funds research aimed at preventing blood cancer before it starts. our work includes several grant-funding mechanisms, the runx1 patient data hub, and our x-out blood cancer awareness campaign.about the rolea parent navigating a genetic diagnosis, a clinician seeking resources, a researcher exploring a new study, and a donor considering a gift need different information. you will help each audience understand our work and take a useful next step.reporting to the president and executive director, and with part-time support from an experienced communications contractor, you will turn organizational priorities into clear communications, effective outreach, and strong visual design. we detail.desc: descriptionthis position is open until the first review and is a bargaining unit represented position. we are looking for someone that can start in early january 2027.a cover letter and resume are required with your online application in order for your application to be considered complete. uploading your resume to auto-fill portions of the application does not automatically attach it to your application. incomplete applications will not be considered for this position.we are recruiting a risk communications specialist to strengthen public health emergency communications through message development, partner coordination, and the integration of risk communication into preparedness planning, training, and response operations. this role works closely with staff across the department and with external partners to build operational readiness, support emergency activations and responses, and drive continuous improvement through after-action processes.why join snohomish county?snohomish county’s commitment to life-work balance and an inclusive culture. the county offers outstanding benefits and professional growth opportunities to our employees, and we also enjoy flexible work schedules, telework options and a convenient downtown everett, wa. location. snohomish county believes in diversity, equity, and inclusion (dei) and is committed to embedding these values into our workplace culture. snohomish county is located on the puget sound; we are situated near some of the country’s most scenic national parks and is consistently ranked as one of the best places to live in the u.s.teleworking optionsthe health department typically has a hybrid model for most roles; however, it is outlined by the supervisor for the given role based on performance and business needs. when working remotely, employees are expected to maintain a home workspace with an internet connection where they can reliably perform work and remain available and responsive during scheduled work hours. snohomish county has a robust collection of tools and resources to support working remotely.descriptionsnohomish county health department is recruiting a risk communications specialist to join our public health emergency preparedness and response (phepr) team in the office of the director. this role leads the program’s risk communication work, from preparedness messaging during steady-state periods to real-time support during emergency activations.the risk communications specialist develops pre-scripted and incident-specific messages, coordinates with the department’s communications team and public information officer, and builds risk communication into our emergency plans, trainings, and exercises. during responses, the specialist supports public information operations and partner coordination. after exercises and incidents, the specialist leads communication-focused after-action work and carries improvements back into plans and training.we are looking for someone who can turn complex, evolving health information into clear, accurate, culturally responsive messages under time pressure. the right candidate builds strong working relationships with partners, has great communication skills, and is comfortable working in dynamic environments.job dutiesexamples of work performed:prepare and respond to public health emergencies using skills, training, and procedures as a member of the phepr program. participate in and support emergency responses in assigned ics roles and tasks. contribute to annual integrated preparedness plans (ipp), aars/ips, risk/capability assessments (e.g., thira/spr, hva), readiness assessments, and corrective-action tracking work.embed and integrate equity, access, and inclusion principles into all work—including planning, training, exercises, outreach, volunteer management, partner engagement, and response operations.maintain accurate documentation (plans, sops, checklists, job aids, rosters, inventories) . and accurate records (training completions, inventories, volunteer rosters, mous, aars/ips, assessments) in shared repositories, ensuring consistency with grant and program requirements.coordinate with region 1 and puget sound partners on cross-jurisdiction topics, projects, and priorities (e.g., esf-8, fatality management, surge planning, alternate care, etc.). build and sustain the relationships needed for effective emergency preparedness and response. support risk communication, information management, and situational awareness processes; keep public-facing preparedness information current and accurate.participate in required public health or emergency management trainings/drills/exercises; maintain role-appropriate credentials.collaborate with health department staff to support effective emergency preparedness and response functions.maintain working knowledge of ics/nims and fulfilling assigned emergency operations center or incident management team roles during trainings, exercises, and responses.coordinate with local, regional, and state partners (dem, nwhrn, ems council, mortuary services, healthcare facilities, dhs biowatch, uasi workgroups, etc.) to share resources, lessons learned, and best practices.support webeoc needs for the health department, collaborate with external partners as needed; ensure staff have access to emergency notifications, complete all required wa secures drills. support staff and volunteer readiness, departmental logistics and operations, and resource management (through tasks such as waserv rosters, mcm inventories/trailers, power bi trackers, readiness assessments, etc.) consistent with program needs and requirements.assist with the tracking of grant-funded deliverables (phep/cri/fphs/naccho/uasi), prepare succinct status reports, and contribute to relevant workplans/strategic plans. coordinate the preparation and delivery of trainings, accurate briefings, and partner presentations; facilitate meetings and communities of practice; maintain schd preparedness and response resources (e.g., schd emergency response toolkit, internal/external preparedness page, etc.).associated duties:perform other duties as assigned.respond, as requested, to emergency operations centers during a public health/health care emergency activation.may be required to work extended workdays during a response, including weekends.participate in local, regional, and state related meetings and communities of practice related to public health preparedness. minimum qualificationsskills for the position may be gained through education, certification, relevant job experience or a combination, such as:bachelor’s degree from an accredited institution in emergency management or closely related fieldtwo (2) years of public health, emergency management or closely related field, preferred. licenses, certifications, and other information:master’s degree from an accredited institution in emergency management or closely related field preferred.completion of relevant emergency management courses such as the federal emergency management agency (fema) independent study series and appropriate national incident management system (nims) and incident command system (ics) courses; ics 100 and 700 to be completed within two weeks of employment.completion of homeland security exercise evaluation program (hseep), preferredvalid washington state driver’s license or ability to obtain one within thirty (30) days of hire and a driving record which meets the requirements of snohomish county’s insurance carrier.successful completion of a background check pursuant to rcw 43.43.830.additional informationsnohomish county is an equal employment opportunity (eeo) employer.accommodations for individuals with disabilities are provided upon request.eeo policy and ada noticeif you have any questions regarding this opportunity, please reach out to shd.hr@co.snohomish.wa.us.job offers are contingent on successful completion of reference and background checks. snohomish county will not sponsor or take over sponsorship of an employment visa for this opportunity. in compliance with federal law, all persons hired will be required to verify identity and eligibility to work in the united states.snohomish county offers a comprehensive benefits package to employees that receive a regular appointment who work at least 20 hours a week.county benefitsvisit www.snohomishcountywa.gov/benefits to learn more about the following benefits.medical insurancevision insurancedental insuranceretirementbasic group term life insurance/ accidental death and dismemberment (ad&d) insurancelong term disability (ltd)commuting benefitsemployee assistance program (eap)partners for health employee wellness programleave & holidays voluntary benefitsdeferred compensation 457(b)supplemental group term life insuranceadditional accidental death and dismemberment insurance (ad&d)flexible spending accounts (fsa)supplemental individual insurance policieshealthcare premiumsregular full-time employees: if you work 35 or more hours per week, you will pay these monthly premiums for medical insurance. the county pays the monthly premiums for vision, dental, and basic life insurance.regular part-time employees: if you work between 20 and 34 hours per week, you will pay pro-rated monthly premiums for medical, dental, vision, and basic life insurance. the county's contribution toward the premium for an employee in a regular part-time appointment will be pro-rated in an amount equal to the f.t.e. percentage the employee is assigned.note: temporary employees, seasonal employees and paid interns may be eligible for medical insurance benefits. organizations, helping translate complex technical capabilities, product advancements and data-driven insights into compelling narratives for business, technology and consumer audiences.we're looking communications professional who will be a hands-on contributor from day one, with the opportunity to help shape how nbcuniversal communicates its technology and innovation story.here you can:help technology capabilities, product innovation and business priorities. turn strategy into strong execution. write and edit press releases, communications plans, messaging frameworks, faqs, executive talking points, speeches, presentations and other high-impact materials, tailoring complex information for different audiences. work closely with senior leaders. partner with subject matter experts across product, technology, growth and decision sciences to identify compelling stories, sharpen messages and prepare leaders for high-profile external opportunities. build visibility for our technology leaders. support executive thought leadership, speaking engagements, industry conferences and awards, from identifying opportunities and developing submissions to preparing executives and supporting events. engage with media. manage press inquiries and develop relationships with reporters covering technology, business, data, innovation and entertainment. identify fresh angles and new opportunities to bring nbcuniversal's innovation stories to the market. connect the dots across the business. collaborate with communications colleagues and cross-functional partners to ensure technology and product narratives support broader company priorities and major milestones. stay ahead of what's next. follow developments in consumer technology, enterprise technology, data, ai, streaming and digital experiences, identifying emerging trends and opportunities that can inform our storytelling. keep complex initiatives moving. manage multiple communications workstreams, deadlines and processes with strong attention to detail, sound judgment and a commitment to excellent execution. qualificationsthe person5+ years of experience in communications, product communications, technology communications, strategic storytelling or a related field, ideally with experience communicating about consumer technology, enterprise technology, digital products, data or innovation. an exceptional writer and storyteller who can make complex, technical or data-heavy subjects understandable, interesting and relevant to a broad audience. comfortable developing everything from press releases and executive messaging to longer-form narratives and strategic communications plans. a strong understanding of technology and its business impact. you don't need to be an engineer or data scientist, but you should be intellectually curious, comfortable engaging with technical experts and able to quickly grasp how products, platforms and technologies work and why they matter. experience working with senior executives and cross-functional teams, with the confidence, professionalism and judgment to navigate high-visibility initiatives and communicate effectively with stakeholders at all levels. strategic curiosity paired with a roll-up-your-sleeves mentality. you're excited to contribute ideas, recognize emerging opportunities and help shape the larger narrative, while also taking ownership of the writing, coordination and execution needed to bring those ideas to life. strong communications instincts and an understanding of earned media, including what makes a approach and a genuine interest in learning, asking smart questions and building relationships across disciplines. bachelor's degree in communications, journalism, business, technology or a related direct-hire process, ensuring candidates join our clients’ teams directly while we support them throughout the journey.about our partner: you'll join an ai-powered marketing technology company that operates as a holding company for a growing portfolio of brands — built on more than 16 years of ai r&d, backed by a large and growing investor community, and trusted by fortune 1000 companies across retail, entertainment and consumer goods.about the role: you'll be the in-house design anchor for the entire portfolio — owning brand identity, presentation and campaign design (decks, ad creative, social and blog graphics, logos and brand guidelines) and serving as the primary point of design accountability, alongside the portfolio marketing team and an established network of freelance designers.this isn't a role where you polish one brand. you'll move between several distinct brands in the same week, and each one has to look unmistakably like itself.what you'll doday-to-day design production. own decks, ad creative, social and blog graphics and other marketing collateral across the portfolio — reliable in-house coverage wherever freelance capacity runs short.brand identity. lead logo development and create and maintain brand guidelines for portfolio companies.campaign alignment. partner with the portfolio marketing team in recurring planning and review sessions to line up creative output with campaign priorities.freelance coordination. work with the brand, motion and project-based freelance designers in the network — keeping quality consistent and handoffs clean between in-house and freelance work.multiple brands, multiple deadlines. manage concurrent requests across different brands, using independent creative judgment on style and visual consistency.organized assets. maintain project files and brand assets in frame.io, adobe creative suite, and figma or canva as needed.quality gate. make sure every deliverable meets each brand's guidelines and the company's quality standards before it's published or distributed.how we worknot a 9–5. workload follows the pace of the business: it surges during fundraising campaigns, with more predictable weeks in between. fast turnarounds during those surges come with the job.an evening approval window. final creative approvals happen in a recurring early-evening window, roughly 7–9 pm pacific time. you'll need to reliably be available for it.in-house anchor, freelance bench. you're the constant; freelancers flex around you.what you bring5+ years of senior-level graphic and brand design experience, including brand identity and guideline development.a strong portfolio of original, polished work across decks, advertising creative, and brand/logo design.proficiency in adobe creative suite (illustrator, photoshop, indesign) and familiarity with figma and canva.experience keeping brand consistency across multiple distinct brands or clients at the same time.independence: you manage competing priorities across companies and hit deadlines in a fast-paced, evolving environment.strong collaboration and communication skills — comfortable coordinating a distributed freelance network and joining recurring team meetings.comfort with non-traditional, variable hours, and reliable availability for the 7–9 pm pt approval window.salary & benefitslocation: 100% remote — open to candidates in the united states or canada. pacific or mountain time zones strongly preferred; other time zones welcome if you can cover the evening pt window.salary: $90,000 – $110,000 usd per year for u.s.-based candidates (up to $120,000 for exceptional profiles)this is a full-time, long-term remote position, immediately available, reporting directly to the head of portfolio marketing & communications.schedule: variable hours tied to campaign cycles, with a recurring 7–9 pm pt approval window.additional perks and benefits.ready to apply? we'd love to hear your story. the next step is a short application where you can share more about your background and upload your resume, along with a portfolio showing your deck, ad creative and brand identity work. take your time — we read every response carefully.

about the roleyou decide how buck mason sounds and what our content is for. this is more than a copywriting job. you bring a strong point of view on how content should show up across every channel (email, site, social, paid, in-store) and you hold that line. you know menswear and womenswear deeply, you think hard about who our customer is, and you can say what a given piece of content needs to do before you write a word of it. your bar for taste is high, you understand what buck mason stands for, and you hold every piece of content to those first principles. this role is based full time at our los angeles headquarters, in the room with the merchandising, creative, and email teams you'll work with every day.what you'll doset the content strategy across channels: what we say, where, in what voice, and why. own and evolve the brand voice. write the guidelines, then be the example of them. for every brief, define the objective and the customer before the copy: a launch email, a product page, a social post, and a paid ad each have a different job. write the copy: product descriptions, product names, email, site, social, campaign lines, and long-form when a story deserves it. partner with merchandising, design, and marketing teams so product, image, and words all tell one story. build and keep a point of view on product. know the fabric, the make, the fit, and the reason a garment exists, for both men's and women's. turn products into platforms. our core franchises deserve names, language, and ideas that are ours: brandable, ownable, and built to last longer than a season. you help shape a product into a story and help tell that story across channels. help drive gtm storytelling. you help decide what we're saying each month, why it matters to the customer, and how it shows up across every channel, so the calendar is a sequence of stories and not just a list of launches. review content across the brand for consistency and quality, and give direct, useful feedback. own the results. product page conversion, email click rate, and social engagement are how we know the words are working, and you read them every week and adjust. be the reason the brand sounds like one brand. anyone at buck mason should be able to say what our point of view is, and that's your job to make true. who you are4+ years in copywriting, content strategy, or editorial, ideally at an apparel or lifestyle brand with a distinct voice. a clear, well-argued point of view on content. you can explain why a piece works, not only that it does. product obsessed, with deep working knowledge of menswear and womenswear: construction, fabric, fit, and how people actually wear clothes. customer centric. you write for a specific person and you can describe them. an excellent writer with range: tight and plain when the product should speak, warmer and longer when the story earns it. comfortable owning strategy and execution at once. you set the plan and you write the copy. a high bar for taste. you notice when a line, a word, or a layout is slightly off, and you fix it before anyone else sees it. a high bar for brand first principles. you know what the brand is and highly motivated campaign manager to lead the strategy, planning, execution, and optimization of integrated marketing campaigns that support distribution priorities and business growth. this individual will serve as the central orchestrator of multi-channel marketing initiatives, from campaign ideology and planning through in-market execution, performance measurement, and optimization. the ideal candidate is a self-starter who excels at managing complex projects, coordinating cross-functional teams, and leveraging data, technology, and ai-enabled tools to deliver measurable business outcomes.the campaign manager will translate business objectives into audience-centric marketing programs across digital, content, email, social media, webinars, events, and sales enablement channels. this role will partner closely with sales, product marketing, digital marketing, marketing operations, compliance, data, and external vendors to deliver campaigns that drive engagement, lead generation, pipeline growth, and business impact across financial advisors, intermediary platforms, and institutional investors.responsibilitiesjob description lead the end-to-end project management and execution of integrated marketing campaigns aligned to intermediary and institutional business priorities. develop comprehensive campaign plans including objectives, audience segmentation, messaging, channel strategy, timelines, dependencies, resource requirements, and success metrics. serve as the primary coordinator across marketing, sales, product, compliance, data, and operations teams to ensure campaigns are delivered on time, within scope, and aligned with business goals. manage multiple concurrent campaigns and strategic initiatives while maintaining project plans, marketing calendars, stakeholder communications, and workflow processes. translate business strategies into actionable campaign briefs and integrated marketing plans that drive engagement, lead generation, and sales enablement. partner with digital marketing, creative, and marketing operations teams to execute cohesive campaigns across email, web, social media, webinars, thought leadership content, paid media, and events. leverage salesforce financial services & sales cloud, salesforce marketing cloud, agentforce ai, linkedin, seismic, on24, and other marketing technologies to deploy, monitor, and optimize campaign performance. utilize ai-enabled marketing capabilities and emerging technologies to improve campaign planning, audience segmentation, personalization, content recommendations, workflow automation, testing, and performance analysis. establish campaign measurement frameworks and kpi reporting to assess engagement, marketing contribution, lead generation, pipeline impact, and return on investment. analyze campaign performance and audience behavior to identify trends, optimize future campaigns, and present actionable insights to marketing and business leadership. partner with distribution teams to ensure campaign insights, leads, and engagement intelligence are effectively leveraged within the sales process. ensure all marketing activities comply with regulatory and corporate governance requirements by partnering closely with compliance and legal. contribute to the continuous improvement of campaign management processes, project workflows, reporting frameworks, and marketing best practices.knowledge of integrated marketing campaign planning, execution, and measurements across digital, email, social, webinar, event, and content marketing channels. u.s. intermediary and institutional distribution channels, including rias, broker-dealers, wirehouses, consultants, retirement platforms, and institutional investors. marketing automation, lead generation, lead nurturing, customer journey development, and campaign performance optimization. salesforce technologies and ai capabilities, linkedin, seismic, on24, and related sales and marketing technologies. data-driven marketing, audience segmentation, campaign attribution, marketing analytics, and performance reporting. ai applications within marketing, including audience targeting, content development, personalization, predictive insights, workflow automation, and campaign optimization. financial services marketing compliance and regulatory considerations.skills in project management skills with the ability to organize, prioritize, and execute multiple campaigns and initiatives simultaneously. stakeholder management skills with the ability to influence and coordinate cross-functional teams in a matrixed environment. strong analytical skills with the ability to translate campaign data into actionable business recommendations. marketing technology proficiency, including salesforce, marketing automation, webinar, and sales enablement platforms. effective written, verbal, and presentation communication skills with the ability to communicate campaign strategy and results to stakeholders at all levels. demonstrated ability to leverage ai-powered tools and technologies to improve productivity, campaign effectiveness, and marketing outcomes. strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and commitment to execution excellence. proactive, self-motivated mindset with a strong sense of ownership and accountability.ability to lead campaigns from concept through execution, measurement, reporting, and optimization. function as the project manager and central point of coordination across multiple stakeholders and workstreams. balance strategic thinking with hands-on execution and operational excellence. prioritize competing deadlines and adapt to changing business priorities. leverage technology, data, and ai-driven insights to improve campaign effectiveness and business outcomes. identify opportunities for innovation, process improvement, and increased marketing efficiency. work independently with minimal supervision while contributing effectively within collaborative teams.educational/previous experience requirements bachelor's degree in marketing, communications, business, or a related field and a minimum of five (5) years of experience in integrated marketing, campaign management, demand generation, or channel marketing within asset management, wealth management, financial services, or a similarly regulated industry.~or~ any equivalent combination of experience, education and/or training approved by human resources.educationbachelor’s - completed: business administration, bachelor’s - completed: digital communications and media/multimedia, bachelor’s - completed: marketingwork experiencegeneral experience - 6 to 10 yearscertificationstravelless than 25%workstylehybridthe total compensation for this position includes base salary or wages, and may include components such as additional compensation (cash or equity), discretionary bonuses, or commissions. this position is eligible for a benefits package that may include medical, dental, and vision; life insurance; critical illness insurance and accident insurance; disability benefits; retirement savings; paid time off (including vacation, holidays, and sick leave); and parental leave. eligibility for benefits and specific offerings may vary based on position and employment status. to view more details of the benefits offered, visit myrjbenefits.com.at raymond james our associates use five guiding behaviors (develop, collaborate, decide, deliver, improve) to deliver on the firm's core values of client-first, integrity, independence and a conservative, long-term view.we expect our associates at all levels to grow professionally and inspire others to do the same work with and through others to achieve desired outcomes make prompt, pragmatic choices and act with the client in mind take ownership and hold themselves and others accountable for delivering results that matter contribute to the continuous evolution of the firmat raymond james – as part of our people-first culture, we honor, value, and respect the uniqueness, experiences, and backgrounds of all of our associates. when associates bring their best authentic selves, our organization, clients, and communities thrive. the company is an equal opportunity employer and makes all employment decisions on the basis of merit and business needs.

about walkersince 1961, walker therapeutic & educational programs has been a trusted partner for children, youth, and families, navigating some of life’s most difficult challenges. based in needham, our mission is to nurture hope, build strengths, and develop lifelong skills in partnership with the children, youth, families, and communities we serve. we provide comprehensive, trauma-informed residential, educational, and clinical services to children and youth with complex social-emotional, behavioral, and learning needs, while supporting their families every step of the way. through three specialized divisions—residential & educational programs, behavioral health & community-based services, and walker solutions—we deliver relationship-based care and capacity-building that makes a lasting difference. today, we serve children, youth, and families from more than 150 communities across massachusetts.make a difference every daythe director of communications plays a pivotal role in advancing walker’s mission by leading a strategic communications function that elevates the organization’s impact, strengthens its reputation, and deepens engagement with key audiences. through compelling storytelling and effective communication strategies, this role will highlight walker’s innovative programs, dedicated workforce, and measurable outcomes while reinforcing the organization’s commitment to children, youth, families, and communities we serve.reporting directly to the ceo, the director of communications will build and lead a proactive mission-driven communication strategy that supports walker’s organizational priorities, including engagement, philanthropy and fundraising, program growth, advocacy, and community partnerships. this individual will ensure consistent, accessible, and high-quality messaging across all internal and external channels, strengthening alignment among staff, families, donors, partners, and the broader community. the director of communications will also help position walker as a trusted leader in behavioral health, special education, and human services by increasing visibility, enhancing transparency, and supporting communication efforts related to key organizational initiatives and transformational change.essential functionsstrategic communications & organizational messaging develop and implement a comprehensive communications strategy that advances walker’s mission, vision, strategic priorities, and organizational goals.partner with the ceo and strategic leadership team (slt) to develop communication plans supporting key initiatives, organizational change, advocacy efforts, and strategic growth.ensure consistent, mission-driven messaging across all internal and external communication channels.monitor emerging trends and audience needs to proactively shape communication strategies and organizational positioning.serve as an advisor to leadership on communication approaches, messaging, and brand stewardship.brand management, storytelling & content developmentstrengthen and protect walker’s brand identity, voice, and reputation across all platforms and communications materials. develop compelling stories that showcase walker’s impact on children, families, employees, and communities.create, edit, and oversee high-quality communications content including newsletters, annual reports, presentations, digital content, promotional materials, and executive communications.establish editorial standards and ensure communications are accurate, accessible, engaging, and aligned with organizational values.manage a content calendar to support organizational priorities and audience engagement efforts.external relations, media & public affairsserve as the primary point of contact for media inquiries and public communications.develop media relations strategies that increase awareness of walker’s programs, expertise, and community impact.draft press releases, talking points, statements, speeches, and media materials.cultivate and maintain positive relationships with media representatives, community organizations, and key external partners.partner with leadership to develop thoughtful, transparent communications that foster trust, strengthen relationships, and support the organization during periods of change, growth, and matters of public interest.digital communications & marketing channelsoversee walker’s website, social media platforms, and digital communications channels.develop and execute integrated digital communication campaigns that increase engagement, visibility, recruitment, and community awareness.monitor analytics and audience engagement metrics to drive continuous improvement.ensure digital content reflects best practices for accessibility, usability, and brand consistency. evaluate and adopt emerging communication tools and technologies to enhance organizational effectiveness.community engagement, advancement & partnership supportpartner with advancement, program, and slt to support fundraising, donor engagement, and community relations efforts.develop communications materials that strengthen relationships with donors, referral sources, foundations, community partners, and partners.promote walker’s thought leadership and expertise in behavioral health, special education, and human services.support public events, community outreach initiatives, and organizational recognition opportunities.enhance awareness of walker’s services, outcomes, and impact throughout the communities it serves.measurement, evaluation & continuous improvementestablish communication goals, key performance indicators, and reporting mechanisms.analyze communication effectiveness using qualitative and quantitative measures.conduct audience research and gather feedback to inform communication strategies and priorities.regularly assess brand awareness, community engagement, and communication outcomes.provide leadership with recommendations for continuous improvement based on communication performance data.additional duties and responsibilitiesall other duties as assigned. skills and abilitiesexceptional written, verbal, and interpersonal communication skills, with the ability to tailor messages for diverse audiences. strong strategic thinking and planning skills, with the ability to align communications initiatives with organizational priorities and business objectives.demonstrated ability to develop compelling stories and content that communicate mission, impact, and organizational values. excellent editorial, proofreading, and content management skills with a high level of attention to detail.strong presentation and public speaking abilities.ability to advice and coach leadership on messaging, communication strategy, and audience engagement.ability to navigate sensitive situations with professionalism, sound judgment, discretion, and diplomacy.strong collaboration skills and ability to work effectively across departments and organizational levels.creative problem-solving skills and a proactive, solutions-oriented mindset.proven ability to work independently, manage multiple projects, prioritize among competing priorities, and meet deadlines.flexibility to adapt to changing environments and organizational needs.ability to sit at workstation for prolonged periods of time, consistent with osha suggestions and requirements. ability to lift packages up to 25 pounds.ability to travel to multiple building locations on and off campus.schedule:monday-friday, 9:00am-5:00pm; flexibility required for evenings and weekends based on organizational needsqualificationseducation and certificationsrequired:bachelor’s degree in communications, public relations, marketing, journalism, english, business administration, nonprofit management, or a related field.preferred:master’s degree in communications, marketing, public relations, business administration, nonprofit leadership, or a related field.experiencerequired:minimum of 5 years of progressively responsible experience in communications, public relations, marketing, media relations, or corporate communications.minimum of 3 years of leadership experience with responsibility for developing and executing strategic communications initiatives.preferred:6-7 years of communications experience in a nonprofit, healthcare, behavioral health, education, human services, or mission-driven organization.other requirements: successfully complete background check suitability requirementsmust have reliable transportation supervision: supervisor: ceo or designeesupervises: n/aequal opportunity statementwalker is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate based upon an individual's race, color, religion, national origin, sex, age, marital status, sexual orientation, genetic information, disability, veteran status, pregnancy, national guard or reserve unit obligations, participation in discrimination complaint-related activities, or membership in any category protected by federal or state law.

marketing & communications managerwheelchair foundation | danville, californiasalary: $90,000–$120,000 annually, commensurate with experience schedule: full-time | hybrid — 4 days in office, 1 day remote (negotiable) location: danville, caabout wheelchair foundationwheelchair foundation is a nonprofit organization dedicated to providing mobility, dignity, and independence to people living with physical disabilities around the world.since our founding in 2000, we have helped deliver more than 1.25 million wheelchairs to people in need. yet an estimated 130 million people worldwide still need a wheelchair.behind every wheelchair is a person, a family, and a story worth telling. we believe that sharing those stories is one of the most powerful ways to inspire generosity and create lasting change.about the positionwe are seeking a talented, creative, and motivated marketing & communications manager to help shape how wheelchair foundation shares its mission, connects with supporters, and inspires giving.this is a hands-on management role for someone who brings fresh ideas, strong writing and editorial skills, excellent creative judgment, and the ability to turn ideas into meaningful campaigns.working closely with the director of development, the marketing & communications manager will lead the foundation's marketing and communications efforts across digital, print, social media, fundraising campaigns, and special events.we're looking for someone who understands the power of a good story, has an eye for compelling design, and knows how to connect with an audience in a genuine, engaging way.key responsibilitiesmarketing strategy & brand managementdevelop and manage an integrated annual marketing and communications plan that supports fundraising, donor engagement, and organizational growth.maintain a consistent, recognizable brand across all foundation communications.bring fresh ideas and creative direction to campaigns, publications, and outreach efforts.manage marketing projects, timelines, budgets, and outside creative vendors or contractors.content, storytelling & publicationslead the content development, editorial direction, and production of the foundation's print newsletter/magazine, donor communications, and other publications.write and edit compelling stories, fundraising appeals, email campaigns, website content, and promotional materials.work with program teams to identify and share authentic stories of wheelchair recipients, volunteers, and donors.oversee photography, video, and creative assets to ensure high-quality, mission-centered storytelling.digital marketing & social mediadevelop engaging digital campaigns across email, website, and social media channels.guide social media content strategy, including instagram, facebook, linkedin, and emerging platforms.manage email marketing campaigns, audience segmentation, and performance reporting.support website content updates and improvements to the donor experience.monitor campaign performance, engagement, and conversions, using results to continually improve outreach.fundraising, events & donor engagementpartner closely with the director of development on fundraising campaigns, donor cultivation, stewardship, and year-end giving initiatives.develop marketing materials and communications for special events, rotary partnerships, school programs, and wheelchair distributions.create thoughtful, engaging donor communications that build relationships and encourage continued support.help identify new audiences and opportunities to expand the foundation's reach.qualifications & experience5+ years of progressive experience in marketing, communications, or a related field, including experience leading projects, campaigns, or creative teams.nonprofit experience strongly preferred, particularly in fundraising communications, donor engagement, or mission-driven storytelling.exceptional writing, editing, and storytelling abilities.strong understanding of digital marketing, social media, email campaigns, and print publications.excellent creative judgment, with an eye for design, photography, and brand presentation.experience managing multiple projects, deadlines, budgets, and outside vendors.familiarity with canva, constant contact, adobe creative suite, or similar creative and marketing platforms.experience with fundraising crm systems, particularly blackbaud raiser’s edge nxt, is a plus.comfortable analyzing marketing performance and using data to guide decisions.bachelor's degree in marketing, communications, journalism, or a related field preferred.the person we're looking forsomeone who is creative, organized, resourceful, and genuinely passionate about making a difference.you'll be comfortable taking the lead while remaining collaborative, bringing ideas to the table, and rolling up your sleeves to get things done.most importantly, you'll understand that behind every campaign, photograph, and donor communication is an opportunity to connect people with a mission that changes lives.compensation & work environmentannual salary: $90,000–$120,000, commensurate with experience and qualifications.this is a full-time position based at our danville, california office, with a hybrid schedule of four days in person and one remote day per week. flexibility may be negotiated.occasional evening or weekend availability may be required for special events.join us in telling stories that move people—and helping bring the gift of mobility to those who need it most.

communications specialistthe arkansas medical society (ams) is looking for a strong writer with an eye for design to help physicians stay informed, connect with colleagues, and take part in the work of their society. you will work with physicians across arkansas, tell their stories, and make complex issues understandable to the people who need to know about them.ams supports physicians and their patients through advocacy, education, and member services. your work will make those resources easier to find and use, and help members, policymakers, partners, and the public understand issues affecting physicians and patient care.you might interview a physician for the journal, build a campaign for a regional meeting, or edit a short video about an issue affecting medical practices and patient care. you will bring ideas, do the writing and design, and see the work through to publication. this position manages communications projects and publications and has no direct reports. the executive director sets strategy and priorities, and you will work with colleagues and physician leaders to develop accurate, useful content.what you will createproduce the journal and chartnotes, gathering stories, editing contributions, and managing production through proofing and publication.develop membership and event campaigns that explain the value of membership and participation and make it easy to get involved.produce email campaigns, publish website updates, and create social media content, including physician stories, useful resources, and approved advocacy messages.create graphics, print materials, and short videos that fit the audience and purpose.prepare communications for the medical specialty societies ams serves and make sure promised sponsor recognition and advertising are published.the ideal candidateyou write clearly, edit carefully, and can produce finished graphics and layouts. you are familiar with planning, capturing, editing, and sharing short videos. you know that a message for physicians may need a different approach than one for policymakers or the public. your work should sound natural, respect the audience, and get the facts right.you consider measuring impact as a part of the job. you will track email clicks, video engagement, registrations, and audience responses, report what they tell us, and use those findings to improve the next effort. you also take professional pride in your ability to manage deadlines, follow up with contributors, and check the details before publishing.you hold a bachelor’s degree and at least three years of relevant communications or editorial experience. you have strong writing, editing, routine graphic design, email production, website publishing, and social content production capabilities. completed work should demonstrate accuracy, judgment, and deadline management. medical or professional-association experience is preferred.how to applysubmit your résumé and two or three existing work 4485786017.title: Founding Product Marketing Manager (PMM) at VC-backed Startup - NYC (Hybrid)

detail.desc: we’re partnering with a venture-backed consumer travel and social platform to hire its first marketing hire. this role reports directly to the founders and owns positioning, launches, growth loops, content, and lifecycle from scratch. the product already has strong organic pull, and this hire gets to build the brand and growth engine around it.amazing team, backed by top-tier vcs and repeat founders. why joinbe an early builder: shape the product, culture, and direction from the ground up with real ownership over what you buildtackle interesting problems: work across ai, social graphs, and real-world coordination with a modern tech stackcompetitive compensation: salary, benefits, and meaningful equity so you share in what the team builds togetherbacked by top angels: supported by founders and operators from leading consumer and travel tech companiesabout the rolethe company is looking for a founding product marketing manager to own how it goes to market, grows, and talks to the world. as the first marketing hire, you’ll define the narrative, build the growth engine from scratch, and sit at the intersection of product, brand, and user acquisition. you’ll work directly with the founders to turn an early product with strong organic pull into a category-defining consumer brand.what you’ll doown positioning & messaging: define how the company talks about the product across every touchpoint: website, app store, product onboarding, social, and press. turn complex product capabilities into simple, resonant stories that make people say “i need this.”drive product launches: quarterback major feature and product launches end-to-end, from narrative and creative assets to distribution channels, creator/community seeding, and post-launch analysis.architect the growth & viral loops: partner closely with product and engineering to design, test, and optimize in-product growth loops (invites, trip sharing, calendar sync, group coordination) that turn every user into a distribution channel.build the content & social engine: establish the brand’s voice across social channels (instagram, tiktok, x, linkedin), newsletter, and community spaces. work with creators, travel tastemakers, and super-connectors to seed organic adoption.own lifecycle & activation: build automated and high-touch lifecycle journeys (onboarding emails, push notifications, seasonal moments) that get users to their “aha” moment fast and keep them coming back before every trip.supply-side & ecosystem marketing: help launch and grow the marketplace and partner ecosystem, crafting the value proposition for curated properties, experience hosts, and travel brands joining the platform.run rapid experiments: continuously test channels, hooks, landing pages, and referral mechanics. measure what matters, kill what doesn’t work, and double down on what compounds.who you are3–7+ years in product marketing, growth marketing, or founding marketer roles at a high-velocity b2c consumer app, social platform, or marketplace (travel, lifestyle, social, creator economy, or prosumer tools are a big plus).a sharp storyteller with great taste: you write crisp, human copy with zero corporate fluff. you have an instinctive eye for design, aesthetics, and cultural relevance; you know what makes a consumer brand feel magnetic.product-obsessed & analytical: you’re just as comfortable in figma and writing launch copy as you are digging into analytics (activation rates, dau/mau, retention cohorts) to figure out why users drop off or share.ai-native operator: you leverage modern ai tools (llms, image/video generation, workflow automation) to move 5x faster, whether prototyping creative, scaling content, or automating growth ops.zero-to-one builder: you thrive in ambiguity, don’t wait for a playbook, and love getting your hands dirty. you’d rather ship a scrappy experiment today than spend three weeks on a strategy deck.deeply connected to how people travel and gather: you’re the person in your friend group who organizes the trip, knows the best spots, or loves connecting people across cities.requires existing us work authorization. reach out if you have any questions or are open to hearing about other opportunities!

hi! 👋 i'm chris, head of product design at ashby.we're looking for a versatile, intrinsically motivated designer who is excited to contribute to rethinking how modern software is designed. at ashby, you'll be part designer, part product manager, part consultant, and part design system manager (or some combination of the 4!). we do design differently here, and if that excites you, read on.our unique approach is working - we're growing >100% year-over-year and have notable customers like notion, linear, shopify, and snowflake. our growth and retention metrics are best-in-class among our peers: we have tens of millions in arr, very low churn, and many years of runway. we're backed by amazing investors like y combinator, elad gil, lachy groom, and many more! we’ll share more details once we meet.how we workin my previous roles, product teams always consisted of a product manager, a designer, and ~4-5 engineers. this may sound familiar to you! the product manager briefs the designer who then designs. after designing, mocks are handed to the engineers.we take a more principled approach here at ashby. if you've been designing software enough, you'll realize in actuality, design is required in varying degrees on each project. sometimes in the past, i'd be asked to design yet another settings page, when really all that was needed was an engineer to reuse existing components and just follow some documentation i had written. other times, i felt i should effectively be the product manager and own a project from beginning to end. in these latter cases, it made sense that i was even the one providing project updates and managing resources rather than constantly being pinged by a separate product manager.this principled approach is now what we do here, and it is part of what has allowed ashby to take down incumbents in multiple verticals all at once. we don't settle for the status quo—we actively resist reversion to the mean.currently, i report to benji, the co-founder & ceo. both abhik and benji (our founders) care deeply about design, which at first glance may seem counterintuitive given the number of full-time designers that we employ. the belief is not that design is unimportant, but rather that it should be owned by the product team collectively, not solely by a group of full-time designers who happen to have the job title.the design department’s job at ashby is not to make every single design decision but to equip our entire product team to make better decisions themselves, as well as edit decisions that pms/engineers choose to make. that, while tackling the biggest design challenges ourselves.separate from design, you may also be excited by the fact that we maintain a near seed-stage-like culture with fuzzy lines between functional roles, as much autonomy as you can handle, and a focus on ic-work with an almost-no-meeting culture. while you get the product-market fit and scale of a growth-stage startup, you also get the agency and no-nonsense, no-red-tape culture of a seed-stage startup.what we’re buildingtalent teams aspire to build a hiring process that identifies great candidates, moves them quickly through the interview process, and provides an excellent experience for the candidate. to accomplish this, recruiters perform thousands of daily tasks to coordinate and relay information between candidates, interviewers, and hiring managers. teams struggle to keep up!scheduling a final round is an excellent example of our customers' challenges. a recruiter needs to collect availability from the blazing fast internal and customer-facing analytics experiences. we're building a cloud-hosted version of duckdb, working hand-in-hand with the creators of the fastest-growing and fastest-improving query engine on the planet. unlike other databases, motherduck was architected to unify local development with cloud operations to bridge the gap between software and data engineering workflows. our team is a mix of thoughtful, passionate, and empathetic data industry veterans.what you will dowe’re looking for a product marketer who lives at the intersection of words, product, and customers. you’ll take what our engineers build and turn it into stories that make developers and data teams lean in. you’ll own positioning and messaging, write the pages people actually read, and make sure our sales team walks into every conversation ready.this role can be based in our seattle, san francisco or new york city office.key responsibilitieswrite. a lot. website copy, landing pages, launch posts, product one-pagers, emails. you care about every word and you know when to cut. help shape how we tell our story. work alongside product, sales, and leadership on who we’re for, why we’re different, and how to say it in a way a data engineer won’t roll their eyes at... then keep it fresh as the product and market evolve. build the web and the artifacts. ship landing pages, comparison pages, demos and interactive assets... ideally hands-on with ai tools rather than waiting in a queue for design and eng. arm the sales team. create battlecards, pitch decks, objection handling, and competitive takes that aes and customer engineers actually use in deals. sit in on calls and bring what you hear back into the messaging. run launches. plan and ship product launches end to end with product, engineering, devrel and growth. stay close to customers and the market. talk to users, track competitors (snowflake, databricks, bigquery and friends), and turn what you learn into sharper stories. work ai-first. use claude and other tools to research, draft, prototype and ship. help set the bar for how marketing at motherduck uses ai. what you bring3 to 10 years in product marketing, ideally at a b2b software or developer-focused companyexcellent writing. clear, punchy, and specific... you can make a technical idea land in one sentencea real knack for positioning: you've taken a product to market and can show the before and afterexperience building web pages and landing pages, and comfort shipping them yourself with modern toolsa track record of sales enablement that sales teams actually usedgenuine curiosity about technical products. you don't need to write sql for a living, but you want to understand how the thing worksai fluency. you already use ai daily to do better work, and you're excited to push that furthera bias for action. you'd rather ship a good version this week than a perfect one next quarterwhat people should be saying if you’re doing ducking awesome“i sent communications experience and expertise to elevate the external profile of a global leader in the testing, inspection, and certification industry.we are hiring a corporate communications lead, executive visibility & thought leadership, reporting to the director of executive and business communications. this role drives proactive external visibility for senior business leaders by translating complex technical topics related to global megatrends (energy transition/electrification, ai/digitalization and sustainability) into high-impact thought leadership, executive positioning and engagement opportunities.the corporate communications lead will also manage select internal communications for the business, providing strategic counsel and communications support for business- or enterprise-wide change-management and business-transformation programs.the ideal candidate is a seasoned and versatile communications professional and writer with experience in corporate media relations, executive communications and speechwriting, social media strategies, and internal corporate communications. a journalism background is a plus but not required. in-house corporate communications experience is essential.this position enables senior leaders to engage effectively with customers, industry, government, and academic audiences across key business verticals. this hybrid role requires working from the office three days per week.responsibilitieslead executive visibility programs for senior business leaders and technical experts, including media placements and speaking engagements aligned to priority verticals. develop message architecture and storylines that translate business priorities and technical content into clear, credible external narratives. develop executive briefings, talk tracks, interview preparation materials and other assets that ensure leaders are ready, confident and message‑aligned. collaborate closely with corporate communications’ agency partner to support external thought‑leadership opportunities tied to business priorities. partner with contributed‑content team to support development of bylined articles and trade‑media thought leadership. coordinate with external communications to ensure engagements, materials and messaging are consistent with outreach plans and approved guidance. use established decision-making and escalation guidelines to determine when activities can proceed and when additional leadership alignment is required. track and report on executive visibility activity and outcomes in support of monthly vertical updates. qualificationsproven experience supporting senior leaders (vp/svp/evp or equivalent) with executive communications, thought leadership or external visibility programs. ability to synthesize complex technical subject matter into concise, externally relevant messages for diverse audiences. excellent writing and editing skills across executive communications formats (e.g., speeches, talking points, briefing documents, social media posts, etc.). sound judgment and discretion when handling sensitive topics. ability to operate independently in a fast‑paced, matrixed environment. 7+ years of corporate communications experience. bachelor’s degree in communications, journalism, business, or a related field. what you’ll experience working for ulsul solutions has been pioneering change since 1894 and we’re still leading the way. from day one, we’ve blazed a trail protecting the planet and everyone on it. our teams have influenced billions of products, plus services, software offerings and more. we break things, burn things and blow things up. all in the name of safety science.that’s where you come in — because none of it could happen without you. it takes passion to protect people, problem-solving to safeguard personal data and conviction to make the world a more sustainable place. it takes bold ideas and brilliant minds to build a better world for future generations across the globe.this is more than a job. it’s a calling. a passion to use our expertise and play our part in creating a more secure, sustainable world today — and tomorrow. as a member of our safety science community, you’ll use your ideas, your energy and your ambition to innovate, challenge and ultimately, help create a safer world.everyone here is unique. but we’re also a global community, working together to help create a safer world. join ul solutions and you can connect with the brightest minds in the business, all bringing their distinct perspectives and diverse backgrounds together to deliver real change.empowering our customers to keep the world safe means thinking ahead. it means investing in training and empowering our people to learn and innovate. at ul solutions, we help build a better future — one where everyone benefits.join ul solutions to be at the center of safety. to learn more about us and the work we do, visit  ul.comtotal rewards: we understand compensation is an important factor as you consider the next step in your career. the estimated salary range for this position is $120,000 to $150,000 and is based on multiple factors, including job-related knowledge/skills, experience, geographical location, as well as other factors. this position is eligible for annual bonus compensation with a target payout of 20% of the base salary. this position also provides health benefits such as medical, dental and vision; wellness benefits such as mental and financial health; and retirement savings (401k) commensurate with the standard rewards offered in each individual location or country. we also provide full-time employees with paid time off including vacation (15 days), holiday including floating holidays (12 days) and sick time off (72 hours).about usa global leader in applied safety science, ul solutions (nyse: uls) transforms safety, security and sustainability challenges into opportunities for customers in more than 110 countries. ul solutions delivers testing, inspection and certification services, together with software products and advisory offerings, that support our customers’ product innovation and business growth. the ul mark serves as a recognized symbol of trust in our customers’ products and reflects an unwavering commitment to advancing our safety mission. we help our customers innovate, launch new products and services, navigate global markets and complex supply chains, and grow sustainably and responsibly into the future. our science is your advantage.

strategies that build brand equity, accelerate household penetration, drive profitable growth, and strengthen the brand’s position as an authority in louisiana-inspired food.given we are a growing cpg organization, this is a hands-on leadership role. the successful candidate will be equally comfortable developing a three-year brand strategy, analyzing syndicated data, leading an innovation pipeline, briefing a creative agency, evaluating packaging, and partnering with sales to prepare for an important customer presentation.key responsibilitiesbrand strategy & business leadershipdevelop and lead the annual and long-range brand strategy, positioning, growth priorities, and marketing plans.translate consumer, category, competitive, and customer insights into clear strategies and actionable growth initiatives.own ongoing analysis of brand, category, consumer, competitive, and syndicated data to identify performance trends, growth opportunities, risks, and recommended actions.own the annual brand planning process, including objectives, strategies, marketing calendar, investment priorities, and kpis.partner with sales, finance, operations, r&d, and supply chain to develop and execute initiatives supporting revenue, volume, distribution, and profitability objectives.marketing strategy & executionlead the development and execution of integrated marketing programs across consumer advertising, social media, digital, retail media, shopper marketing, pr, promotions, e-commerce, experiential marketing, and packaging.develop compelling briefs and lead agency partners from strategy through execution.drive a consistent brand identity, positioning, voice, and visual expression across consumer and customer touchpoints.develop retailer-specific marketing programs with sales and e-commerce partners, including activation through retail media networks.establish clear kpis and continually evaluate marketing effectiveness and roi to improve future investment decisions.manage the brand marketing budget and ensure resources are focused against the highest-growth opportunities.innovation & portfolio strategylead the innovation strategy and portfolio pipeline, identifying opportunities grounded in consumer needs, food trends, category whitespace, and the brand’s right to win.develop and manage a multi-year innovation pipeline across new products, line extensions, packaging, renovation, and adjacent categories.lead consumer research, concept development, positioning, naming, packaging, pricing, and commercialization recommendations.build strong business cases for innovation, including consumer rationale, market potential, pricing, volume assumptions, margins, investment requirements, and key risks.regularly assess existing product portfolio and recommend opportunities to invest, renovate, reposition, or rationalize products based on consumer demand, brand strategy, financial performance, and operational considerations.leadership & cross-functional collaborationserve as a key marketing leader and advocate for the consumer across the organization.champion the practical application of ai across brand marketing and innovation, identifying opportunities to accelerate strategic planning, insight generation, content development, innovation, analysis, and marketing execution.build strong relationships with external agency partners.bring urgency, curiosity, resourcefulness, and an owner's mindset to a fast-moving entrepreneurial organization.qualificationsbachelor's degree in marketing, business, or related field; mba preferred.8+ years of progressive brand marketing experience, ideally within food, beverage, or consumer packaged goods.demonstrated experience developing brand strategy and personally driving execution.strong experience with innovation, new product development, commercialization, and stage-gate processes.experience with consumer insights, syndicated data, and retailer/customer data.strong understanding of the modern cpg marketing ecosystem, including digital, social, shopper marketing, retail media, e-commerce, and traditional marketing.demonstrated experience using ai and generative ai tools is strongly preferred, with the ability to incorporate ai into consumer and competitive analysis, insight development, brand strategy, creative development, agency briefing, innovation, concept development, and business presentations.strong financial and analytical capabilities with experience managing budgets, p&ls, business cases, and marketing roi.excellent communication, executive presence, and ability to influence cross-functional teams.comfortable operating in a lean, entrepreneurial environment where leaders are expected to both develop strategy and execute it.we are proudly us-owned and us-made. in fact, our plant and headquarters are still located right where we started, in baton rouge.in 1982, louisiana fish fry products was established to bring the true taste of louisiana to a wider audience, with cajun-inspired products that are authentic and easy to prepare. it started with fry mixes, then expanded to base mixes for louisiana favorites like jambalaya and etouffée, followed by seafood boil, sauces and gravy mixes. louisiana fish fry products has since seen steady growth in both the retail and foodservice industry.today, louisiana fish fry products still proudly calls baton rouge, louisiana home. nearly forty years later, that same commitment to selling authentic louisiana-style dishes made from only the finest, high-quality ingredients still proudly inspires everything we do.
