brooklyn sports & entertainment creates bold, authentic, and unforgettable experiences that redefine sports, entertainment, and hospitality, the brooklyn way. as the parent company of marquee properties including the brooklyn nets, ny liberty and barclays center, brooklyn sports & entertainment operates at the intersection of live entertainment, premium hospitality, and community engagement.as it expands its existing portfolio, brooklyn sports & entertainment now includes bk mag, brooklyn wine club, and a hospitality business developing several location-based entertainment properties.whether on the court, on stage, or in the workplace, brooklyn sports & entertainment is driven by a pursuit of excellence—constantly evolving, innovating, and pushing boundaries to elevate its business and expand its fan base. the company is deeply committed to fostering a culture of belonging and inclusion, both internally and across its communities, ensuring that every interaction reflects its values of growth mindset, integrity, accountability and care.we are guided by our core valuesintegrity: be intellectually honest at all times. demonstrate the highest professional and ethical standards. care: care for everything and everyone around us. practice empathy, respect, and inclusion to promote an environment of excellence and success. growth mindset: develop ourselves and those around us. experiment, learn, and improve from everything we do. accountability: deliver on our word, take responsibility for our actions, and work in the interest of our team. summaryour fellowship program brings together recent graduates who have an interest in working in the sports and entertainment industry. standout applicants will embody the spirit and values of brooklyn sports & entertainment: accountability, growth mindset, integrity, and care.the program supports brooklyn sports & entertainment’s commitment to developing diverse leaders and making impactful strides in the world of sports and entertainment.program overviewthe fellowship is a 12-month paid program for motivated and innovative recent college graduates. it is designed to build core skills, gain business insights, and get exposure to the many facets of brooklyn sports & entertainment.the external affairs fellow will provide support to three key functions: external communications, internal communications and community impact. during their fellowship program, they will work on key priorities for the communications and community relations departments including media tracking, internal and external storytelling support, drafting materials, assisting in planning and executing community events and engaging in stakeholder management.key responsibilitiesexternal communications - support the brooklyn sports & entertainment communications team in executing corporate communications across the platform — including the brooklyn nets, new york liberty, barclays center, and brooklyn sports and entertainment’s expanding ventures in sports, entertainment, and hospitality. the role will also support storytelling around the liberty and nets’ on- and off-court success, concerts and cultural moments at barclays center, and business milestones across the organization. responsibilities may include: monitor and compile daily media coverage across sports, entertainment, and business outlets coordinate with promotors and onsite staffing for barclays center concerts – including evening and weekend events  draft press materials, such as releases, media alerts, and executive bios  support game-day and event media operations  assist with media recaps and communications reports  research and develop unique story angles to elevate brooklyn sports & entertainment, nets and liberty  support executive thought leadership efforts, including searching for opportunities to highlight brooklyn sports & entertainment leadership and preparing brief materials to support executives internal communications - assist with developing content for weekly communications, including newsletter, slack posts, emails, etc. and support communications campaigns across brooklyn sports & entertainment. help maintain internal comms editorial calendar and processes. draft content for brooklyn sports & entertainment’s linkedin pages and partner with page managers across the organization to coordinate and promote posts. support ongoing updates on brooklyn sports & entertainment’s external websites and intranet. assist with employee recognition program by developing employee features and spotlights and supporting internal nomination processes. maintain industry awards calendar, research awards opportunities, and draft nominations. support internal, employee-facing events. community impact - community event support & execution assist in planning and executing programs and events. responsibilities include coordinating logistics, managing event materials, and serving as an on-site liaison to ensure smooth operations and positive community engagement. local partner engagement  build and maintain relationships with local nonprofits, schools, and community organizations. help schedule meetings, prepare briefing materials, and support collaborative programming such as mentorship sessions or donation drives. volunteer coordination & outreach  support internal volunteer initiatives by organizing staff participation in local service projects (e.g., food bank visits, park beautification efforts). maintain volunteer rosters, track participation, and help recognize employee contributions. community communications & impact tracking  draft newsletters and recaps that highlight brooklyn sports & entertainment’s community impact. capture photos and quotes from events to help tell authentic stories about the organization’s work in brooklyn. help compile monthly reports that summarize outreach activities, attendance, and qualitative impact stories to share with internal stakeholders. donation & ticket program management  assist with the administration of community ticket programs, including tracking requests and coordinating distribution. support in-kind donation efforts by preparing and managing inventory. who you aresomeone who demonstrates our company's core values of: accountability, growth mindset, integrity, and care a highly proactive, thoughtful team member with an excitement to learn and grow professionally must have a passion for the culture of sports as a vehicle through which to lift people up able to work full time and stay engaged during the duration of our program an excellent communicator who enjoys relationship building, collaborating cross functionally in a fast-paced environment, and championing culture within a group setting demonstrated connection and commitment to brooklyn ability to excel in performance under high pressured environments and time constraints detail oriented, organized and able to work autonomously applicants must have prior work experience in the department to which they apply. prior work experience can include internships, projects, volunteer work, involvement in paid and unpaid activities of significance. legally authorized to work in the us for any employer program durationjune 2027 – may 2028program benefitswork experience: each fellow will rotate through several areas within a department or focus area to get a robust understanding of that area; fellows will have an opportunity to learn from various teams and work on cross-departmental projectscustom curriculum: tailored programming, workshops, and external eventsnetworking: access to internal and external networking opportunitiescareer advancement: early access to full-time roles within bsementorship: access to brooklyn sports & entertainment's mentorship program and peer-to-peer mentorshipcompensation: the fellowship is paid, and fellows are benefits eligible for our competitive packageshow to applythe fellowship program will be accepting applications until tuesday, november 17th. to apply, please submit the below documents:resume: attach a resumestatement of intent (attached as a cover letter to your application): how will you contribute to brooklyn sports & entertainment's values in both the short and long term? how will your participation in the fellowship program help you achieve your personal and professional goals? please submit a brief essay (no more than 500 words).please note: you can only apply for one opportunity within one of the five departments. please be thoughtful in your selection.salary$20.00 per hour + corporate benefitswork environmentthis position primarily works in an office environment; however, our program fellows may be expected to attend games and events in a working capacity. games and events may take place on evenings, weekends and holidays.we are an equal employment opportunity (“eeo”) employer. it has been and will continue to be a fundamental policy of the company not to discriminate on the basis of race, color, creed, religion/creed, gender, gender identity, transgender status, pregnancy and lactation accommodations, marital status, partnership status, domestic violence victim status, sexual orientation, age, national origin, alienage, immigration, or citizenship status, veteran or military status, disability, genetic information, height and weight, arrest or conviction record, caregiver status, credit history, unemployment status, sexual and reproductive health decisions, salary history, status as a victim of domestic violence, stalking, and sex offenses, or any other characteristic prohibited by federal, state or local laws.

singularity is an aerospace and defense startup headquartered in gardena, ca. our founding team hails from spacex, anduril, and lockheed martin, and we are backed by joint staff-level military leadership and several silicon valley firms. our first product is a low-cost air defense system built for immediate deployment worldwide. with a world-class business development and leadership team already in place, we are well positioned to capitalize on already overwhelming demand.position summarythe marketing & communications manager will lead day-to-day marketing and communications for singularity defense, from strategy through hands-on execution. as the company's first hire in this function, the manager will build the company’s visual brand and messaging, take ownership of creative production and other work currently handled by an outside agency, lead trade show and media presence, and equip business development with the materials it needs to win. the role works directly with executive leadership, program teams, and business development, and ensures all external communications comply with export control requirements.key responsibilitiesstrategy: develop and execute the marketing and communications strategy aligned with the product roadmap and bd priorities.brand & content: maintain and apply brand standards and messaging across all channels. own the website, linkedin and social channels, newsletters, data sheets, case studies, and other collateral, writing and producing much of it directly.creative & visual brand: build the company’s visual brand and own creative production, including photo and video of the team and major milestones. manage productions such as product launch videos, working with outside vendors as needed.public relations: write and distribute press releases and build relationships with defense trade press, industry analysts, and partner communications teams.trade shows & events: coordinate cross-functional marketing campaigns, advertising efforts, and events, including the company's presence at industry trade shows, conferences, and partner events (e.g., ausa, sea-air-space, space and missile defense symposium, afa warfare symposium), such as booth strategy, executive briefings, and supporting collateral.bd & capture support: partner with business development on pitch materials, customer briefings, and proposal content.performance reporting: track engagement metrics and campaign performance, and report results to leadership to inform future strategy.regulatory compliance: coordinate with legal, security, and export control functions to ensure that all external communications comply with itar, ear, and other applicable regulations governing defense-related content. review photo, video, and other visual content with legal and security before release.internal communications: support internal communications on company strategy and major announcements.build the function: manage existing agency relationships, transition agency-managed work, including creative, in-house, and manage the agency relationship through the handoff, oversee the marketing tool stack and budget, and help define future hiring needs as the company grows.core skills neededcommunication: exceptional written, verbal, and editorial abilities, with demonstrated capacity to translate complex technical information for a range of audiences.project management: strong organizational skills with a demonstrated ability to manage multiple deadlines and cross-functional projects concurrently.digital tools: proficiency with web content management systems, marketing automation and crm platforms (e.g., hubspot, salesforce), and social media management tools.data analysis: ability to review performance metrics and apply findings to optimize the effectiveness of future campaigns.self-starter: comfortable operating as the sole in-house marketing resource.creative direction: experience directing photo and video production, in-house or through vendors, and a strong visual sense for brand.required qualificationsbachelor's degree in marketing, communications, public relations, journalism, or a related field, or equivalent experience.five or more years of progressive experience in marketing, communications, or public relations, including meaningful experience within aerospace, defense, government contracting, or another highly regulated industry.demonstrated experience developing go-to-market and communications strategy for technical or complex products.experience building or significantly scaling a marketing function at an early-stage or growth-stage company.working knowledge of export control considerations (itar/ear) as applicable to marketing and public communications, or a demonstrated ability to acquire such knowledge promptly.superior writing, editing, and executive-communication skills, with the ability to translate technical content for varied audiences.experience planning and executing a company's presence at industry trade shows and conferences.u.s. person status as defined under itar (u.s. citizen, lawful permanent resident, or protected individual), owing to this position's access to export-controlled information.preferred qualificationsexisting relationships with aerospace and defense trade media, industry analysts, or professional associations.experience working directly with business development, capture, or proposal teams within a government contracting environment.prior experience with a defense prime, government agency, or technology company serving the defense sector.familiarity with brand and digital marketing platforms, including content management systems, marketing automation, customer relationship management, and analytics tools.compensation & benefitssalary range: $140,000 – 185,000 plus performance-based incentives.comprehensive health, dental, and vision benefits.401(k) retirement plan with company match.support for professional development and participation in industry conferences.equity participation.opportunity to grow your role and responsibilities as the marketing team expands.the opportunity to help build the marketing function at a growing defense technology company.

team puts ai to work — using it as a force multiplier across the content lifecycle to speed up output and raise quality at every stage you touch. the role spans two complementary domains: external detail.desc: you've moved past asking ai to write a first draft. you build the workflows, check the claims, and ship the campaign yourself. here, that hands-on approach is the operating model for digital engagement across nine scholarship granting organizations, not a side project inside a staff-led department.stealth educational startup is recruiting for a marketing operation that supports nine sgos and their scholarship fundraising for k-12 students. each nonprofit has its own executive director, audiences, and priorities. your job is to turn those differences into clear positioning, channel budgets, and campaigns that produce measurable fundraising results. the work supports a $1b+ educational freedom tax credit (eftc) fundraising plan; that is the wider business ambition, not your personal fundraising quota.you might start a day agreeing a channel budget with an ed, then build an ai workflow for donor content, correct an unsupported claim before expert review, and finish by tracing campaign results through the crm. you own the production system and the decisions it informs. partnership operations, connectors, and expert reviewers report to you, but they don't replace doing the marketing work with ai. you work with the nine eds as internal clients.the opportunity is to turn individual campaign wins into a repeatable digital engagement operation: better workflows, sharper spending decisions, and evidence of what brings in donors. this is a full-time, remote role in the united states. if you want to build the machinery and answer for what it delivers, apply.what you will be doingset each sgo's marketing strategy, plan, and channel budgets with its ed, while owning brand and messaging across all nine.personally build, run, and verify generative ai workflows for ed-authored content, partner pitch materials, and campaign kits; secure the eds' podcast and press bookings through public relations and media outreach.run search engine optimization (seo) and generative engine optimization (geo) across nine websites, coordinating the expert reviewers who sign off on content.operate paid media, events and opt-in crm, email marketing and sms (text) campaigns for applicants, donors and signups, with marketing automation and conversion tracking that connects activity to results.own marketing technology and vendors; oversee partnership operations, connectors and reviewers; and use fundraising results, donor acquisition cost and channel effectiveness to improve the operation within counsel's compliance boundaries.what you won’t be doingsetting strategy and handing production to a conventional marketing staff.treating ai-generated claims as verified facts or making legal decisions outside counsel's guidance.reporting reach and impressions as substitutes for fundraising results.producing workplace sales collateral; workplace creates its own sales materials.carrying the wider $1b+ fundraising plan as a personal quota.director of digital engagement key responsibilitiesdeliver measurable fundraising growth and efficient donor acquisition across nine nonprofit sgos through a hands-on, ai-first digital engagement operation.basic requirementsbased in the united states and available for a remote role, 40 hours per week.experience owning marketing plans and channel budgets (marketing budget management), including audience choices, spending decisions, and acquisition or fundraising measurement.personal, hands-on use of generative ai (e.g. claude, chatgpt, n8n, zapier, make, etc.) in live marketing production, with identifiable tools, source inputs, delivered outputs and human review steps.ownership of brand positioning or messaging that has been deployed through content or campaigns.delivery experience in both paid acquisition (paid search and paid social) and opt-in email or sms lifecycle marketing, including platform use, consent handling and performance measurement.practical use of crm and analytics tools (e.g., salesforce or hubspot; google analytics 4 and google tag manager) to connect campaigns with acquisition, conversion or fundraising outcomes.experience overseeing vendors or specialist operational or review contributors, including their responsibilities and approval processes (vendor management).nice-to-have requirementsexperience marketing for scholarship organizations, nonprofit fundraising initiatives or other donor-supported programs.experience coordinating distinct brands or executive voices across multiple organizations (multi-brand marketing).hands-on experience with seo/geo programs, expert-reviewed content or executive podcast and press outreach.experience marketing for scholarship organizations, nonprofit fundraising initiatives, or other donor-supported programs, including donor crms such as raiser’s edge nxt or bloomerang.about stealth educational startupwe are a stealth educational startup in austin, tx (center of educational innovation in us). we are building an online community focusing on the most underserved customer base in us education - gifted and talented kids. we are a remote first company who hires globally via crossover.there is so much to cover for this exciting role, and space here is limited. hit the apply button if you found this interesting and want to learn more. we look forward to meeting you!working with usthis is a full-time (40 hours per week), long-term position. the position is immediately available and requires entering into an independent contractor agreement with crossover as a contractor of record. the compensation level for this role is $112 usd/hour, which equates to $225,000 usd/year assuming 40 hours per week and 50 weeks per year. the payment period is weekly. consult www.crossover.com/help-and-faqs for more details on this topic.crossover job code: lj-5863-us-seattle-directorofdigi

perfect. let's talk.the weber shandwick collective (twsc) is looking for an associate creative director — art or copy, we're open — who lives and breathes the internet. if you have a running theory about the next big tiktok trend, can spot the next biggest creator or meme format before it's viral, and obsess over how to break through in the new media landscape, you might just have found your calling.this is a role for someone who wants their fingerprints on some of the biggest brands in the world, and who's ready to move from executing great work to shaping it. you'll bring ideas to the table that spark joy, ignite shares, and earn a permanent spot in people's lives. we want the kind of ideas that don't just ride a wave, but that create one.let's be clear: this is not the job where you're cranking out uninspired work and the same old rinse-and-repeat ideas. this is the job, and the agency, where ideas meet cultural currency. where you'll help create the campaign that everyone shares before lunch. where ideas become award-winning work that's discussed around the country.this role is built for the senior art director or senior copywriter ready to make the jump, or the acd who wants a bigger canvas and a shorter distance between their idea and the work going live.so, let's talk specifics.what you'll domake the work: you'll be hands-on, concepting and building attention-grabbing ideas from blank page to finished craft. you'll work alongside strategy, account, media relations, and analytics to make sure your ideas feed algorithms and transcend platforms. sharpen the idea, balancing craft and strategy: whether your instrument is a headline or a layout, you'll help guard the voice and visual identity of every brand you touch. stay playful, but always purposeful. your work won't just entertain, it'll deliver results. bring others up with you: you'll mentor junior creatives and help set the bar on craft — not by managing from a distance, but by being in the work next to them. be the pulse of culture: research platforms, subcultures, emerging media, and niche communities to unearth untapped opportunities. you need to know before anyone else what gens alpha and z are doing on social channels, why brands are jumping all over a meme, what conversations are capturing the attention of journalists (and why), and who is poised to become the next big thing in the cultural conversation. these inputs will shape the ideas you develop and bring to teams and clients. help sell it: you'll present your thinking with conviction — internally, and increasingly in the room with clients. what you'll bringobsessive curiosity: about trends, people, platforms, memes, and the mechanics of why certain things just work. a social media sixth sense: you know which platforms matter most, what kind of content works where, and how to surprise people in their scroll. pop culture proficiency: from mainstream moments to niche internet corners, you stay plugged into what everyone's talking about, and what they're about to. experience: 5–8 years in art direction, design, or copywriting — especially if you've worked on earned, digital, and social-first campaigns, or for culturally relevant brands. craft, whichever your discipline: if you're an art director, you'll need to work quickly and accurately across adobe creative suite (photoshop, indesign, illustrator) and presentation software (powerpoint). bonus points for illustration, after effects, photography, retouching, filmmaking, videography, editorial, animation, html. if you're a copywriter, you'll need range — from a scroll-stopping caption to a script to a manifesto that actually means something — and the instinct to know which the moment calls for. a sense of humor: if you can't laugh at yourself (or at least at the internet), we're not the place for you. why you'll love it here (other than the snacks)you'll work with some of the best creatives in the business, a team fueled by bold ideas, cultural insights, and enough caffeine to power a small city. you'll have the freedom to experiment, fail forward, and redefine what “earned-first creativity” means. you'll create work that matters to brands, to audiences, and to culture at large. you'll get real runway. this is a step-up role, and we treat it like one — with the mentorship, the reps, and the visibility to grow into what's next. final thought (because we're big on storytelling)this job isn't just about being clever. it's about becoming the creative who reshapes how brands communicate in this endlessly scrolling, algorithm-ruled world. it's about showing up every day with fresh ideas and a love for the craft. and maybe, just maybe, it's about finally justifying all the hours you spend on tiktok.if this sounds like you, let's create something worth bookmarking.send us your portfolio, résumé, and a list of the accounts and trends you're loving right now. because if we're going to shape culture, we want to detail.desc: scholarship funding follows trust. donors give to people they believe, and partners open their audiences only to leaders they'd vouch for. this role is that leader: the public voice of gifted education, accountable for turning that credibility into donations.gifted and talented scholarships is a nonprofit scholarship granting organization funding k-12 scholarships for gifted and talented students. starting january 1, 2027, individuals can claim a federal tax credit for cash donations to approved scholarship granting organizations in participating states. as director of external affairs, you will build the external engine that turns that opening into funding: a credible media presence, speaking platforms and partnerships with companies, associations, organizations and content creators.you set the agenda and own the result. you decide which partners to pursue and which stages to take, negotiate and sign the agreements, and activate them into donor campaigns. then you read the attribution data and put your effort where it raises money. accuracy is part of the job. every public claim you make or approve about gifted identification, school options and tax treatment has to hold up, and anything that needs legal review gets it.an operations partner runs scholarship awards, compliance and finances, so your attention stays external. this is full-time remote work in the united states, 40 hours per week. if you want to be the face of a mission and be held to the dollars it raises, apply.what you will be doingserve as the principal spokesperson for gifted education: pitch reporters, lead tv, radio, print, podcast and online interviews, and headline conferences, member meetings, webinars and community events.set the message: produce video and social content, review public materials for factual accuracy, and answer live questions from approved messaging, bringing in legal review when a question calls for it.build the partnership portfolio: identify, approach and win companies, associations, organizations and media influencers whose audiences include gifted students, families and educators.negotiate and close the agreements, including paid influencer arrangements, that commit partners to asking their members, employees, customers and followers to donate, then activate them into live campaigns.run the results: track active partners, reach, attributable donations, and media and speaking engagements, report them honestly, and redirect effort to what produces donations.what you won’t be doingrunning scholarship award decisions, compliance administration or day-to-day finances. an operations partner owns that work.selling enterprise payroll benefits or managing payroll integrations.a ceremonial spokesperson role judged by appearances and impressions. you are judged by the donations you can attribute.giving individual tax advice or publishing unverified tax-credit claims.director of external affairs key responsibilitiesincrease donations for k-12 gifted and talented scholarships by owning the organization's public credibility and the partnerships that convert it into funding.basic requirementsyou know gifted education from the inside. you've spent 2+ years in the field as a teacher, coordinator, testing specialist, admissions lead or advocate. or you're the parent or guardian of a formally identified gifted child and handled their testing and school or program choice yourself. either way, families trust you because you've lived the problem.you're at ease in front of a microphone or camera. you've given live and on-camera interviews as an official spokesperson, and you've pitched journalists, fielded press inquiries or engaged policymakers on an organization's behalf. you stay accurate when the questions get hard.you close. you've personally sourced and signed partnerships with companies, associations or membership organizations, each ending in a signed agreement or mou. you know the difference between a warm intro and a deal.you know how to work with creators. you've negotiated or managed paid influencer or content-creator agreements and know how to keep a partner's audience engaged and the messaging on point.you make complex topics clear. you've explained tax or public policy to the public in plain language, through articles, explainers, op-eds, testimony or interviews. you're ready to master federal scholarship tax-credit and sgo rules within your first 30 days.you work well on your own. you're based in the united states, available 40 hours a week, and used to driving results in a remote setting without needing someone to set your agenda.nice-to-have requirementsexperience as an educator or leader in gifted education.existing relationships with gifted-education associations, enrichment providers or education media.experience in school choice, scholarships or nonprofit fundraising.about stealth educational startupwe are a stealth educational startup in austin, tx (center of educational innovation in us). we are building an online community focusing on the most underserved customer base in us education - gifted and talented kids. we are a remote first company who hires globally via crossover.there is so much to cover for this exciting role, and space here is limited. hit the apply button if you found this interesting and want to learn more. we look forward to meeting you!working with usthis is a full-time (40 hours per week), long-term position. the position is immediately available and requires entering into an independent contractor agreement with crossover as a contractor of record. the compensation level for this role is $200 usd/hour, which equates to $400,000 usd/year assuming 40 hours per week and 50 weeks per year. the payment period is weekly. consult www.crossover.com/help-and-faqs for more details on this topic.crossover job code: lj-5860-us-chicago-directorofexte

midwest’s engagement with jewish communities, jewish communal institutions, and strategic non-jewish communities and partners throughout the midwest region, aligned to adl’s strategic direction. the collaborative action against antisemitism, hate, and discrimination.the role also provides strategic guidance, coordination, and support to colleagues in adl midwest’s spoke markets to help ensure a adl’s mission and deepen engagement with the broader jewish community through strategic outreach, education, programming, and advocacy initiatives. outreach and partnerships with non-jewish founding marketing leadlocation: chicago, il headquarterstype: full-time, in officecompany stage: pre-seed / seed-stage, venture-backed tech startupwe're a small, fast-moving team building something new in physical ai and robotics. this role is a fit for a b2b tech marketer who wants room and autonomy to build, and to be a trusted builder on a lean but highly effective gtm team. you'll be hands-on from day one, writing, launching campaigns and shipping content yourself, with a path to lead a team as we grow.the right person is highly organized, naturally prioritizes the work that moves the top line, and doesn't need a fully built playbook to get started. early-stage startup life means shifting priorities, lean resources, and high expectations, and that energizes you rather than slows you down. if you're looking for a structured corporate environment with defined processes and a large support team, this probably isn't the right fit. if you want real ownership, real impact, and the chance to build something from the ground up, keep reading.about us - our mission & visionat autopilot, our mission is to free people up to do what they do best by automating everything else. we are building the infrastructure layer that powers autonomy in motion across the physical world, including sports, fitness, logistics, healthcare, and more. our systems help robots move, record, deliver, train, and connect in real-world environments that have historically lacked modern tooling. our values are simple and non-negotiable: do good. have fun. make money. we believe these are mutually reinforcing, and we work hard to uphold them as we grow.we move fast, operate scrappy, and care deeply about building something that works.benefitsyou will be eligible to participate in company benefits and perks, which currently include:base salary + annual bonus potentialthe total compensation range for this role is $120,000-$200,000. this range reflects total target compensation, which includes base salary and bonus potential. where a candidate falls within the range depends on factors such as experience, skills, and locations.equity: early-stage ownership through stock options. a chance to build meaningful value as we scale.100% employer-covered health, dental, and vision insurance401(k) – company-administered planflexible pto – time off as needed, coordinated with your teamtravel reimbursement – reimbursed in accordance with company policy, where role-related travel is requiredteam & culture events – team offsites, social events, and company-sponsored activitiesbenefits and policies may be updated from time to time at the company's discretion.the roleown how autopilot tells its story and turns that story into a pipeline. you'll shape messaging, positioning, and go-to-market narrative across our verticals, build and run the campaigns that generate demand, and create the customer-proof library that helps close b2b deals. you'll start as a hands-on builder who writes and launches the campaign, and reports on the results, then grow into leading the marketing team as we scale.what you'll ownproduct marketing & positioningown messaging, positioning, and value proposition across enterprise and channel, tailored by vertical and by buyer.partner with sales, product, and leadership to translate company strategy into a marketing plan that drives the pipeline.support product launches with positioning, launch content, and go-to-market plans.content & customer proofbuild autopilot's library of case studies, roi documentation, and deployment outcomes end-to-end. develop thought leadership that positions autopilot as a serious player in facility automation, speaking the language of b2b buyers in industries new to robotics.coordinate with customer success and sales to surface the strongest stories and access the right contacts.demand gen & campaignsbuild and run campaigns end-to-end: marketing automation, lifecycle and email campaigns, paid media, seo/content, and reporting.use ai tools to plan, produce, and test campaigns faster than a traditional team could.build dashboards for pipeline, conversion, and marketing roi, and share what's working with leadership.brand, content & eventsmaintain brand consistency across all channels; own the editorial calendar and content that feeds paid, email, and seo.own autopilot's presence at trade shows and live demo events, from planning through post-event nurture.growing the teamas the function grows, help hire and eventually lead the marketing team, alongside agencies and contractors where they make sense.who you area scrappy builder who sees this as an opportunity to build something and grow with it.you understand that content at a startup isn't just blog posts. it's sales ammo, brand positioning, and customer trust.wired for speed: you make decisions with imperfect information, ship work, and iterate rather than waiting for everything to be perfect.highly organized with a multiplier mindset. you instinctively prioritize the work that moves the top line, not just the work that fills the calendar.you want autonomy now and to lead a team down the road.experience3–8 years of b2b marketing experience at technology companiesyou are hands-on and experienced across product marketing, content marketing, and demand generation and you've built without a large team or a big budget.pre-seed or seed-stage, venture-backed tech startup experience preferred. a track record of building and launching campaigns yourself, from brief to resultsai-native in your day-to-day and in your campaigns. you default to tools like claude, chatgpt, or similar to move faster, write better, and solve problems before asking for help.you know your way around campaigns, lists, workflows, and reporting without needing a tutorialbonus pointsexperience in robotics or physical aiexperience marketing new technology to legacy industries

intelligence-driven, end-to-end solutions that unify media, content, operations and strategy. powered by advanced ai, robust digital shelf analytics across 1,400+ retailers in 70 countries and serve as a key driver of go-to-market (gtm) success, focusing on core product messaging & positioning, sales enablement, competitive analysis, and developing high-impact customer stories/messaging for companies to coordinate co-marketing initiatives for your product line, including partnered social posts and promotional opportunities.qualificationsbachelor's degree in marketing, advertising, liaison with hmg affiliates and business units across the united states.develop relationships with communications teams throughout the hyundai ecosystem.maintain communications contact databases and stakeholder maps.support message alignment across government affairs, corporate communications, public relations, and affiliate organizations.6) executive communications supportprepare executive briefing materials for meetings, events, site visits, and stakeholder engagements.develop speeches, remarks, talking points, q&a documents, and meeting preparation materials.support executive visibility initiatives and thought leadership opportunities.maintain executive communications calendars and associated planning activities.7) communications operationsmaintain communications calendars, project trackers, and content repositories.support development and administration of communications processes, templates, style guidance, and approval workflows.track communications metrics and prepare recurring reports and summaries.assist with budget tracking, vendor coordination, and communications program administration and other communications-related projects and responsibilities as assigned.

detail.desc: about audubonthe national audubon society is a leading nonprofit conservation organization with 120 years of science-based, community-driven impact, dedicated to protecting birds and the places they need, today and tomorrow. birds are powerful indicators of our planet’s health, acting as sentinels that warn us of environmental change and inspire action. audubon works across the western hemisphere, driven by the understanding that what is good for birds is good for the planet. through a collaborative, nonpartisan approach across habitats, borders, and the political spectrum, trusted advisor to senior cs leaders, providing integrated support that combines strategic communications expertise with leadership development capabilities to drive organizational effectiveness and leader capability building.as a strategic enablement business partner, you'll work at the intersection of communications and leadership development, partnering with dedicated senior leader stakeholders across our global customer service organization. you'll design and deliver strategic communications that connect employees to our mission, while simultaneously building leadership capabilities through coaching, facilitation, and tailored development programs. this dual-discipline approach allows you to see the full picture of organizational health and create holistic solutions that drive both engagement and capability.your work will directly impact how cs leaders communicate with their teams, develop their leadership skills, and navigate complex organizational challenges. you'll facilitate leadership offsites, craft strategic messaging for organizational changes, and design bespoke learning solutions—all while serving as a credible challenger who pushes leaders' thinking and surfaces opportunities they might not see on their own.the most exciting aspect of this role is the breadth of impact. you'll work across multiple cs organizations, supporting leaders who oversee thousands of employees globally. your integrated approach means you'll help leaders not just communicate change, but build the capabilities needed to lead through it. you'll be the single face of strategic enablement for your stakeholders, connecting them to our full suite of capabilities while directly executing high-impact work.this role requires someone who can operate with significant autonomy in ambiguous situations, build trusted relationships with senior leaders, and seamlessly blend communications and leadership development expertise to deliver exceptional results.the ideal candidate must be able to think critically, act tactically, write effectively, and display strong organizational and communication skills. they must quickly get up to speed on cs-specific tenets, goals, programs, policies, and businesses, becoming a subject matter expert on the cs business.key job responsibilities serve as a trusted advisor and strategic partner to dedicated senior cs leaders, providing integrated communications and leadership development consultation and execution that drives ongoing organizational transformation and effectiveness design and execute strategic communications including organizational announcements, change management messaging, town halls, and leadership communications that connect employees to cs vision and priorities facilitate leadership offsites, team meetings, and strategic planning sessions that build alignment and drive decision-making provide executive consultation to senior leaders, helping them develop their leadership capabilities and navigate complex organizational challenges design and deliver bespoke leadership development solutions tailored to stakeholder needs, partnering with broader organizational enablement teams for program development develop and maintain yearly integrated communications and leadership development support plans for assigned stakeholders, ensuring proactive and coordinated delivery across both disciplines act as a credible challenger who pushes leaders' thinking, surfaces blind spots, and identifies opportunities for organizational improvement connect stakeholders to the full range of communications and leadership development capabilities and subject matter experts, serving as the single point of contact for all interactions conduct surveys and gather feedback to measure communication effectiveness, engagement, and leadership development impact support ad hoc requests through the strategic enablement shared service model, providing consultation and execution support to cs leaders and program teams across the organization collaborate with organizational enablement creative & marketing teams to develop compelling visual and video content that enhances communication consistent quality.we are looking for a senior technical program manager, ai content capabilities to lead that shift as part of our marketing technology organization, building ai-powered products and reusable content capabilities that will enable 900+ marketers to own more of the path from idea to finished, on-brand content. this individual will bridge marketing content expertise and technical implementation, working across content capability leads, engineering, design, and platform teams to prototype ai-powered skills, define how their quality is evaluated, and establish reusable patterns for grounding, orchestration, integrations, and human review. they will help take capabilities from experimentation through implementation and scale, ensuring teams reuse proven approaches rather than solving the same technical problems independently across content types. the ideal candidate combines strong product instincts with hands-on ai prototyping experience and technical depth across llms, agents and skills, apis, data and context, and application integrations. you are energized by ambiguity, comfortable building and testing emerging capabilities, and able to turn an idea into a validated experience and path to scale.responsibilitiesdefine and scale reusable technical patterns for ai-powered content capabilities, including skill and agent design, grounding and context, orchestration, integrations, human review, and evaluation approaches that can be applied across content types and marketer scenarios. prototype ai-powered skills and experiences using generative ai platforms, agents, apis, low-code tools, and code where appropriate to test hypotheses, validate approaches, and establish a clear path to production. establish the evaluation and improvement framework for ai-generated marketing content, translating content and brand quality standards into repeatable evaluation criteria, test sets, and measurement approaches that identify gaps and continuously improve outputs. translate marketer needs into product and technical requirements, including workflows, data and context, grounding, integrations, brand requirements, user experiences, dependencies, and success criteria. shape solutions with engineering, design, and platform teams, informing architecture, technical tradeoffs, integration patterns, and implementation decisions while identifying shared components that should be built once and reused across capabilities. codify and continuously improve ai content development best practices, turning learnings from individual capabilities into repeatable patterns, guidance, and frameworks that accelerate development across the portfolio. measure capability performance and drive continuous improvement, using evaluation results, customer feedback, usage, quality, and business outcomes to identify opportunities and influence roadmap priorities.qualificationsrequired/minimum qualifications bachelor's degree and 4+ years experience in engineering, product/technical program management, data analysis, or product development or equivalent experience.2+ years of experience managing cross-functional and/or cross-team projects.additional or preferred qualifications3+ years of experience managing cross-functional and/or cross-team projects. proven ability to take ambiguous customer or business problems through discovery, product vision, requirements, experimentation, mvp, and scale. hands-on experience designing, prototyping, or shipping generative ai products, agents, applications, or workflows and evaluating their effectiveness. demonstrated experience shaping technical solutions with engineering and design, with fluency in apis, application integrations, data and context management, and ai/llm concepts. experience leading complex, cross-functional initiatives and influencing senior stakeholders across organizational boundaries. experience applying ai to marketing, content creation, creative, or other complex knowledge-worker workflows. experience with llms, agents, skills, mcps, grounding and retrieval patterns, apis, and platforms such as azure ai foundry, copilot studio, m365 copilot agents, and/or model context protocol (mcp). experience defining or implementing evaluations for ai or llm-powered products and using results to improve product performance and output quality. experience with marketing technology, brand systems, creative tooling, knowledge systems, or content operationstechnical program management ic4 - the typical base pay range for this role across the u.s. is usd $119,800 - $234,700 per year. there is a different range applicable to specific work locations, within the san francisco bay area and new york city metropolitan area, and the base pay range for this role in those locations is usd $160,200 - $261,000 per year.certain roles may be eligible for benefits and other compensation. find additional benefits and pay information here:https://careers.microsoft.com/us/en/us-corporate-paythis position will be open for a minimum of 5 days, with applications accepted on an ongoing basis until the position is filled.microsoft is an communication: raises concerns early and gives candid, useful updates. requirementsworking conditionsstandard business hours, with occasional evening or weekend work during launches or major about partner forcespartner forces is a management consulting firm helping homeland security organizations solve some of their most pressing and complex challenges. we partner with government agencies and industry to strengthen national security and critical infrastructure through expertise in strategy, program management, stakeholder engagement, technology implementation, preparedness, and business transformation.at partner forces, we're more than consultants—we're trusted advisors. we work alongside our clients to solve meaningful problems, deliver actionable solutions, and make a lasting impact. as a growing firm, every employee has the opportunity to contribute not only to our clients' success, but also to the future of partner forces. we believe great consultants are developed through collaboration, mentorship, continuous learning, and meaningful opportunities to lead.our culture is grounded in six core values: integrity, excellence, positivity, candor, determination, and teamwork. these values shape how we work with our clients, support one another, and grow together. we believe that when our people thrive, our clients do too, which is why we invest in our employees' well-being, professional development, and long-term success.what we are looking forpartner forces is seeking a consultant to support strategic communications and stakeholder engagement for a department of homeland security (dhs) client. while strong communications skills are essential, we are first and foremost looking for a relationship builder who can earn the trust of government leaders and become a valued advisor to the client.the ideal candidate understands that great consulting starts with great relationships. they take the time to understand their client's mission, priorities, challenges, and working style. they know how to listen, ask thoughtful questions, anticipate needs, and bring forward solutions. they are equally comfortable developing executive-level communications, facilitating conversations with diverse stakeholders, and providing candid, thoughtful counsel to client leadership. we're looking for someone who is proactive, personable, collaborative, and low-ego. someone who can navigate ambiguity, build credibility quickly, and take ownership without needing constant direction. most importantly, someone who genuinely enjoys working with people and takes pride in being a trusted partner to their clients.what you'll dobuild and maintain strong, trusted relationships with government clients, establishing yourself as a go-to advisor for strategic communications, stakeholder engagement, and broader mission priorities.serve as a strategic thought partner to client leadership, anticipating needs, providing sound recommendations, and helping navigate complex or sensitive communications challenges.develop and execute strategic communications plans that align with client priorities, mission objectives, and stakeholder needs.translate complex operational and technical information into clear, compelling messaging for executive, government, and other stakeholder audiences.draft and refine executive briefings, talking points, presentations, correspondence, reports, and other high-visibility communications products.coordinate communications across internal teams, government stakeholders, and external partners to ensure consistent messaging and alignment.support stakeholder engagement activities, including meeting preparation, facilitation, follow-up, and relationship management.identify opportunities to strengthen communications processes, improve information sharing, and enhance stakeholder engagement.manage competing priorities and time-sensitive deliverables while maintaining exceptional quality, responsiveness, and attention to detail.navigate sensitive stakeholder dynamics with professionalism, diplomacy, discretion, and sound judgment.qualificationsbachelor's degree required.5-7 years of experience supporting federal government programs, consulting engagements, or related project management efforts.experience supporting dhs or other federal civilian agencies.demonstrated ability to build and sustain trusted relationships with government clients, including advising senior leaders and navigating complex stakeholder environments.exceptional interpersonal skills and emotional intelligence, with the ability to connect with diverse personalities, build credibility, and influence without formal authority.strong strategic communications experience, including executive messaging, stakeholder communications, briefing development, and communications planning.excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to translate complex information into clear, actionable messaging.a proactive, solutions-oriented mindset with the ability to anticipate client needs, exercise sound judgment, and take initiative.strong organizational and project management skills, including the ability to manage multiple priorities and tight deadlines.ability to navigate ambiguity, sensitive situations, and shifting client priorities with professionalism and diplomacy.a collaborative, low-ego approach and genuine commitment to exceptional client service.u.s. citizenship.ability to obtain and maintain a dhs suitability determination or security clearance, as required.next stepsif your application looks like a match, someone from our people operations team will reach out to schedule a phone screening. during this conversation, we will determine if the current or future position aligns with your experience and skills. if things go well, from there you'll meet with members from the project team, including the hiring manager and teammates, and possibly be asked to submit a writing assessment to showcase your practical knowledge. if we find you are a match, you’ll get a call offering you the role. while we wish we could hire every great candidate who comes our way, the reality is that we can't. if you are not selected, we will be sure to connect with you and let you know so you can move on with your search. we will also keep your resume for future needs.salary range & compensation philosophythe anticipated salary range for this position is $95,000 - $120,000. at partner forces, we recognize that every candidate brings a unique combination of skills, experiences, and qualifications. compensation decisions consider several factors, including years of relevant experience, specialized expertise, clearance level, and the requirements of the role. we also believe compensation is a starting point, not a finish line. we're committed to recognizing contributions, rewarding strong performance, and creating opportunities for continued growth as our employees develop their skills and careers at partner forces.partner forces is an equal opportunity employer. we do not discriminate based on race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. we are committed to fostering a workplace where everyone feels valued and respected. if you require a reasonable accommodation during the application process, please contact us at recruiting@partnerforces.com.

leadership and work closely with corporate communications colleagues to advance our communications strategy in the market. the ideal candidate is an exceptional communicator with strong business acumen, executive presence and a passion for storytelling. they thrive in a fast-paced environment, bring sound judgment to complex situations and can confidently navigate both opportunities and challenges while keeping the business moving forward.what you'll own:develop and execute integrated external communications strategies that support smb business objectives, market positioning and growth priorities. serve as a strategic communications advisor to smb executives and business leaders. drive proactive media relations, building relationships with key business, technology, payments influence across functions and levels. experience managing communications programs from strategy through execution and measurement. about the teamour inclusive and global teams win together every day. important, ensuring the abilities of all employees are used to their fullest potential.as a key member of the external communications team, this role helps shape and protect cna's reputation among brokers, customers, industry stakeholders, media and other external audiences. the marketing manager serves as a strategic communications advisor, developing and executing integrated communications strategies that advance business objectives, strengthen market positioning and elevate cna's brand and thought leadership.working closely with business leaders and subject matter experts, this individual identifies opportunities to amplify cna's voice in the marketplace, manages media and public relations initiatives, and provides communications counsel on both proactive and sensitive issues. the role requires strong business acumen, exceptional communication skills and the ability to translate complex topics into compelling stories and messaging that resonate with external audiences.job description:essential duties & responsibilitiesperforms a combination of duties in accordance with departmental guidelines:serves as a trusted communications advisor, providing strategic counsel on messaging, reputation management, communications risks and opportunities, and stakeholder engagement strategies. develops and executes external communications strategies that support enterprise priorities, business objectives and key growth initiatives. manages media and public relations programs, reputation management, executive visibility, reporter engagement, media materials development, spokesperson preparation, media monitoring and results reporting. leads cna's awards & recognition program as a key component of the company's reputation and thought leadership strategy. execute opportunities that enhance cna's external profile, elevate executives and subject matter experts, and showcase the company's expertise, culture and business performance to key stakeholders. identifies and develops opportunities to enhance cna's visibility and reputation through thought leadership, executive positioning, speaking engagements, industry awards and recognition programs. partners with business leaders and subject matter experts to create compelling content and storytelling that strengthens cna's market presence and supports strategic priorities. monitors emerging issues, assesses potential reputational impacts and recommends communications strategies, messaging and response plans. manages agency relationships and external communications projects, ensuring optimize future strategies and programs. collaborates across marketing & communications and business teams to ensure consistent messaging and a coordinated approach to external engagement. skills, knowledge & abilitiescommercial insurance industry experience required. strong expertise in external communications, media relations and public relations, including earned media strategy, message development, spokesperson support and issues management. excellent writing, editing and storytelling skills with the ability to translate complex business, insurance and industry topics into clear, compelling communications. demonstrated ability to develop strategic communications plans that support business objectives and enhance reputation. experience positioning organizations, leaders and subject matter experts through thought leadership, executive visibility programs, speaking engagements and industry recognition opportunities. strong relationship-building and influencing skills with the ability to work effectively across all organizational levels. proven project management skills, including the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment. education & experiencecommercial insurance industry experience required. bachelor's degree in communications, public relations, journalism, marketing, english or a related field, or equivalent experience. typically a minimum of five to seven years of progressively responsible experience in corporate communications, public relations, media relations or a related field. experience advising leaders and stakeholders on strategic or high-profile communications initiatives. in certain jurisdictions, cna is legally required to include a reasonable estimate of the compensation for this role. in district for employment-based visas for this position at this time.about hormel foods — inspired people. inspired food.™ hormel foods corporation, based in austin, minnesota, is a global branded food company label®, columbus®, jennie-o® and more than 30 other beloved brands. the company is a member of the s&p 500 index and the s&p 500 dividend aristocrats, was named one of the best companies to work for by u.s. news & world report, one of america’s most responsible companies by newsweek, recognized by time magazine as one of the world’s best companies, and has received numerous other awards and accolades for its corporate responsibility and community service efforts. the company lives by its purpose statement — inspired people. inspired food.™ — to bring some of the world’s most trusted and iconic brands to tables across the globe. for more information, visit www.hormelfoods.com.responsibilities:business planning, p&l management, business initiative execution: develops and executes the annual operating plan (aop) financial targets. establishes business objectives, strategies, and tactics to attain aop. achieves volume, net revenue, and gross margin targets.brand equity management: public relations plans.innovation/renovation: leads future growth by identifying new product and line extension opportunities by analyzing consumer trends, determining specific market needs and potential, and building a business case. actively manages total branded portfolio to ensure relevancy (sku rationalization, ppa, all customer/consumer touchpoints)sales enablement: fosters strong brand initiatives and business needs.channel development:  works collaboratively with category management on strategic selling. develops trade strategy. monitors marketplace dynamics and implements its authors to readers in more than 200 countries and territories. for more information visit our website at www.simonandschuster.com.about the rolewe are seeking a creative, strategic, and collaborative brand manager to strengthen the campaigns for scribner high touch authors and connect our books and authors with more readers. this person will translate each author's brand into compelling campaigns, consistent messaging, and partnerships that build awareness, deepen reader engagement, and drive sales.working closely with marketing, editorial, and sales, the brand manager 4486794198.title: Richmond Coffee Strategic Brand & Marketing Manager

detail.desc: brown distributing company is a leading beverage distributor throughout the state of virginia. since 1919, brown distributing has grown into a beverage distribution business with combined sales of over 3 million cases annually and serving in excess of 3,000 retailers with nearly 200 employees. brown distributing offers their employees competitive compensation, complete benefit package, including medical, dental, vision, company paid life insurance and a 401k employer match.the strategic brand & marketing manager will lead the strategy, development, and day-to-day execution of the richmond coffee ready to-drink “rtd” coffee brand within the richmond market, along with future brands and markets as the portfolio grows. this is a hands-on, roll-up-your sleeves role that owns the brand from concept to shelf: managing co-packer relationships, directing brand and packaging design, building marketing programs, and ensuring a strong supplier experience. this role partners closely with the sales team and with chain, independent, and on-premise retail accounts to build brand awareness, grow distribution, open new accounts, and deliver volume and profitability goals. this role will also identify and lead brand expansion opportunities that drive future growth, and will manage the sampling & events coordinator and the brand’s in-market sampling program.compensation$85,000-$110,000/yearvehicle allowance: $825/monthphone allowance: $75/monthschedulefull time position to include nights and weekends, and travel as needed to co-packers, suppliers, markets, and events.essential duties & responsibilities: include the following. other duties may be assigned.brand strategy & portfolio management: own the brand strategy, positioning, and annual brand plans for richmond coffee and additional brands as the portfolio expands, including the brand calendar, pricing strategy, sku mix, case volume and sales goals, and brand p&l oversight.co-packer management: source, onboard, and manage co-packer relationships, including production scheduling, run minimums, quality standards, cost negotiations, and contract compliance.product development: lead new product and line-extension development from concept through commercialization, including consumer and category research, flavor development, formulation, shelf-life testing, packaging, and launch timing.innovation pipeline & sku management: build and manage a multi year innovation pipeline; evaluate sku performance and recommend additions, line extensions, and sku rationalization based on velocity and profitability.brand & packaging design: direct brand identity, packaging, and point of-sale design with internal resources and outside artists, ensuring a consistent look, voice, and message across every touchpoint.brand guidelines & sales tools: create and maintain brand guidelines, sell sheets, price sheets, and digital assets; develop point-of-sale (pos/posm) and merchandising materials and ensure the sales team and retail accounts execute the brand consistently in market; develop display, cooler and cold-vault placement, shelf, and secondary-placement programs that turn awareness into purchase, and audit in-market execution during store visits.supplier experience: manage relationships with ingredient, packaging, and materials co-packers to ensure quality, on-time delivery, and cost efficiency; resolve supply issues quickly and build long-term partnerships.marketing programs: develop and execute integrated, 360-degree marketing plans, including digital and social media, influencer and consumer engagement, retail and chain promotions, trade marketing, pr, local community and cause-marketing programs, and partnerships, to build awareness and drive trial and repeat purchase. build richmond coffee’s identity as a local, community-rooted brand through partnerships with richmond-area organizations including non-profit, colleges and universities, sports and entertainment venues, festivals, and local businesses.sampling & events oversight: set the strategy, budget, and goals for sampling and event programs; build an annual sampling and events calendar that targets high-traffic retail accounts, priority prospect accounts, chain in-store demos, and community events; set measurable goals for every activation (samples distributed, consumer engagements, sales lift, and new placements); ensure each sampling event is coordinated with the sales team so it converts into orders, displays, or new accounts; direct the sampling & events coordinator and review post-event reporting and roi, reallocating sampling dollars to the activations that drive the most sales.brand expansion & future growth: identify and evaluate new markets, channels, products, and brand opportunities; build business cases and lead go-to-market planning for expansion.sales team partnership: partner with the sales team to develop sell-in presentations, quarterly programming, and sales incentives; support chain, independent, and on-premise account objectives; and conduct market visits and ride-withs with sales representatives to drive distribution, placements, displays, new accounts, and velocity.pricing & market planning: support pricing, retailer margin structures, and planning for new markets and channels in partnership with sales leadership.market & consumer insights: monitor category trends, competitive activity, and consumer insights using syndicated scan data (such as nielsen, circana/iri), internal sales and depletion reporting, consumer feedback captured at sampling events, and consumer research to guide brand decisions and identify new opportunities.budget & performance reporting: manage the brand marketing, sampling, and trade spend budgets; track key metrics (depletions, distribution points, velocity, share, new accounts opened, samples distributed, sampling-to-sale conversion, social media reach and engagement, and roi); and report results, post-program analysis, and recommendations to leadership.industry presence: represent the brand at sales meetings, retailer meetings and reviews, trade shows, and community events, serving as the brand ambassador internally and externally.regulatory & labeling compliance: work with co-packers and suppliers to ensure labeling, claims, and packaging meet applicable fda and regulatory requirements; ensure sampling programs follow food-safety, product-handling, and retailer and venue sampling requirements.new account development: partner with the sales team to identify, prioritize, and pursue new accounts across grocery, convenience, drug, on-premise, foodservice, office, hospitality, and college and university channels; use sampling and in-store demos as a door-opener with buyers and store managers; track new accounts opened, distribution points gained, and reorder rates.brand ambassador program & sampling standards: with the sampling & events coordinator, build and maintain a team of trained part time brand ambassadors (recruiting, training, product knowledge, talking points, and scheduling); set sampling execution standards covering setup and presentation, product handling and food safety, cold-chain, sample inventory accountability, and photo and recap reporting.digital & social media: own the brand’s social media channels and content calendar; capture content from sampling events, accounts, and the community; grow followers and engagement; and use geo-targeted digital, local influencers, and user-generated content to drive consumers to retail locations where the brand is sold.supervisory responsibilitiesdirectly supervises the sampling & events coordinator, and direct the work of outside artists, designers, and vendors. carries out supervisory responsibilities in accordance with the organization’s policies and applicable laws. responsibilities include interviewing, hiring, and training employees; planning, assigning, and directing work; appraising performance; rewarding and disciplining employees; and addressing complaints and resolving problems.qualificationsbachelor’s degree in marketing, business, or a related field (or an equivalent combination of education and experience), and at least 5 years of brand management or marketing experience in the beverage (alcohol or non-alcohol) or consumer packaged goods industry. hands-on experience managing vendors; co-packers or contract manufacturers, leading packaging and brand design projects, and launching new products a plus. beverage distributor experience, rtd coffee or beverage experience, experience building and running sampling, demo, or brand ambassador programs, established relationships with richmond-area retailers and community organizations, and prior supervisory experience are preferred. working knowledge of beverage distribution, including chain account programming and resets, depletion reporting, pricing, and trade spend management. experience using syndicated scan data and internal sales reporting to build fact-based selling stories. proficiency in microsoft office; social media management and content tools, and sales/depletion data platforms is a plus. all final applicants will be required to comply and pass all drug, background, and driving checks

lifestyle, or retail brands.experience in managing premium, luxury, contemporary, or mass-market fashion brands will be an advantage.prior experience in launching, repositioning, or expanding brands in the us market.candidates with experience in both brick-and-mortar retail and e-commerce will be preferred.key objectiveto strengthen the company's brand presence in the us market by developing effective brand strategies, driving consumer engagement, enhancing brand visibility, and supporting long-term business growth

orchestration and governance, ensuring our content is optimized for the latest generative and agentic technologies.editorial strategyeditorial mission: to provide consumers with the most trusted, integration: lead training and enablement for team members and freelancers to incorporate ai agents and automations into every aspect of content strategy and development. partner with product and tech ai-assisted automation of clinical and content tasks.qualificationsprofessional experienceeducation: bachelor’s degree in communications, journalism, public health, health education, or a related
