to continuous improvement.ready to apply?the process is simple. click on the “apply now” button to get started. good luck!#qkcm

why join usbrex is the intelligent finance platform that enables companies to spend smarter and move faster in more than 200 markets. by combining global corporate cards and banking with intuitive spend management, bill pay, and travel software, brex enables founders and finance teams to accelerate operations, gain real-time visibility, and control spend effortlessly. brex’s ai-native automation and world-class service eliminate manual expense and accounting tasks for customers so they can focus on what matters most. tens of thousands of the world's best companies run on brex, including doordash, coinbase, robinhood, zoom, plaid, reddit, and seatgeek.working at brex allows you to push your limits, challenge the status quo, and collaborate with some of the brightest minds in the industry. we’re committed to building a diverse team and inclusive culture and believe your potential should only be limited by how big you can dream. we make this a reality by empowering you with the tools, resources, and support you need to grow your career.design at brexdesign at brex creates the experiences that make complex systems feel effortless through thoughtful, scalable design. whether crafting interfaces, shaping product strategy, or harnessing ai to empower our users, we obsess over quality and clarity. this is a team where creativity meets high craft, and where designers grow by building for ambitious customers.what you’ll dobrex is looking for a staff brand designer to join the design team, a cross-disciplinary group of creatives including product designers, brand designers, content design, operations, and marketing strategists. our team’s mission is to build a category-defining brand and meaningfully move key business metrics by delivering world-class creative.your role will be to drive the evolution of brex's brand identity system, pushing our visual language forward while maintaining cohesion across all touch points. you'll be instrumental in defining how our brand shows up in the world, from establishing new design patterns and brand expressions to reimagining our visual identity for the next phase of growth. this is a strategic and hands-on role that will require you to work closely with marketing leaders, web and product teams, and creative partners to ensure our brand identity is distinctive, scalable, and reflects our ambition. you are a systems thinker who can envision the big picture while obsessing over the craft details that bring a brand to life.where you’ll workthis role will be based in our san francisco, seattle, or new york office. we are a hybrid environment that combines the energy and connections of being in the office with the benefits and flexibility of working from home. we currently require a minimum of three coordinated days in the office per week, monday, wednesday and thursday. as a perk, we also have up to four weeks per year of fully remote work!responsibilitiesown and evolve brex’s brand identity system, including visual language, typography, color, illustration, and brand patternsdefine and maintain brand standards that balance consistency with creative flexibility across teams and channelstranslate company strategy and brand vision into clear, compelling visual direction in partnership with leadershipdesign and deliver new brand expressions that advance the identity while preserving recognition and equitylead high-impact brand work beyond the core system, including special campaigns, sub-brands, and select product or service launchesart direct and contribute to brand campaigns, collaborating with external partners and internal teams to ensure exceptional craftprovide guidance and feedback across the organization to raise the quality and effectiveness of brand executionrequirements7+ years of experience in brand design or art direction, with a strong focus on identity systems and brand evolutiona portfolio demonstrating strategic thinking, system design, and high-quality execution across identities and campaignsdeep expertise in typography, color, composition, and building scalable visual systemsstrong ability to articulate design decisions and build alignment with cross-functional partners and senior stakeholdersexperience working across multiple workstreams in fast-paced, evolving environmentsfluency in figma and adobe creative suite, with comfort prototyping and iterating quicklypractical experience using ai tools in the creative process with sound judgment on when and how to apply thembonus pointsmotion, video, or illustration experience applied to brand systems or campaignsexperience art directing complex brand work with external creative partnerscompensationthe expected salary range for this role is $187,000 - $234,000. however, the starting base pay will depend on a number of factors including the candidate’s location, skills, experience, market demands, and internal pay parity. depending on the position offered, equity and other forms of compensation may be provided as part of a total compensation package.please be aware, job-seekers may be at risk of targeting by malicious actors looking for personal data. brex recruiters will only reach out via linkedin or email with a brex.com domain. any outreach claiming to be from brex via other sources should be ignored.

who we arenotion is the collaborative ai workspace where teams and agents think together. we're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and ai tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on notion.notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. we care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. each and every team of notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the ai era. from building a business’s system of record to making and managing ai agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.about the rolethis role is based in new york city. we work from our offices on mondays, tuesdays and thursdays (our anchor days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. we’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days.this role sits on notion’s creative studio, a small team of designers, illustrators, and filmmakers. our work tells the story of our offering in a way that reflects the products themselves: smart, refined, and with a dash of wit on the side.as a brand designer, you’ll work on high-impact brand initiatives and campaigns: setting direction from early strategy through final execution, partnering closely with stakeholders and executives, and raising the bar for craft and systems. you’ll be asked to define approaches, resolve ambiguity, and influence both project outcomes and how the team works.what you'll achieveconcept, art direct and design high-visibility moments from brand campaigns, product launches, and events, developing approaches that can scale across a broad range of surfaces, moments, and channels.contribute to our brand systems and develop standards and tooling that improve velocity and consistency for teammates near and far.mentor and raise the bar for other designers and creative partners through feedback, critique, and patterns that make great work repeatable.skills you'll need to bring10+ years in an agency or in-house environment, with demonstrated leadership on ambiguous, complex, high-impact work.a strong portfolio of work that’s culturally resonant and visually diverse, and that showcases your ability to tell stories across many channels.a deep commitment to systems thinking, typographic excellence, and sensitivity to small details.experience working with a broad range of makers. you’ve teamed up with illustrators, animators, copywriters, filmmakers, photographers, and beyond to bring your ideas to life.excellent partnership skills. you can work hand-in-hand with cross-functional stakeholders, drive alignment, and make pragmatic tradeoffs.a tinkerer’s mindset. you're curious about how your tools are evolving and have a strong perspective on how ai can expand creative expression and drive production. you’ll actively experiment with new ai workflows to concept, prototype, and push our design systems further.notion is committed to providing highly competitive cash compensation, equity, and benefits. the compensation offered for this role will be based on multiple factors such as location, the role’s scope and complexity, and the candidate’s experience and expertise, and may vary from the range provided below. for roles based in new york city, the estimated base salary range for this role is $200,000 - $250,000 per year.by clicking “submit application”, i understand and agree that notion and its affiliates and subsidiaries will collect and process my information in accordance with notion’s global recruiting privacy policy and nyll 144.a note on aiyou don’t need deep ai expertise for every role, but we do expect every notino to be intellectually curious, drawn to tinkering and discovery, and excited to use ai as a real collaborator in their work. for some roles, ai fluency is a core requirement — when that’s the case, we'll say so explicitly in the qualifications. people who thrive here don’t treat ai as a novelty. they use it to think better, and make their work easier for others to build on.equal opportunity & accommodationswe hire talented people from a wide range of backgrounds. if you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every bullet, we still encourage you to apply. notion is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of any legally protected characteristic. consistent with applicable law, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. notion provides reasonable accommodations during the application process; if you need one, please let your recruiter know.notion is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. we do not discriminate in hiring or any employment decision based on race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, genetic information, veteran status, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, or other applicable legally protected characteristic. notion considers qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. notion is also committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures. if you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, please let your recruiter know.

job descriptionwho we arecreative artists agency (caa) is the leading entertainment and sports agency, with global expertise in filmed and live entertainment, digital media, publishing, sponsorship sales and endorsements, licensing, media finance, consumer investing, fashion, trademark licensing, and philanthropy. distinguished by its culture of collaboration and exceptional client service, caa’s diverse workforce identifies, innovates, and amplifies opportunities for the people and organizations that shape culture and inspire the world. the trailblazer of the agency business, caa was the first to build a sports business, create an investment bank, launch a venture fund, found technology start-up companies, establish a philanthropic arm, build a business in china, and form a brand marketing services division, among other innovations.the departmentcaa brand consulting is a strategy-led, full-service marketing agency with expertise in cultural and consumer insights, data and analytics, talent/influencer and property partnership advisory, experiential, social impact, creative services, and content and digital strategy. these integrated capabilities come together to offer solutions from planning through execution, and we pull in a collective perspective of expertise with each client brief to ensure we are tapping into diverse thinking and building strategies reflective of the marketplace and culture we work within.the rolewe are seeking a designer to join the caa brand consulting creative team to focus on brand & design. equal parts conceptual thinker, craftsperson, and visual storyteller, this role independently develops strategically grounded brand systems, campaigns, experiential graphics, and customer-facing creative across sports, entertainment, media, and culture.working closely with creative directors, art directors, account directors, project managers, and experiential partners, the designer manages multiple owned workstreams, develops and presents conceptually led solutions, and delivers polished creative across digital, print, environmental, presentation, and motion touchpoints. the role also contributes to pitches, provides guidance to junior designers, and maintains rigorous brand, production, and quality-control standards in a fast-paced, collaborative environment.essential functions:independently concept, develop, and execute brand identity systems, campaigns, and customer-facing creative across a portfolio of sports, entertainment, and cultural brands, ensuring every solution is strategically grounded and visually compelling.champion exceptional craft across digital, print, presentation, environmental, and experiential design, delivering world-class creative that elevates both brand and fan experiences.develop graphic identity systems and production-ready assets for live events, sponsorship activations, and environmental applications, partnering closely with experiential teams to ensure cohesive translation across physical, digital, and motion touchpoints.partner with creative directors, account teams, and external partners to transform business objectives into integrated creative solutions.clearly communicate creative concepts and design rationale to internal leadership and clients, incorporating feedback while maintaining the integrity of the creative vision.provide day-to-day guidance, constructive feedback, and craft support to junior designers while contributing actively to team reviews and shared creative standards.independently manage a large initiative or multiple concurrent workstreams, allocating time effectively, meeting milestones, and ensuring creative output remains aligned with the brief, workback schedule, and quality standards.requirements:2-4+ years of graphic design and/or brand design experience within media, entertainment, sports, broadcasting, lifestyle, or cultural brands. environmental and experiential design experience, a big plus.develop multiple high-quality creative concepts and design solutions that respond to strategic briefs across a range of visual styles.strong understanding of brand identity systems, logo development, typography, layout, and visual storytelling.exceptional eye for composition, color, texture, lighting, hierarchy, and detail, with the ability to create premium, visually compelling work.advanced-to-expert proficiency in photoshop, indesign, and illustrator, including high-end compositing, retouching, image finishing, and vector illustration.working knowledge of after effects and premiere pro is a plus; proficiency with figma, powerpoint, or presentations and design documentation.strong conceptual mindset with experience translating ideas into compelling visual narratives, storyboards, and customer-facing experiences.confident presenter who can clearly articulate creative rationale to internal teams and clients while managing project feedback and revisions.manage multiple projects simultaneously with strong organization, attention to detail, and the ability to consistently meet deadlines and creative standards.actively contribute to brainstorms, collaborate across disciplines, mentor junior designers, and help elevate the overall quality of the creative team.build trusted relationships with clients and cross-functional teams by proactively communicating project status, solving challenges, and contributing thoughtful creative recommendations.preferred skills:conceptual thinking: ability to translate business and brand objectives into original, strategically grounded creative concepts.communication & presentation: excellent verbal and visual communication skills, with the ability to confidently present work, explain creative rationale, and incorporate feedback.collaboration: strong cross-functional partnership skills with the ability to work effectively with the creative team, account leaders, and external partners.creative problem solving: ability opportunities, organizing press conferences, and more- monitor and decipher developments in key client issue areas — with a focus on healthcare policy and congressional activity — and flag be prioritized.- experience with state and federal legislative, regulatory, or issues-based campaigns and lobbying is a plus- solid project management experience and a proven ability to help manage multiple projects and client initiatives in a fast-paced environment while able to think quickly- proven expertise in developing and supporting development of strategies and plans (issues management, crisis protocols, advocacy, positioning, etc.) across various industries and subject areas (financial services, health care, food and consumer goods, technology, transportation, energy, etc.)- responsibly; and work efficiently under tight deadlines- experience participating in business development opportunities a plus – industry research, proposal development and drafting, staffing plan detail.desc: the american cancer society cancer action network (acs can) is the nation's leading cancer advocacy organization. together with our charitable partner, the american cancer society, we work in congress, state legislatures and local jurisdictions to support evidence-based policy and legislative solutions designed to eliminate cancer as a major health problem.leads media advocacy efforts for assigned territory of arkansas, florida, louisiana, texas, oklahoma and puerto rico, both in english and spanish, providing input into campaign planning, implementing tactics to support policy and revenue activities, driving relevance, and enhancing acs can brand recognition in support of local, state, and federal priorities. provides a full range of media outreach, including developing target media lists and building relationships with key capitol press corps, health reporters and diverse news outlets. drafts talking points, fact sheets, news releases/advisories as well as opinion editorial articles and letters to the editor. secures editorial meetings and earned media placement by leveraging digital media skills and selling story ideas by phone and electronically to print, radio and tv newsrooms.***candidates must be home based in one of these following states/territories: arkansas, florida, louisiana, texas, oklahoma and puerto rico. must be a strong communicator with excellent writing and verbal skills in english and spanish. prior experience with legislative and advocacy campaign experience is highly preferred. ***essential functions:assist in drafting and implementation of strategic media advocacy plans for local, state and federal policy campaigns, to demonstrate broad based public support for cancer-related policy initiatives. assist in occasional ballot and electoral campaign planning. draft and implement such plans directly, in assigned multi state geography of arkansas, florida, louisiana, texas, oklahoma and puerto rico. (30%) develop messaging that is tailored to the specific political environment and attuned to the rapid pace of legislative activities. write and coach others to enhance their writing of press releases, media advisories, letters to the editor, op-eds, talking points, faqs, fact sheets, speeches, presentations and other media material as needed, ensuring appropriate review for subject matter accuracy and brand standards. plan and manage media events, including press conferences and editorial board meetings. (30%) develop and maintain relationships with press corps in assigned multi state geography, and proactively engage these reporters on legislative issues as well as responding to media inquiries. track and report media results and trends. (20%) coordinate activities with acs marketing & communications staff, as well as with acs can media advocacy colleagues as needed. manage media activities to support acs can fundraising. (5%) conduct media trainings as needed for volunteers and staff. identify and/or vet and train staff and volunteer spokespeople with personal stories related to acs can’s policy campaigns. (5%) represent acs can in coalitions for priority campaigns to ensure coordination and brand recognition with joint media activities (5%) elevate the profile of acs can, by working through the media to ensure that opinion leaders are aware of acs can legislative activity and voter education activity. (5%) experience/qualifications:minimum degree required: bachelor's degree preferred degree: bachelor's degree certificate(s) or license(s): n/a years of experience: 2-3 years knowledge, skills, and ability:spanish language proficiency requiredat least 2-3 years of experience in journalism or public relations and/or legislative communications. familiarity with the legislative and/or political process a must; familiarity with reporters and/or media outlets in the covered markets preferred. political campaign or legislative experience preferred. knowledge of health care policy preferred. excellent written, oral, interpersonal and computer skills required. ability to work independently with minimum direction as well as work as a member or leader of a team. demonstrated ability to work on fast-paced, time-sensitive matters with internal and external constituents. ability to complete work in a timely and efficient manner and ensure work is accurate. ability to utilize available technology to perform position responsibilities. self-starter and proactive with creating ideas and messaging adept at working independently in a remote setting. travel requirements:some overnight travel for meetings required. physical requirements:limited lifting for media event setup may be required the starting rate is $73,000 to $83,000 annual. the final candidate's relevant experience/skills will be considered before an offer is extended. actual starting pay will vary based on non-discriminatory factors including, but not limited to, geographic location, experience, skills, specialty, and education.acs can provides staff a generous paid time off policy; medical, dental, retirement benefits, wellness programs, and professional development programs to enhance staff skills. further details on our benefits can be found on our careers site at: jobs.cancer.org/benefits. we are a proud equal opportunity employer.

status: full-time in-office, exempt/salary compensation: base salary of $100,000 - $110,000 doe are you the right fit? would it excite you to have a pivotal role in communicating to our community what is necessary to overcome our housing shortage and make home more attainable to everyone? if yes, please keep reading. about useveryone deserves a place to call home. not just an address or somewhere to take shelter, but a little slice of the universe that’s all your own. a place where you can plant roots and grow. where you have a voice. where you make memories. where you always belong. a house is a structure with four walls and a roof—but a home is wherever you can be you. that place might look a little different to everyone, but the feeling of safety and comfort it provides is universal. and to us, that’s a feeling no one should live without.since 1909, the master builders association of king and snohomish counties has been making home happen. we live in one of the best places in the world, and as representatives of our region’s housing industry, it’s our duty to keep it that way—by making housing available and attainable to everyone. that’s why we support those who provide the puget sound region with places people can call home.we’ve been the voice for builders for more than 100 years, helping to shape our community for the greater good. we devote years to creating legislation that promotes a free market where housing supply can keep up with regional demands. we collaborate with our communities to develop land in ways that serve everyone, balancing environmental preservation with housing provision. and we’re continuously building a home of our own, where our members can connect, learn from each other, and succeed. together, we’re determined to provide our region with attainable housing—today, tomorrow, and for the next 100 years.there’s a reason people say home is where the heart is—because home is where everything begins. it’s integral to human success, to creating connected communities, and to building a better tomorrow. that’s why, as the master builders association of king and snohomish counties, we don’t just make housing happen—we make home happen.what it takes to succeedhere are the skills and traits you’ll need to be successful in our organization.a team player -- you define personal success by the success of the association and one.self-motivated but also collaborative – you take full ownership of your work statement but also enjoy working with a team.highly adaptive and resilient – when necessary, you are happy to iterate, react to changes in requirements, and learn for next time.organized and detail-oriented – you have a knack for record-keeping and multi-tasking and have strong proofreading and copyediting skills. an excellent communicator – you write and speak effectively at varying levels of technical detail depending on what is most effective with any given audience.skilled & experienced but also humble – you are confident in what you bring to the team while recognizing that your opinion isn’t the only one that matters.position overviewthe communications manager has an overarching primary objective: to ensure members, policymakers, and the broader community understand mbaks’ advocacy priorities and how to make home more attainable for all.to accomplish that objective, the communications manager has three primary responsibilities:1. develop and execute strategic, member-focused communications that advance the priorities of the homebuilding industry and demonstrate the value of mbaks advocacy.2. contribute to a culture of excellence within the team to advance the priorities and objectives of the association.3. develop and / or maintain processes, tools and behaviors that support the needs of presentations, and digital and physical collateral for advocacy events. the communications manager needs to understand the unique voice and branding elements for each of those audiences and be adept communication skills, and the ability to connect mbaks advocacy work to practical impacts on members and housing.required education, experience, knowledge, and skillseducation: bachelor’s degree in dexterity and coordination.mental requirements:strong cognitive skills for problem-solving, critical thinking, and troubleshooting.ability to manage multiple tasks simultaneously, adjusting priorities detail.desc: job summarywe are seeking an experienced and highly strategic senior creative project manager to join the luxury creative team, stewarding the planning and execution of integrated creative projects across campaigns, content, retail, and brand experiences.in this role, you will own the end-to-end creative operations process, ensuring that every touchpoint reflects sulwhasoo and ap beauty’s luxury positioning, heritage, and commitment to artisanal excellence. you will partner closely with creative leadership, art direction, copy, design, marketing, and cross-functional stakeholders to deliver work that is meticulous, elevated, and emotionally resonant with the luxury consumer.this role requires a balance of operational excellence and aesthetic sensibility—someone who not only drives timelines and process, but also understands what excellence looks like in the luxury beauty space and protects that standard from brief through final execution.principal accountabilitieswhat you’ll do end-to-end project leadership: own the full lifecycle of creative projects—from intake, scoping, and resourcing through delivery and post-launch evaluation—ensuring projects are executed with rigor, clarity, and accountability at every stage. creative operations & process excellence: establish, document, and continuously improve creative operations processes, templates, and tools that enable clear ownership, cross-functional alignment, and scalable execution while maintaining high creative standards. workflow & time management: develop refined project timelines and resource plans; proactively flag risks, balancing speed with the realities of luxury-level execution and approvals. resource planning & capacity management: partner with creative leadership to align resourcing against priorities, manage workload distribution, and ensure teams are set up for success through realistic timelines and clearly defined expectations. cross-functional partnership: serve as the central liaison between creative, marketing, digital, retail, pr, sales & education, and external agencies—ensuring alignment, accountability, and on-time delivery while advocating for creative quality. quality control & brand adherence: act as a steward of sulwhasoo and apb’s luxury standards by ensuring all deliverables meet brand guidelines, approval requirements, and executional expectations—escalating concerns and managing revisions as needed.core responsibilities campaign & deliverables management: lead day-to-day management of all creative deliverables—including campaign content, vmd, retailer.com, paid media, pr, social—from intake through launch, ensuring clear briefs, timelines, and flawless execution. creative operations & workflow management: define, document, and enforce workflows and processes that drive collaboration, rigor, and accountability, while enabling thoughtful iteration and high-quality creative output. content & production oversight: partner with internal teams and production agencies on the strategic development of mood boards, visual narratives, storyboards, shot lists—bringing a discerning eye to detail who is glidance?glidance is a seattle-based startup harnessing cutting-edge ai, robotics and advanced wayfinding technology to address real human needs.our flagship product, glide, is the world's first intelligent guide for individuals who are blind or have low vision — a new category of personal robot that enables millions of people to get out of their homes and navigate more confidently, safely, and independently.if you're looking for a place where groundbreaking technology meets real-world impact, and where your work defines a category rather than iterates upon it, then glidance is where you belong. this is not just your next job: it is your chance to make a life-changing impact on millions around the world.   the role:we're hiring a social media & community manager to own glidance's content and communications across our digital channels. you'll be responsible for how the glidance brand shows up, builds trust, and maintains an active and consistent presence across digital channels, telling the story of glide – the world’s first intelligent guide for the blind and low vision community- and the people who use it while growing a highly engaged community. this is a hands-on role with the founding team at an early-stage company: you'll own everything from strategy through to content creation, development, writing and posting. reports to: head of brand & marketing location: remote, seattle preferred start date: openwhat you'll do:own and shape glidance's digital media and marketing strategy across social platform (linkedin, instagram, youtube, facebook, tiktok and more), and define how a brand-new category of personal robot shows up online. be the front line of our brand: own the glidance inbox and community communications channels, responding to inquiries with care and accuracy. build and run a content calendar tied to product milestones and events, and handle day-to-day publishing across platforms. design simple, low-friction ways to collect user-generated content (ugc) from demo days, field testing and early customers, then manage its intake, organization and production for social, marketing and community channels. create original content that makes glide, and our brand, stand out: posts, short-form video, glider stories, product explainers, content series, blogs and more. support marketing and sales coordination: newsletters, launch communications, partner outreach, and the materials the team needs to tell the glide story. help support demo days, conferences and events, from logistics and promotion beforehand to content capture and follow-up afterward. set ambitious targets, track kpis across every channel (growth, engagement, sentiment, conversions), and report bi-weekly on qualitative and quantitative performance with clear learnings and next steps. what you bring:5+ years managing social media, growth marketing, or community engagement for brands; ideally startups, consumer tech or mission-driven organizations. exceptional writing and communications skills, whether it's a 200-character post, a 1,500-word article, or an empathetic email response to a preorder customer. exceptional organization skillsproven track record growing social audiences and driving measurable engagement. familiarity with ai, robotics and emerging technologies. hands-on skill editing short-form video and creating simple graphics for social (e.g. capcut, premiere, canva). experience with scheduling and analytics tools, crms, and sales and marketing systems (pipedrive, shopify, mailchimp, etc.). sound judgment and genuine empathy when telling stories about disability and accessibility, and the instinct to let people speak in their own voice. self-direction and a deep desire to grow: you set priorities, own your workflow and drive conversations forward, with support when you need it. nice to have:lived experience of blindness or low vision, or close ties to the blind and low-vision community. experience marketing assistive technology, medical devices, robotics or hardware products. working knowledge of accessible content practices: alt text, captions and audio description. what we offer:competitive compensation & benefits commensurate with experience. a chance to shape the voice of a category-defining product from the ground up. work that directly expands independence for millions of people with sight loss.

developing strategic partnerships, making value-based decisions, and finding innovative solutions to the world’s food waste crisis. you’ll join an elite team to elevate our growth and collaborate consumer-facing campaigns across the us and canada. sitting within the b2c marketing team, you will be the creative force that brings the too good to go brand to life, inspiring both prospective and existing customers to join the food waste movement.in this role, you will bridge the gap between imaginative storytelling and analytical rigor. you will own your workstreams end-to-end, moving fluidly from high-level campaign concepting to tactical execution. rather than settling for vanity metrics, you will look deep into the data to prioritize initiatives that drive true brand love, user acquisition, and measurable marketplace impact.core responsibilitiescampaign strategy & brand concepting (b2c)campaign ownership: own the strategy, ideation, and end-to-end execution of high-impact, production, ensuring all marketing assets and copy are exceptionally creative, on-brand, and localized for the north american market.content, influencer & community growthinfluencer marketing: scale and manage our influencer marketing program from end-to-end, including sourcing creators, negotiating contracts, briefing content, and tracking roi.owned social & content creation: drive the overarching strategy for our owned social media channels, concepting highly engaging, viral-worthy content that highlights the value of saving food.community management: oversee regional community management strategies to foster deep brand loyalty, turn casual users into brand advocates, and keep our audience highly engaged.cross-functional collaboration & data impactmatrixed collaboration: serve as a key connective tissue across marketing verticals, collaborating daily with local and global teams—including crm marketing managers, partner marketing managers, social media managers, and pr managers.data-driven optimization: regularly dig into performance data to evaluate campaign health. move beyond likes and impressions to measure how your workstreams impact core business metrics like customer acquisition, engagement, and retention.requirementsthe experience: significant years of hands-on experience in brand marketing, campaign management, or consumer marketing. experience within a high-growth b2c app or mobile-first marketplace is highly preferred.creative brand acumen: a natural creative storyteller who instinctively understands how to bring a brand identity to life across digital and physical touchpoints. proven experience managing external creative agencies is a must.multi-channel expertise: deep familiarity with modern consumer marketing channels, including influencer networks, owned social platforms (tiktok, instagram), experiential activations, and community management.data fluency: you don't just report on vanity metrics; you are comfortable digging into the data to understand the true business impact of your campaigns and use insights to build your next strategy.strategic & tactical: you can dream up big, innovative campaign ideas but are equally excited to roll up your sleeves, build briefs, write copy, and execute the work.collaborative owner: you are a self-starter who thrives when given total ownership of a project, while remaining a supportive, highly aligned team player within a complex global structure.what it takes to succeedwe are looking for people who are energized by the opportunity and driven by the discipline it takes to achieve it. too good to go is building a high performing team where the right people thrive by holding themselves and each other to these standards. if you are looking for a place to grow, own your work, and make an impact—you’ll fit right in.to succeed here, you’ll need to embody these four principles:choose excellence over ease: you take initiative and prioritize long-term impact over short-term comfort, consistently pushing for exceptional quality rather than settling for "good enough."demonstrate integrity and responsibility: you do the right thing when no one is watching. you recognize your own agency to influence outcomes and take responsibility —meeting setbacks with solutions and humility rather than excuses.seek honesty: you ask questions and prioritize truth over comfort, welcoming candid feedback, and addressing performance directly to ensure we never stop improving.bring energy and joy to the journey: you take responsibility for the energy you bring to the team, finding meaning in the work while celebrating our shared wins and lessons.benefitsagility & autonomymodern hybrid model: maintain a high-performance rhythm with a balance of focused remote work and collaborative office days (3x a week) in our nyc hub.global mobility: the flexibility to work from abroad for up to 30 days per year.dedicated time to recharge: 20 days of paid vacation plus additional paid volunteer time through our shareback program.parental support: comprehensive paid parental leave with top-up support to ensure you can be present for life’s most significant milestones.holistic wellbeing & securitypremium health coverage: 100% employer-paid medical (epo), dental, and vision options for employees.comprehensive support: access to our employee assistance program (eap) for mental health care, legal and financial advisory, and family support.active lifestyle: stay energized with monthly classpass credits and our dedicated bike mobility program.financial future: plan for long-term security with a 401(k) program, including an employer-matched contribution.community & belongingglobal connectivity: engage with our international team through various employee resource groups (ergs), including p.r.i.d.e., women in the workplace, global majority voices, and functionally diverse groups.vibrant workspace: experience a welcoming office environment with curated snacks, premium coffee, and regular team celebrations that foster a true sense of community.how to applywe take recruitment very seriously, so please carefully read everything we have written above. please also check our website and international media in order to get a good overview of too good to go.submit your cv and cover letter in english.please note that we only accept applications confidently quantify impact and business value. built to provide a centralized view of risk and compliance, with ai intelligence woven into the platform's core, logicgate delivers real-time insights and actionable data to help drive current business decisions, with the flexibility to scale alongside evolving business needs. recognized as a leader in the grc market, logicgate continues to further solidify its position as a best-in-class platform.the grc marketgovernance, risk, and compliance (grc) is a rapidly expanding sector, with a global market size projected to reach $104.5 billion by 2031. logicgate is at the forefront of this industry transformation, empowering enterprise professionals to navigate complex regulatory environments, manage critical uncertainty, and operate with integrity at scale.senior pr managerabout the roleas a senior public relations manager you’ll serve as a hands-on storyteller who orchestrates our media relations and thought leadership strategy tier-one coverage. this is an autonomous, highly visible builder seat where you will set the pr strategy, write pitches, and measure outcomes with direct access to leadership. if you are a tenacious relations strategy: cultivates relationships with reporters, editors, podcasters, and newsletter writers at tier-one publications to secure earned placements across business, technology, and grc sectors. proactive storytelling: writes and distributes targeted weekly pitches—spanning customer stories, product news, original research, and executive commentary—to drive brand awareness and earn coverage. rapid response communications: responds to fast-moving industry news and issues with expert commentary from logicgate leaders to maximize news-jacking opportunities and protect corporate credibility. pr operations & measurement: owns the inbound press inbox, media calendar, and reporting metrics (such as share of voice and aeo citation rates) to clearly demonstrate pr's influence on the sales pipeline. cross-functional collaboration: partners with product marketing, sales, and demand generation teams to align pr campaigns with broader product launches, research, and revenue goals. what you bringrequired:execution & autonomy: 8 or more years in public relations at an agency or b2b technology company, with a proven track record of independently pitching and securing tier-one earned placements. technical translation & communication: exceptional written and verbal communication skills, demonstrating the ability to turn dense product capabilities, customer stories, or complex data into sharp, compelling pitches and releases. agility & news judgment: sound news judgment and the ability to operate calmly under pressure to handle reactive, sensitive communications and fast-moving industry trends. analytical & ai literacy: demonstrated ability to explain pr impact with data (coverage quality, share of voice) alongside curiosity and experience leveraging modern about avanteask any employee to explain their benefits, and you'll likely get a confused shrug. ask any hr leader if their benefits investment is working, and you'll get an honest "i don't know." for employees, benefits are confusing and overwhelming. for hr and finance leaders, benefits are the second-largest expense, but they lack the visibility to know what's working and what's wasted.at avante, we're changing that. we're an ai-native benefits intelligence platform built to help companies and hr leaders run benefits more effectively with ai. for employees, our agent carly provides personalized, always-on benefits guidance. for benefits leaders, our agent ava serves as the extension of the benefits team, handling operational workload and giving them better insights, sooner.we're based in seattle and expanding our presence to new york city, and work 4 days a week in the office (one day remote). we sell to fortune 2000 employers, with customers like samsung, zscaler, and news corp, and our marketing team is still small enough that one person's writing sets the tone for how the entire market understands what we do. we're looking for a senior content marketing manager to be that person.the roleai for benefits barely existed two years ago, and someone has to write the story of why it matters. that's this role: you'll be the voice behind the ideas, events, and content that make hr and benefits leaders sit up and pay attention.day to day, you'll plan and write across a range of formats: blog posts, sales enablement materials, event and webinar content, social, and more, moving fluidly between short-term production and longer-term editorial planning. you'll partner closely with product marketing, demand generation, and creative to make sure content ladders up to the right goals and reaches the right audience, and you'll use data to figure out what's working and adjust accordingly.this is a senior individual contributor role built for a writer at heart: you'll launch thought leadership communications, shape the narrative behind our webinars and panels, and turn avante's customer relationships into stories nobody else can tell. you'll own and curate avante’s brand voice, and identify areas of improvement as this industry continues to develop. what's yours is the writing itself: the original thinking, sharp framing, and proprietary point of view that no ai tool or outside agency can produce.what you'll dobuild avante's content engine. stand up the fundamentals: a working content calendar, website content, and a steady cadence of gtm enablement materials that give sales something concrete to use in every deal.curate avante's point of view. build narratives, materials, and thought leadership that define our category, educate and entertain our buyers, and enlighten and engage our partners and customers.write and shape our event content. build the speaker guides, narrative arcs, and talking points behind our webinars, panels, and podcasts. you provide the narrative and direction; creative partners handle production.lead our social presence. you'll shape what we say on our social platforms and make sure it sounds like a company with something to say, not another ai vendor posting for the algorithm.support demand generation with nurture content. write the drip sequences that keep leads warm once they enter the funnel, and write to improve aeo and seo through topical content, optimized for ranking.protect a consistent brand voice. make sure everything avante puts out, whatever the format or channel, sounds like it's coming from the same company. you're the one who catches it when copy drifts off-brand, and the one who keeps that voice sharp as more people touch content over time.use ai to extend your reach, not replace your thinking. let it handle the mechanical work, slicing long-form pieces into emails, subject lines, and social copy, so you can spend your time on what it can't produce: original ideas, real customer stories, and a voice that's recognizably avante's.adapt as we grow. scope will shift as the marketing function scales, and you should welcome that.what we're looking for7+ years in content marketing or a writing-heavy communications role, with a portfolio led by thought leadership and executive or event content, not general content opsbachelors degree in marketing, communications, or equivalent experienceexcellent, independently strong writing and editing skills; you can take a rough transcript or technical brief and turn it into something a senior hr or benefits leader wants to readdirect experience writing for events: speaker guides, panel and webinar narratives, or podcast contenta track record of producing enablement materials that sales teams actually use, built on real relationships, not generic testimonialscomfort using ai tools to repurpose and extend long-form writing, paired with clear judgment about what only a human writer should produceexperience partnering with product marketing or brand partners and executing on their vision.early-stage startup experience, including comfort being the only content person for a whileexperience marketing to enterprise-level/fortune 2000 companiesnice to havea published writing background (bylines, books, or a personal platform with real readership)experience marketing to hr, benefits, or healthcare buyershow we workour four values aren't aspirational. they translate into concrete operating tenets that shape how we make decisions every day.beat yesterday. we re-evaluate our own toolkit every quarter, because the workflows that made you effective three months ago may already be outdated. we act on 70% of the information rather than waiting for certainty. we timebox, execute, and iterate, getting work in front of real people quickly instead of polishing in isolation. and we own our output regardless of how we produced it. ai can get you 80% of the way there. everything that goes out with your name on it is your responsibility to review, refine, and stand behind.embrace type 2 fun. we take on hard problems and find meaning in the work, even when it's uncomfortable. we assume good intent and follow up directly rather than venting in side channels. we celebrate wins loudly and specifically, naming the actual behavior so the whole team learns what great looks like. we are on by default, because we owe it to each other and to our customers to be available beyond what a regular corporate job would demand. and we do unscalable things today that build scalable advantages tomorrow: every hand-built case study and late-night byline turnaround earns us the right to scale later.stay hungry, stay curious. we expect everyone to be the expert on ai in their function before anyone asks them to be. the landscape changes weekly. when you learn something, teach it. learn enough about adjacent functions to ask good questions. ask the question you think is too basic, because in complex domains like benefits, the cost of a wrong assumption can be a lost account. and remember: curiosity without urgency is a hobby. learning has to translate into action on a timeline that matches the opportunity.act like an owner. we say the uncomfortable thing early, raising missed commitments or quality gaps directly with the person within 48 hours. we surface problems when they're small, not the week they become a crisis. customer-facing work gets priority, always. and we close the loop every time, because over-communication is a feature at our stage, not a bug.comp: $120k-$155k base, + equity

standards across content, campaigns, and marketing assets. as the voice of marketing within the integration team, you represent brand and marketing interests across workstreams and ensure that integration decisions uphold brand integrity. you ensure each firm transitions cleanly from integration into business-as-usual (bau).reporting into the growth & marketing lead, integration and coordinating through the integration management office (imo), the firm's central governance body for coordinating and overseeing integration execution, you serve as the accountable owner for brand consistency and quality within the marketing & brand workstream. you partner closely with corporate brand, campaign marketing and the digital and website integration teams to ensure brand and marketing execution is consistent, on-standard, and high quality while reflecting local market and language needs. you operate as both a workstream lead and a hands-on brand practitioner, ensuring brand consistency is delivered repeatably as the firm scales across geographies.essential functions and responsibilities: own the brand integration plan for assigned firms, translating approved brand decisions into clear actions, milestones, owners, dependencies and handover dates.  translate approved brand strategy and acquisition brand decisions into clear integration plans, milestones, owners and dependencies.  ensure each integrated firm adopts a consistent visual identity, applying branded templates, visual identity assets, and guidelines uniformly across markets.  review and quality-assure integrated content, campaigns, and marketing assets to confirm they meet global brand standards before go-live.  act as the voice of marketing within the integration team, representing brand and dependencies across workstreams and ensuring integration decisions uphold brand integrity.  coordinate localization and translation requirements with relevant market and specialist teams, ensuring approved brand standards are maintained.  support the application of approved global campaigns and creative in integrating markets, working with campaign marketing and creative teams to maintain a consistent brand look, feel and message.  coordinate with the sales & marketing collateral lead to keep brand content and sales collateral visually and stylistically consistent.  partner with corporate brand and campaign marketing to enforce global brand standards, messaging, and creative quality across integrated firms.  manage integration activities against capacity, identifying gaps, risks, dependencies, and trade-offs; escalate decisions through imo governance.  coordinate with outsourced and contracted delivery partners where brand, creative, or content production is externally sourced, ensuring brand quality and standards are met.  use established brand governance playbooks and standards to support consistent, repeatable brand onboarding, identifying gaps or improvements for brand operations to address.  provide practical brand onboarding and guidance to joining marketing teams, helping them understand what must be applied consistently, where adaptation is permitted and when central approval is required.  maintain a clear record of brand decisions, approvals, exceptions, open issues and outstanding actions throughout each integration.  other duties as assigned. you have the following technical skills and qualifications: bachelor's degree in marketing, business, communications, or related field  5-7 years of experience in brand management, brand fiber-optic sensing, and advanced reservoir engineering, fervo has developed a repeatable approach to building utility-scale enhanced geothermal systems. our flagship cape station development in utah detail.desc: looking for something new?for nearly three decades, dkc has been a leading communications agency attracting the best and the brightest talent from around the country. currently, we are searching for a trailblazing account supervisor to join our new york beauty lifestyle team which works across variety of sectors and industries, including beauty, and other lifestyle related clients.we’re looking for a creative thinker and business strategist who has the media connections to move mountains; curiosity to work in exciting sectors and the right amount of energy and enthusiasm to help world-class teams take brands to new heights.the nature of the work provides a dynamic environment where members of the team are asked to adapt quickly to a changing media landscape while working with reporters on a number of beats. no two days are the same, and we like it that way.allow us to introduce ourselves:dkc is one of the country’s most innovative independent communications agencieswe strongly believe in the mantra, work hard, play harder, win together!with a vibrant and fast-paced atmosphere, dkc prides itself on offering a culture of fun, inclusivity, and growth. from our national committees focused on health & wellness, diversity, to a hands-on-approach to training and career growth, dkc offers a wide range of options for career minded staff. plus, we offer 401k match, cell phone reimbursement, an unlimited vacation and sick day policy, the latest technology for all digital natives and a welcoming environment that is all about perfecting the craft of communications.now, a little about you:smart, energetic, savvy account leader with sophisticated media relations expertise and digital chops looking to join our rapidly expanding team.5 -7 years’ experience in public relations and integrated communications, with experience with beauty, and related lifestyle business brands and corporate clients. agency experience preferred.proven success in developing and executing strategic communications programs with media relations at the core.deep relationships with reporters/editors at national and local outlets.understands and can study data, distill insights, and bring new ideas to the forefront, and translate that data into insights that can help set the stage for communications programmingcomfortable working in a fast-paced team environment and can roll with the punches (not literally! however, we do have a wellness club if you’re into that)has the motivation and attitude to mentor junior staffable to foster new and significant media and industry relationships, while maintaining relationships with key mediaexcellent writing skillsrelentless attention to detail and proven ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously, bringing a sense of urgency to the task at handcommitment to delivering outstanding client service, providing both strategic counsel and hands-on resultsability to think both analytically and creativelyentrepreneurial spirit and desire to be a part of teamthe salary range for this role is commensurate with experience from around $80k - $100k.our office has a hybrid work model: in office 3 days a week, working remote 2 days a week.at dkc, we celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. we are proud to be an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our agency. we do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

agencygolin ketchumjob functionaccount management and growthjob subfunctionaccount managementjob descriptiongolin ketchum is looking for a manager/senior account executive to join our technology team! golin ketchum shapes narratives for the world’s most innovative technology brands. from consumer technologies to b2b, cloud, enterprise and foundational tech, our specialists help clients navigate the ai era with strategic communications that inspire business leaders, decision-makers and society at large.we lead with earned media and pair it with strategy, data and creative that connect to how customers actually decide. we are looking for a manager (senior account executive) who goes after the story instead of waiting for one, knows how to engage reporters and create editorial value, and can help a technical executive bring the story to life.you will lead account programs, counsel clients on executing against strategy, partner with agency specialists, and lead and mentor the account team around you. this is a hands-on role for someone ready to support client relationships and grow toward the next level of leadership.golin ketchum is the most awarded public relations agency of the decade. we create change that matters for our clients and our people. the kind of change that earns attention and shapes culture to build business. formed in 2026 from the merger of two iconic pr agencies, golin ketchum combines fearless creative and strategic excellence, fueled by omnicom’s industry-leading data and ai solutions, to uncover powerful insights and execute work that builds and protects the world’s greatest companies. with specialized expertise across consumer and brands, corporate affairs, healthcare, technology, and food, agriculture and nutrition, we deliver integrated, high-impact communications services at scale. at golin ketchum, culture matters. we are fiercely ambitious yet fundamentally kind and collaborate obsessively with the best clients in the world.want to create change that matters with us? here are the details:what you’ll dolead with earned media. develop and secure compelling coverage for enterprise and b2b technology brands, and proactively create opportunities across trade, vertical, business and financial, technology, broadcast, and national and local outlets. support the account. manage multiple programs and workstreams, coordinating between the agency and client teams on planning, timelines, reporting, and measurement. shape the story. turn complex technology, product launches, and executive perspectives into narratives that are clear, differentiated, and newsworthy. write, edit, and present communications plans, points of view, q&as, and press materials. build media relationships. establish and nurture relationships with the reporters who cover enterprise tech and lead pitching that earns placement on the strength of the story. counsel clients. advise client on executing against strategy, with a point of view on competitors, market dynamics, and media trends. partner with account leadership on bigger calls. think beyond earned. learn to integrate thought leadership, analyst and influencer engagement, social, and emerging disciplines such as ai visibility and generative engine optimization into program plans. develop the team. coach assistant account executives and coordinators, set a high bar for writing and strategic thinking, and help other junior staff grow their careers. grow the business. identify expansion opportunities within existing accounts and contribute to new business pitches and rfp responses. what you haveany combination of education and experience providing the required skills and knowledge for successful performance would qualify. typical qualifications would be equivalent to:3 to 5 years of relevant account management experience, pr agency preferred, with day-to-day examples of supporting client relationships and workstreams. experience with enterprise and b2b technology brands, such as enterprise software, semiconductors, cloud, ai, cybersecurity and with the journalists and outlets that cover them. a record of securing high-impact coverage and a working network of tech and business reporters. sharp writing, editing, and storytelling skills, with the ability to make technical subject matter compelling to journalists and business audiences. experience mentoring junior team members. comfort working with engineers and subject matter experts to translate complex concepts. curiosity for all things technology, a real-time pulse on the industry, and an interest in how ai is reshaping search, media, and discovery. bachelor's degree in communications, public relations, journalism, english, marketing, or a related field preferred. nice to haveexperience with global or multi-market programs. background in executive visibility, industry analyst relations, or influencer programs. familiarity with measurement approaches for earned media and ai visibility. exposure to issues and crisis communications. prior experience supporting new business pitches. golin ketchum is proud to be an equal opportunity/affirmative action employer. golin ketchum recruits qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, gender, age, ethnic or national origin, protected veteran status, physical or mental disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status or citizenship status.69k - 90kto the extent permissible by local law, omnicom’s policy requires employees to work in the office for a minimum of three days a week, unless additional in-office days are directed by their agency or manager.omnicom is committed to hiring and developing exceptional talent. we agree that talent is uniquely distributed, and we’re focused on developing inclusive teams that can bring the best solutions to everything we do. we strongly believe that celebrating what makes us different makes us better together. join us—we look forward to getting to know you. we will process your personal data in accordance with our recruitment privacy notice.link to recruitment privacy notice: https://www.omc.com/privacy-noticefor us job seekersit is the policy of omnicom and any of its affiliates to provide equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, religion, color, ethnic detail.desc: our offices in boca raton, fl and nashville, tn are where we come together for collaboration, education, and celebrations, and we’re looking for teammates who can join us in person for those meaningful moments.reports to: evp, strategy & innovationyears experience: 10+ yearsdepartment: strategy & innovationthe position:the director, brand strategy is the lead commercialization and market strategy expert within bpd’s integrated pharmaceutical engagement model. bridging commercial strategy, market access, customer engagement, and brand activation, this role helps pharmaceutical clients position, launch, and grow brands in competitive markets - translating scientific differentiation into business opportunity and engagement strategies that drive adoption, access, and long-term growth.partnering across medical affairs, market access, analytics, media, creative, sales enablement, and account leadership, the director, brand strategy develops commercially viable, insight-driven go-to-market strategies grounded in real market dynamics and customer behavior, and serves as a trusted strategic advisor in client engagements and business development.the responsibilities:includes, but not limited to the following:lead commercial planning for pharmaceutical brands across pre-launch, launch, and growth phases, including launch readiness and strategic prioritization.develop integrated commercialization and go-to-market strategies — channel strategy, stakeholder engagement, customer journey planning, and activation frameworks — aligned to market opportunity and business objectives.analyze therapeutic category dynamics, competitive landscapes, reimbursement environments, and customer behavior; translate market intelligence into actionable commercial recommendations and identify barriers, adoption challenges, and whitespace opportunities.integrate market access, payer, and healthcare ecosystem considerations into brand strategy, and support stakeholder segmentation across hcps, payers, health systems, advocacy groups, and patients.partner with brand strategy and creative to define differentiated positioning and messaging frameworks that align scientific differentiation with commercial opportunity, translating clinical value into meaningful market narratives.partner with media and engagement teams to shape omnichannel engagement and customer activation plans across digital and in-person ecosystems, leveraging bpd and mjh engagement capabilities.serve as a strategic advisor to clients throughout engagements, building trusted relationships with senior client stakeholders.play an active role in business development - partnering with growth and account leadership to shape pharma-focused pitches, proposals, and organic growth opportunities, and representing bpd’s commercial strategy capabilities in the market.leverage ai-enabled tools and bpd’s proprietary data platform to accelerate market analysis, insight generation, and commercial planning.the essentials:10+ years of experience in pharmaceutical commercialization, brand strategy, launch planning, or consulting.deep understanding of pharma market dynamics and commercialization models; experience in specialty, rare disease, or complex therapeutic categories preferred.strong grasp of payer, reimbursement, and market access considerations.experience developing omnichannel engagement and customer activation strategies.ability to communicate effectively with scientific and commercial stakeholders alike, and to collaborate across integrated, cross-functional teams.ba/bs in an advanced science, business, or related field; advanced degree (mba, mph, or science) a plus.fluency with ai-enabled tools and data platforms to inform insight generation, market analysis, and commercial planning.comfort operating in a fast-paced, growth-oriented environment.able to travel as needed.the vision:bpd health is the strategic growth partner trusted by the most ambitious brands in health. purpose-built for health brands, health systems, pharmaceutical companies and healthcare innovators, we help organizations grow by connecting market position, team engagement, physician referrals, patient demand, payer relations and community impact into one coordinated growth system. as part of mjh life sciences, we give clients direct access to the largest physician engagement network in the u.s.unified bpd unites our diverse backgrounds and perspectives into a stronger collective—one that fosters a more inclusive, impactful future for our people, our clients, and healthcare as a whole. guided by ongoing reflection and learning, we respect every race, ethnicity, gender expression, sexual identity, ability, and life experience.as bpderrrs, we:celebrate and value what makes each of us unique;unite around our shared purpose to ignite greatness in those we serve and, by extension, help them improve the health to the communities they serve;lead through inclusive work that authentically connects with all consumers and champions health equity for alllean into honest dialogue, acknowledging that building a diverse workforce, fostering belonging, and creating the best, most inclusive work for our clients and their communities is an ongoing journey.this commitment ignites our organization’s greatness and grounds the brilliant work we do for our clients and communities.bpd is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. bpd recruits qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, gender, age, ethnic or national origin, protected veteran status, physical or mental disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, or citizenship status.

why usaa?at usaa, our mission is to empower our members to achieve financial security through highly competitive products, exceptional service and trusted advice. we seek to be the #1 choice for the military community and their families.embrace a fulfilling career at usaa, where our core values – honesty, integrity, loyalty and service – define how we treat each other and our members. be part of what truly makes us special and impactful.we are proud to support active-duty military spouses. usaa roles may offer remote or hybrid flexibility for active-duty military spouses consistent with applicable policy and business needs.the opportunityour creative strategist senior translates business priorities, audience insights, and usaa’s brand strategy into compelling creative strategies that strengthen relevance, deepen trust, and drive growth. connects the needs of prospective and existing members with distinctive storytelling across channels and the marketing journey. develops clear, actionable creative briefs that align stakeholders and guide creative development. partners across marketing to connect creative decisions to meaningful member and business outcomes while reinforcing usaa’s mission and a unified brand.we offer a flexible work environment that requires an individual to be in the office 4 days per week. this position can be based in one of the following locations: san antonio, tx, plano, tx, phoenix, az, charlotte, nc, colorado springs, co, and tampa, fl.relocation assistance is not available for this position.what you'll dodevelops creative strategy for assigned campaigns and initiatives, translating business objectives, audience priorities, and the master brand platform into focused creative recommendations. applies usaa’s understanding of the military community and the master brand platform to campaign-level strategy, messaging, and storytelling.creates concise, actionable creative briefs that define the business challenge, audience, desired response, core insight, messaging priorities, and creative guardrails. applies the master brand platform to campaign-level creative strategy and messaging, ensuring assigned initiatives reinforce a consistent and distinctive expression of usaa.develops messaging and storytelling recommendations across acquisition, engagement, and retention, adapting recommendations to audience and channel needs. clarifies requirements, consolidates stakeholder feedback, and confirms alignment before creative development.partners closely with in-house creative teams and external agencies from briefing through development, representing the strategy, providing actionable feedback, and evaluating concepts against the approved brief, master brand platform, audience needs, and intended outcomes.applies audience insights, creative testing findings, campaign performance, and other available evidence to refine campaign-level strategy, messaging, and recommendations.applies established strategic frameworks and emerging cultural, channel, and creative practices, including responsible ai use, to improve the relevance, quality, and efficiency of strategic work. resolves routine questions and escalates significant or conflicting direction promptly to the lead creative strategist reduce avoidable back-and-forth and rework. ensures risks associated with business activities are effectively identified, measured, monitored, and controlled in accordance with risk and compliance policies and procedures.what you havebachelor's degree; or 4 years of relevant education and/or experience.7-8 years of experience in creative strategy, brand strategy, account planning, integrated marketing strategy, or a related discipline. demonstrated experience independently developing creative strategy for integrated marketing campaigns. demonstrated ability to translate audience research and business objectives into concise creative briefs and messaging recommendations that creative teams can execute. experience collaborating with creative teams, cross-functional stakeholders, and agencies to clarify direction and resolve feedback. experience applying audience insights, creative testing, and campaign performance findings to refine campaign-level creative strategy and messaging. knowledge of brand building, consumer behavior, and channel-specific storytelling across digital, social, video, and other marketing channels. demonstrated ability to present strategic recommendations clearly and manage multiple assignments and deadlines. what sets you apartconnect business strategy to creative strategy translate defined business objectives, audience needs and brand direction into a focused creative problem and actionable strategy for assigned initiatives.find the insight that unlocks the work connect available audience insights, cultural context and member needs to identify the human tension or truth most relevant to the assignment.bring a clear strategic point of view make and clearly articulates strategic recommendations rather than simply capturing stakeholder input or facilitating the process.inspire rather than constrains creative teams you write focused briefs and provides strategic guidance that inspires ideas while leaving room for creative exploration.make the work feel distinctly usaa apply the master brand platform and usaa’s understanding of the military community to campaign-level messaging and storytelling.is a trusted creative partner work alongside creative teams from briefing through development, providing constructive strategic feedback that keeps the work true to the brief and brand.compensation range: the salary range for this position is: $103,450 - $197,730.usaa does not provide visa sponsorship for this role. please do not apply for this role if at any time (now or in the future) you will need immigration support (i.e., h-1b, tn, stem opt training plans, etc.).compensation: usaa has an effective process for assessing market data and establishing ranges to ensure we remain competitive. you are paid within the salary range based on your experience and market data of the position. the actual salary for this role may vary by location.employees may be eligible for pay incentives based on overall corporate and individual performance and at the discretion of the usaa board of directors.the above description reflects the details considered necessary to describe the principal functions of the job and should not be construed as a detailed description of all the work requirements that may be performed in the job.benefits: at usaa our employees enjoy best-in-class benefits to support their physical, financial, and emotional wellness. these benefits include comprehensive medical, dental and vision plans, 401(k), pension, life insurance, parental benefits, adoption assistance, paid time off program with paid holidays plus 16 paid volunteer hours, and various wellness programs. additionally, our career path planning and continuing education assists employees with their professional goals.for more details on our outstanding benefits, visit our benefits page on usaajobs.com.applications for this position are accepted on an ongoing basis, this posting will remain open until the position is filled. thus, interested candidates are encouraged to apply the same day they view this posting. usaa is an equal opportunity employer. all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or status as a protected veteran.

impact. in addition, the foundation designs and hosts innovative programs that strengthen the region’s nonprofit ecosystem. position summary the communications officer is the community foundation’s consistent with the community foundation’s voice, and proofread final materials to catch copy and design errors before publication. ﻿program support develop the communications that support the community foundation’s events and programs, such as promotion, invitations, and written materials. provide support for event planning, media coverage and execution. essential professional assets bachelor’s degree in communications, journalism, public relations, english or a related field, or equivalent experience. three to five years of experience in communications, public relations, writing. working knowledge of ap style and the ability to maintain a consistent brand voice. experience writing for executives, including speeches, talking points and bylined articles. experience with website content management, email platforms and social media scheduling tools. essential personal assets a sharp eye for detail and a rigorous, unsparing editing standard, with a proven ability to catch copy, formatting and design errors, from typos and inconsistent style to misaligned layouts and incorrect names, figures and dates. comfort managing several projects and deadlines at once,
